invite:0.en: The hall smelled of pine smoke and old parchment. Master Qingwu set a fresh brush beside each empty seat, then turned to us. 'A blank page does not wait forever,' she said. 'I *invite* each of you to write the word for wind before the incense burns down.' My hand trembled over the paper.
invite:0.cnHint: 师尊____我们在香燃尽之前写出'风'字，我的手在纸上颤抖。
invite:0.hook: The incense was already half gone.
invite:0.line: 'I *invite* you to prove the word lives inside you.'

million:0.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a map across the study table. Tiny peaks dotted the silk like scattered salt. 'A *million* cloud-paths cross this sea,' he said quietly, tracing one silver line with his finger. 'Master Qingwu walked every one before she chose ours.' I stared until the lines blurred.
million:0.cnHint: 师兄说云海上有____条云路，师尊走遍了每一条才选中我们所在的这座山。
million:0.hook: One path on the map glowed faintly red.
million:0.line: 'A *million* paths exist, yet only one rises to the summit.'

represent:0.en: Master Qingwu held up a single character brushed in gold. 'Every stroke you draw must *represent* more than ink,' she said. 'It must carry your breath, your intention, your will to ascend.' The room fell silent. Outside, the clouds shifted and the mountain groaned once, low and long.
represent:0.cnHint: 师尊说我们笔下的每一个字都必须____超越墨水本身的东西。
represent:0.hook: The golden character slowly lifted off the paper.
represent:0.line: 'Let this stroke *represent* everything you have learned so far.'

surprise:0.en: I had copied the word for 'ascend' a hundred times and felt nothing. Then, on the hundred and first try, warm light spread from the page to my fingertips. The *surprise* stopped my breath for a moment. Xiaoxing looked over from her desk and gave a small, knowing nod. The candle between us burned twice as bright.
surprise:0.cnHint: 当我第一百零一次抄写'升'字时，一阵温热的____让我屏住了呼吸。
surprise:0.hook: The candle between us burned twice as bright.
surprise:0.line: 'What a *surprise* — the word chose you before you chose it.'

topic:0.en: Shen Wujiu pinned a single character to the board at the front of the study room. 'Today's *topic* is silence,' he announced. No one laughed. He explained that the word for silence, written correctly, could still a storm. I pressed my brush to paper and heard, for one breath, nothing at all.
topic:0.cnHint: 师兄宣布今天的____是'寂静'，正确写出这个字据说可以平息风暴。
topic:0.hook: Outside, the howling wind stopped the instant my brush lifted.
topic:0.line: 'The *topic* today is the word that holds all other words still.'

meat:0.en: The evening meal was simple: rice, pickled greens, and a small bowl of braised *meat* that Xiaoxing said was an old sect tradition before a disciple's first flight trial. 'Eat well,' she said softly. 'The body must be strong or the words cannot lift you.' I finished every grain and tried to believe her.
meat:0.cnHint: 小星说在弟子第一次飞行试炼前吃____是门派的传统，身体要强健，字才能将你托起。
meat:0.hook: After the meal, my shadow on the wall stretched six inches taller.
meat:0.line: 'Eat the *meat* — tonight demands more than words alone.'

drink:0.en: Master Qingwu poured two small cups from a clay pot and set one before me. The liquid was pale green and smelled of rain on stone. 'When you *drink* this herb tea,' she said, 'say the word for cloud aloud. The two must meet inside you.' I lifted the cup, whispered the word, and the steam rose in a perfect spiral.
drink:0.cnHint: 师尊让我在____这杯草药茶时大声说出'云'字，两者必须在我体内相遇。
drink:0.hook: The spiral of steam did not fade — it climbed toward the ceiling and kept going.
drink:0.line: '*Drink* slowly, and let the word settle with the warmth.'

sleep:0.en: Past midnight the study hall was quiet. I had promised myself one more page, but my eyes kept closing over the open scroll. Xiaoxing appeared at my shoulder. 'Good *sleep* sharpens a word better than a good brush,' she murmured, pressing a folded blanket into my arms. I blew out the lamp — and saw a character glowing on the dark wall.
sleep:0.cnHint: 小星说好好____比一支好笔更能磨砺字的力量，她把毯子递给了我。
sleep:0.hook: The glowing character on the wall was the one I had failed all evening.
sleep:0.line: 'Take your *sleep* — the words will wait, but your spirit will not.'

shop:0.en: Inside the inner hall, rows of lacquered shelves held every kind of spiritual herb. Master Qingwu called this place the sect's *shop* — not for coin, but for earned knowledge. Each jar was sealed with a word; break the word, claim the herb. I reached for the smallest jar and felt the seal tremble beneath my fingers.
shop:0.cnHint: 内堂的____中，每只药罐都以一个字封印，师尊说只有悟透字义才能取走草药。
shop:0.hook: The jar I touched began to glow with a cold, silver light.
shop:0.line: 'This *shop* asks no silver — only understanding,' said Master Qingwu.

electronic:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread a thin jade plate on the study table. Tiny lines of light ran across its surface like rivers seen from above. He called it an *electronic* scripture — a new kind of text where words moved and rearranged themselves to test the reader. I had never seen words behave like living things before.
electronic:0.cnHint: 师兄展示了一块玉板，其上的文字如流光般移动，他称之为____经文。
electronic:0.hook: One glowing word detached itself and drifted toward my open hand.
electronic:0.line: 'An *electronic* scripture changes each time you read it,' Shen Wujiu warned.

wild:0.en: The herb room smelled of rain and deep forest. Xiaoxing pointed to a cluster of dark roots in a clay pot. 'These grew on no tended slope,' she said. They were *wild* — pulled from the edge of a crumbling outer peak where no disciple was supposed to go. Their power was raw and uneven, like a song sung too loud.
wild:0.cnHint: 小星指着那些____草药说，它们长自无人看管的悬崖边缘，力量粗粝而难以驯服。
wild:0.hook: One root curled slowly, as though it had just woken up.
wild:0.line: 'A *wild* herb can heal twice as fast — or burn twice as deep,' Xiaoxing said.

rich:0.en: Master Qingwu ground the silver leaf into powder and the whole room filled with a warm, layered scent. 'The soil of the upper peak is *rich*,' she said, 'and so the words that grow there carry more weight.' I copied the formula onto my strip of paper and felt the ink sink deeper than usual, as if the page itself was drinking.
rich:0.cnHint: 师尊说上峰的土壤____而深厚，那里生长的字药蕴含更重的力量。
rich:0.hook: My ink strip curled at the edges and let out a single faint chime.
rich:0.line: 'Only a *rich* root can carry a formula strong enough to lift a man,' said Master Qingwu.

special:0.en: Among the rows of common herb jars stood one black canister with no label. Shen Wujiu told me it held a *special* word — one that the sect kept for a single purpose no junior disciple was told. He said it plainly, without drama, and then moved on. But his hand paused on the shelf just a breath too long.
special:0.cnHint: 那只黑色无名罐子里装着一个____的字药，师兄说它只为某个从不告知弟子的目的而存在。
special:0.hook: That night the canister was gone, and no one admitted moving it.
special:0.line: 'It is *special* — and that is exactly why you must not ask,' said Shen Wujiu.

text:0.en: My first assignment was to read a strip of bark hung above the inner door. Master Qingwu called it the founding *text* of the Cloud Sea Sect — forty words that, read in the right order, could still the wind on a broken peak. I read it three times and felt nothing. On the fourth reading, my breath steadied without my trying.
text:0.cnHint: 那片悬于内门之上的树皮是云海宗的开宗____，据说以正确顺序诵读可平息山间之风。
text:0.hook: On my fifth reading, the bark began to curl away from the wall.
text:0.line: 'The *text* does not change — you are the one who must change,' said Master Qingwu.

front:0.en: The study hall faced east, and the wide window at the *front* looked out over nothing but white cloud. Xiaoxing said that on the clearest mornings you could see the shadow of a lower peak far below. We waited together in silence as the cloud thinned. The shadow appeared, darker than it should have been for that hour.
front:0.cnHint: 书堂____的大窗朝东而开，小星说晴天可以隐约看见云层之下更低山峰的影子。
front:0.hook: The shadow below was shaped like no mountain either of us recognised.
front:0.line: 'Stand at the *front* window and tell me what you see at dawn,' said Xiaoxing.

law:0.en: Shen Wujiu set down his brush and looked at me steadily. 'There is a *law* older than any sect rule,' he said, 'and it lives inside the words themselves — a word misused will turn and mark the one who spoke it.' He tapped the formula I had written. One stroke was crooked. I had not noticed, but the paper had already begun to yellow at that corner.
law:0.cnHint: 师兄说字药之中存有一种古老的____，误用文字者，字会反过来在使用者身上留下印记。
law:0.hook: The yellowed corner of my paper spread slowly toward the center.
law:0.line: 'The first *law* of every formula is: mean what you write,' said Shen Wujiu.

thinking:0.en: I sat alone in the study hall, a single candle burning low. My *thinking* had circled the same formula for three hours — how could one word carry both healing and flight? Then, quietly, the answer rose like mist from the page. I pressed my brush to the paper and wrote. The candle flame turned pale blue and held perfectly still.
thinking:0.cnHint: 我在书房独自苦思，终于明白了那个咒文的双重含义，就在那一刻，烛火变成了蓝色。
thinking:0.hook: Beyond the window, a second moon blinked open in the cloud sea.
thinking:0.line: 'My *thinking* stopped the moment the word chose me, not the other way.'

cover:0.en: Master Qingwu spread a cloth of pale silk to *cover* the iron cauldron. She said the word inside must breathe in darkness before it could take root in a disciple's chest. I knelt and waited, heart loud as a drum. A thin thread of silver smoke slipped beneath the cloth and curled toward my face.
cover:0.cnHint: 师尊用丝布____住铁鼎，说灵字必须在黑暗中酝酿，才能扎根弟子心中。
cover:0.hook: The smoke spelled a character none of us had studied yet.
cover:0.line: 'Use silence to *cover* the word until it is ready to wake.'

earth:0.en: The lesson was simple: kneel and press both palms to the wooden floor until you could feel the mountain's root far below. Shen Wujiu called it listening to the *earth* beneath the clouds — a skill most disciples skipped, thinking it too slow. I stayed an hour longer. When I rose, my feet left faint glowing prints on the boards.
earth:0.cnHint: 师兄说要感受云层之下的____，这是大多数弟子忽视的功课，但我多练了一个时辰。
earth:0.hook: The prints pointed toward the locked eastern archive.
earth:0.line: 'The *earth* below the clouds still remembers every word ever spoken to it.'

paper:0.en: Xiaoxing slid a folded square of *paper* across the study table without a word. Inside was a formula I had spent a week searching for, written in her neat hand. The characters shimmered faintly — she had already fed them a little of her own breath. I looked up to thank her, but her seat was empty and her candle was out.
paper:0.cnHint: 师妹悄悄递给我一张____，上面写着我找了一周的咒文，墨迹还在微微发光。
paper:0.hook: Her empty chair was still warm, but the door had not opened.
paper:0.line: 'Keep the *paper* flat — the word hates being folded a second time.'

art:0.en: Master Qingwu said that writing a healing word was not only knowledge but *art* — the brush angle, the speed of the stroke, the moment you lifted your hand all changed what the word could do. I had copied the character five hundred times and still she shook her head. On the five hundred and first try she went very quiet.
art:0.cnHint: 师尊说书写治愈灵字不仅是学问，更是一种____，每一笔的角度与速度都会改变其效果。
art:0.hook: She turned the page over and over, as if afraid to set it down.
art:0.line: 'The *art* lives in the pause between one stroke and the next.'

street:0.en: The inner sect map showed something strange: a narrow *street* running between the Herb Hall and the Flame Archive, unmarked and too straight to be a natural path. Shen Wujiu said no one used it. I walked it anyway, counting my steps. Midway, the cloud sea below the mountain became perfectly silent, and every bird on the peak stopped singing at once.
street:0.cnHint: 内门地图上有一条未标注的____，介于药堂与火档之间，师兄说没人走那里，但我还是去了。
street:0.hook: At the street's far end, a door stood open that the map did not show.
street:0.line: 'That *street* has been on the map since before the sect had disciples.'

talent:0.en: I overheard two senior disciples say my *talent* for spoken formulas was unusual — not strong, but strange, as if the words recognized me before I learned them. I said nothing and kept my head down over my brush. That night the ink stone on my desk cracked cleanly in two along a seam that formed a perfect character for 'sky.'
talent:0.cnHint: 我无意中听到两位师兄议论我在口诀上的____很奇特，似乎灵字在我学会之前就已认识我。
talent:0.hook: The character in the cracked stone was not in any text I had ever seen.
talent:0.line: 'Raw *talent* without discipline is a word pronounced in the wrong season.'

overall:0.en: At the month's end Master Qingwu reviewed our work. The *overall* progress of the class was steady, she said, like a river that does not hurry. Then she paused at my scroll for a long moment, tapping one line twice with her finger, and looked out the window instead of at me. Far below, something large moved through the cloud sea.
overall:0.cnHint: 月末，师尊点评全班____进展平稳，但她在我的卷轴前停顿了很久，随后望向窗外。
overall:0.hook: Whatever moved in the clouds below was larger than any known spirit beast.
overall:0.line: 'The *overall* pattern of your strokes tells me more than any single word.'

meaning:0.en: Inside the Hall of Scrolls, I unrolled an ancient text and traced each character with trembling fingers. Master Qingwu stood behind me, silent as stone. Only when I read the final line aloud did I feel its true *meaning* settle into my bones, heavy and warm.
meaning:0.cnHint: 我在藏卷堂中终于领悟了古卷最后一行的____。
meaning:0.hook: The candle flame bent sideways, though no wind stirred.
meaning:0.line: 'Every word holds a *meaning* only a still mind can receive,' said Master Qingwu.

strengthen:0.en: Shen Wujiu showed me how to press the silver herb between two flat stones and breathe slowly while grinding. 'Each pass of the stone will *strengthen* the spirit inside the leaf,' he said. I pressed harder, and the herb began to glow a faint, steady gold.
strengthen:0.cnHint: 师兄教我研磨银草，说此法能____草叶中的灵力。
strengthen:0.hook: Then the glow pulsed once, like a heartbeat, and stopped.
strengthen:0.line: 'Repeat this every dawn to *strengthen* what you carry inside,' said Shen Wujiu.

competitive:0.en: Master Qingwu had posted the trial rankings on the inner wall of the study. The names glowed in order of spiritual power. I had not expected the hall to feel so *competitive*, each disciple standing apart, eyes measuring, breath held.
competitive:0.cnHint: 排名榜贴出后，书斋里弥漫着一股____的气氛。
competitive:0.hook: Xiaoxing's name was missing from the list entirely.
competitive:0.line: 'A *competitive* spirit is a fire — warm if kept small,' said Master Qingwu.

recently:0.en: Xiaoxing sat cross-legged on the reed mat, sorting dried sky-petals into small clay jars. She told me she had *recently* begun hearing faint tones inside the herbs — not sound exactly, but something close to music. I listened, and realised I heard nothing at all.
recently:0.cnHint: 小星告诉我，她____开始能听见草药中细微的声音。
recently:0.hook: Outside the window, a white bird landed and did not move.
recently:0.line: 'I have *recently* started hearing things the others cannot,' Xiaoxing said softly.

nation:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a wide map across the long table. It showed every sect, every peak, every trade road in the cloud-sea lands. 'This is our *nation* of cultivators,' she said, 'and the words you master here will one day hold it together or let it fall.'
nation:0.cnHint: 师尊展开地图，向我说明这片修炼者____的版图。
nation:0.hook: One peak on the map was circled in red ink, still wet.
nation:0.line: 'Every disciple of this sect serves the *nation* of the cloud sea,' said Master Qingwu.

perceive:0.en: I sat alone in the study, pressing my palm to a sealed formula jar. I could feel warmth but nothing more. Shen Wujiu watched from the doorway and told me that to *perceive* the word inside, I must first empty every thought, even the wish to succeed.
perceive:0.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，只有清空杂念，才能____封印瓶中的字诀。
perceive:0.hook: When I finally emptied my mind, the jar cracked clean in two.
perceive:0.line: 'You must *perceive* the word before you can ever speak it,' said Shen Wujiu.

pound:0.en: The preparation room smelled of earth and smoke. I was given a stone bowl and told to *pound* the dried moon-root until no piece remained larger than a grain of sand. My arms burned after the first hour. Xiaoxing glanced over and silently took the second bowl.
pound:0.cnHint: 我在炼药房里奉命将月根____成细粉，手臂酸痛难忍。
pound:0.hook: The powder, once fine, began to rise on its own.
pound:0.line: '*Pound* until the root releases its hidden light,' said Master Qingwu.

purpose:0.en: After the evening lesson, I remained in the study staring at the empty formula board. I had copied words all day without understanding why. Master Qingwu returned, set a single lit candle before me, and asked what I thought the *purpose* of a flame was — to burn, or to show the dark.
purpose:0.cnHint: 师尊在课后向我追问，修习字诀究竟有何____。
purpose:0.hook: I opened my mouth to answer, and the candle went out.
purpose:0.line: 'Know your *purpose* before the trial begins, or the trial will decide it for you,' said Master Qingwu.

satisfaction:0.en: Inside the Hall of Words, I pressed my palm against the stone tablet and felt the character for 'wind' enter my chest like warm tea. Master Qingwu watched in silence. When the glow faded, a quiet *satisfaction* spread through my bones — not pride, but the deep ease of something finally understood. The mountain hummed beneath my feet.
satisfaction:0.cnHint: 我在石碑前领悟了'风'字，心中升起一种____的感觉。
satisfaction:0.hook: Then the tablet cracked, and a second character bled through.
satisfaction:0.line: 'This *satisfaction* you feel — treasure it, for the next word will not come so gently,' said Master Qingwu.

cultivate:0.en: Each morning in the inner library, Shen Wujiu lit a single candle and began to read aloud. 'You cannot hurry a herb,' he told me. 'You must *cultivate* it — water it with patience, warm it with attention, and wait.' I copied his method with the word for 'cloud.' By noon, the word breathed on its own. Somewhere outside, thunder gathered.
cultivate:0.cnHint: 师兄在内室书房教我如何____一个字，就像照料一株草药。
cultivate:0.hook: The candle flame bent sideways, though the windows were sealed shut.
cultivate:0.line: 'To *cultivate* a word is to give it a season, not a single afternoon,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

productive:0.en: Xiaoxing spread her notes across the reading mat, each page dense with copied glyphs. 'Today was *productive*,' she said, stacking them with care. I looked at my own page — half-blank, one word crossed out. Master Qingwu passed the doorway without stopping, but her sleeve brushed the lamp, and the light shifted from gold to pale blue.
productive:0.cnHint: 小星把满满的笔记摆好，说今天很____，而我的纸页却几乎空白。
productive:0.hook: The blue light settled on Xiaoxing's topmost page and would not leave.
productive:0.line: 'A *productive* day is one where one true word is found, not ten false ones,' Master Qingwu said.

vision:0.en: The library held a mirror no one used. Shen Wujiu said looking into it too long would blur your *vision* — not your eyes, but your inner sense of what words meant. I glanced anyway. For a moment every book on the shelves blazed with colour, each title a different flame. Then my sight returned to ordinary ink and dust.
vision:0.cnHint: 书库里有一面镜子，据说久视会损伤人的____，模糊对字义的感知。
vision:0.hook: In the mirror's corner, one flame had not gone out.
vision:0.line: 'Guard your *vision* of what a word truly means — that is harder to heal than any eye,' Shen Wujiu warned.

distance:0.en: I found the word for 'distance' pressed between two pages like a dried leaf. When I spoke it aloud, the far wall of the study seemed to breathe, as though the room itself remembered open sky. Master Qingwu looked up from her scroll. '*Distance* is not only space,' she said quietly. 'It is also time, and sometimes silence between people.'
distance:0.cnHint: 我念出'____'这个字，书房的远墙仿佛也感受到了辽阔。
distance:0.hook: The dried leaf crumbled, and where it had lain the page showed a map.
distance:0.line: '*Distance* keeps some things safe and some things lost — know which is which,' said Master Qingwu.

forward:0.en: Xiaoxing stood at the edge of the indoor practice terrace, toes curled over the stone lip. She had been trying the word for 'step' for an hour. Finally she spoke it clean, and her body moved *forward* one smooth pace without her feet touching the ground. She landed lightly and laughed — a small, surprised sound. Then the lamp oil ran dry all at once.
forward:0.cnHint: 小星终于念对了字，身体向____轻轻移动，双脚离地一瞬。
forward:0.hook: In sudden darkness, we heard a second set of footsteps no one had made.
forward:0.line: 'Move *forward* only when the word is ready — rushing the step will crack the floor,' Xiaoxing reminded herself.

harmful:0.en: On the herb shelf between two glowing jars sat a scroll marked with a red thread. Shen Wujiu touched the knot and said, 'The words inside are not evil, but used carelessly they are *harmful* — to the speaker first.' I asked what kind of harm. He was quiet a long time, then touched the faded scar along his left wrist. Rain began without clouds.
harmful:0.cnHint: 师兄指着红线封口的书卷说，里面的字若不谨慎使用会____人，首先是念字者自身。
harmful:0.hook: The rain fell upward, rising from the floor grates toward the ceiling.
harmful:0.line: 'What is *harmful* is not the word itself but the hand that throws it without care,' said Shen Wujiu.

impossible:0.en: Master Qingwu set a task I was sure was *impossible*: write the word for 'light' using only darkness-ink, which swallowed every stroke I made. I sat for two hours while the study grew cold. Then Xiaoxing leaned over and whispered, 'Write the space around the word, not the word itself.' I tried. The character appeared, faint and perfect. The ink jar then rose off the table on its own.
impossible:0.cnHint: 师尊布置了一个看似____的任务，小星的一句话却让我找到了答案。
impossible:0.hook: The floating ink jar began, very slowly, to write on its own.
impossible:0.line: 'Call nothing *impossible* until you have tried what the word itself suggests,' said Master Qingwu.

respond:0.en: Master Qingwu set a single word-herb on the stone table and waited. One by one, each disciple tried to name it. When my turn came, something quiet moved inside my chest, and I *responded* without thinking, the word leaving my lips like breath meeting cold air. The herb glowed soft green for just a moment.
respond:0.cnHint: 弟子们依次尝试辨认灵草，轮到我时我脱口而出，竟然____了。
respond:0.hook: Then the glow faded, and Master Qingwu's expression did not.
respond:0.line: 'You *responded* before your mind could stop you — that is the first true sign.'

welcome:0.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the inner gate, lantern in hand, when I arrived at the Hall of First Words. 'Your *welcome* is already written on the wall,' he said softly, nodding toward a line of glowing script above the arch. My name was there, carved in light, among all the others.
welcome:0.cnHint: 进入内殿时，师兄指着墙上发光的文字说，我的____早已刻好在那里。
welcome:0.hook: But one name on the wall was already fading at its edges.
welcome:0.line: 'Your *welcome* was written here long before you climbed this mountain.'

appeal:0.en: I had copied the flying formula forty times and still could not lift a single foot from the floor. In desperation I made a quiet *appeal* to Master Qingwu, bowing low and placing my practice scroll at her feet. She did not laugh. She simply turned the scroll over and pointed to what I had missed.
appeal:0.cnHint: 我无法领悟飞升咒，只好低头向师尊____，她翻开我的卷轴指出了遗漏之处。
appeal:0.hook: The missing stroke looked like a falling leaf — or a warning.
appeal:0.line: 'Your *appeal* has been heard; now see what your own hand already wrote.'

finally:0.en: For seven mornings I sat with the healing word-herb, breathing its faint silver smoke and waiting for it to recognize me. On the eighth morning, it *finally* opened, petal by petal, and the warmth it released settled into my palms like sunlight through thin paper. Xiaoxing watching from the doorway let out a quiet breath.
finally:0.cnHint: 连续七天，那株疗愈灵草对我毫无反应，直到第八天它____开放了。
finally:0.hook: Xiaoxing's relieved breath turned to mist — and the mist formed a character neither of us knew.
finally:0.line: 'It has *finally* opened for you — but keep very still now.'

guess:0.en: Master Qingwu placed three sealed word-jars on the shelf and told us each to *guess* which one held the wind formula. The jars hummed at the same low pitch. I pressed my fingers to the cold glass of the middle jar and felt, faintly, something push back.
guess:0.cnHint: 三只密封灵罐摆在架上，师尊让我们____哪一只藏着风之咒文。
guess:0.hook: The jar I did not choose trembled once, then went perfectly silent.
guess:0.line: '*Guess* carefully — one of these jars has already chosen its next holder.'

protection:0.en: Before the night trial in the Fog Archive, Shen Wujiu pressed a small word-token into my hand. 'This carries a *protection* formula,' he said, his voice low. 'It will hold for one hour. Do not stay longer than that.' The token was warm, and shaped like a seed.
protection:0.cnHint: 夜间试炼前，师兄将一枚刻有____咒的令牌塞进我的手心。
protection:0.hook: An hour later, deep in the Archive, the token turned cold all at once.
protection:0.line: 'This *protection* is strong, but even strong things have their limit.'

resident:0.en: Each word-herb in Master Qingwu's study had a name above its pot. One small silver herb had no name — only a question mark. 'It arrived on its own,' Master Qingwu said. 'It is a *resident* with no origin that I can trace.' The herb tilted its leaves toward me as she spoke.
resident:0.cnHint: 师尊书房里有株无名灵草，她说它是自行而来、来历不明的____。
resident:0.hook: When I looked away and looked back, the herb had moved closer to the edge of its pot.
resident:0.line: 'Every *resident* of this study was invited — except that one.'

willing:0.en: Xiaoxing had mastered the light formula weeks before me, but she never showed it off. When I finally asked her to practice together, she was immediately *willing*, spreading her notes across the low table without a word of hesitation. The candle between us burned unusually tall and still.
willing:0.cnHint: 我请师妹一起练习光之咒时，她毫不犹豫地表示____，把笔记铺满了整张矮桌。
willing:0.hook: Then the candle flame bent sideways, toward the window, though no wind came.
willing:0.line: 'I am *willing* — I have been waiting for you to ask.'

admit:0.en: The inner hall smelled of pine smoke and old paper. I knelt before Master Qingwu and waited. She set down her brush and studied me for a long moment. 'I will *admit* you to the first ring of study,' she said at last, 'but only if you can hold the word for silence without trembling.' My hands were already shaking.
admit:0.cnHint: 师尊宣布____我进入第一阶修习，但附加了一个考验。
admit:0.hook: Outside, the cloud sea turned a colour no one had named yet.
admit:0.line: 'I *admit* you to this sect, but the word you carry will test you harder than I can.'

association:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread a worn chart across the study table and traced two glowing glyphs with his finger. 'Notice the *association* between these two root words,' he said. 'One calls rain; the other calls wind. Together they call a storm.' I copied them side by side, and the ink on my page began to rise like mist.
association:0.cnHint: 师兄解释两个字根之间的____，说明它们合用时会召来风暴。
association:0.hook: A single drop of ink lifted off the page and hung in the air, waiting.
association:0.line: 'The *association* between these glyphs is older than our sect — do not break it carelessly.'

brand:0.en: Master Qingwu pressed a heated seal to the cover of my new scroll. The mark it left was not ink but light — a small, steady flame that would not go out. 'Every word you learn will *brand* itself here,' she told me, 'so the scroll remembers even when you forget.' I touched the warm glow and felt the first word already pressing inward.
brand:0.cnHint: 师尊用一枚印章将光焰____于我的新卷轴封面，从此每个字根都会留下印记。
brand:0.hook: The flame on the cover flickered once, as though answering a call from far below the clouds.
brand:0.line: 'Let each lesson *brand* itself on your scroll before you dare move to the next.'

deep:0.en: The reading room held a single candle and rows of tall shelves that vanished upward into shadow. Shen Wujiu pulled a volume from the lowest shelf and handed it to me. 'Start here,' he said. 'The words on the upper shelves are too *deep* for a new disciple — their meaning can pull your spirit under if you are not ready.' I looked up into the dark and believed him.
deep:0.cnHint: 师兄警告我，高层书架上的字义太____，新弟子尚不能承受。
deep:0.hook: Something on the highest shelf shifted with a sound like held breath.
deep:0.line: 'These upper texts are *deep* beyond your current root — wait until your spirit is steadier.'

discover:0.en: I was copying a healing word for the third time when the brush slipped and drew an unplanned curve. The candle flared. In the new shape I had made by accident, I could suddenly read a meaning no teacher had shown me — a word for mending cracked stone. 'Did you mean to do that?' Xiaoxing asked from the doorway. I shook my head. Sometimes you *discover* a word; sometimes it discovers you.
discover:0.cnHint: 笔锋一滑，我竟____了一个无人教过我的字——能修补裂石的词语。
discover:0.hook: The candle burned green for just one breath, then returned to gold.
discover:0.line: 'To *discover* a word by accident is still a gift — write it down before it fades.'

essential:0.en: Xiaoxing laid seven glyphs in a row on the study mat and then swept four of them aside. 'Only three are *essential* to lift yourself off a mountain ledge,' she explained. 'The rest add beauty but not flight.' I had spent two weeks learning all seven with equal care. I felt the waste of it, and also, quietly, the relief.
essential:0.cnHint: 师妹演示只有三个字根是____的，其余四个不过锦上添花，并不能真正让人飞起来。
essential:0.hook: A wind pressed against the sealed window as if testing whether we had learned the right three.
essential:0.line: 'Master only what is *essential* first — beauty in a formula means nothing if you fall.'

fine:0.en: I had not slept well. My copying was uneven, and Master Qingwu could see it at once. She held my scroll to the light, tilted her head, and set it down. 'The meaning is intact,' she said. 'Your hand is *fine* for today.' It was not praise exactly, but in the quiet of that room, with cloud light coming through the high window, it felt like enough.
fine:0.cnHint: 师尊检视我歪歪扭扭的誊写后，说今日的手感____——并非称赞，却已足够。
fine:0.hook: Her shadow on the wall held perfectly still, though no shadow should have in that shifting light.
fine:0.line: 'Your grip is *fine* for now, but tomorrow the scroll will ask more of you than today did.'

largely:0.en: Shen Wujiu reviewed my first month of progress with careful eyes. 'Your mistakes are *largely* in the water-root family,' he said, pointing to a cluster of smudged glyphs near the centre of my practice sheet. 'Fix the root and the branches correct themselves.' It sounded simple. I looked at the smudges and counted twelve of them, each one slightly different from the last.
largely:0.cnHint: 师兄指出我一个月来的错误____集中在水字根一族，建议我从根部修正。
largely:0.hook: One of the smudged glyphs pulsed once with a faint blue light, as though disagreeing.
largely:0.line: 'Your errors are *largely* rooted in one family of glyphs — correct the source, not each mistake.'

australia:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an old map across the stone table. Every continent was named after a lost word-herb. One southern land, vast and ringed by ocean, bore the name *Australia* — a word said to hold the power of deep roots and warm wind. 'No disciple has ever gathered it,' she said softly.
australia:0.cnHint: 师尊展开古地图，指向南方那片以____命名的大陆，据说那里蕴藏着深根与暖风之力。
australia:0.hook: The map's ink began to glow, tracing a path only one pair of eyes could see.
australia:0.line: 'The word *Australia* sleeps far away, but its warmth can still reach us here.'

authority:0.en: Shen Wujiu's voice was calm as he read from the Sect's oldest scroll. Every rule carved there carried the *authority* of masters long gone — words so strong they still held the mountain steady. I copied each line slowly, feeling their weight settle into my brush.
authority:0.cnHint: 师兄诵读宗门古卷，那些规则承载着先师的____，重如山石。
authority:0.hook: On the final line, the ink refused to dry.
authority:0.line: 'The scroll's *authority* is older than this mountain — copy it with care.'

confident:0.en: Xiaoxing stood before the word-flame and breathed out the healing formula without a pause. She looked *confident*, her hands steady, her voice clear as running water. I watched from the doorway, holding my own untested scroll, and felt both admiration and a quiet ache.
confident:0.cnHint: 师妹站在字焰前，神态____地吟诵治愈咒文，令我既佩服又暗感压力。
confident:0.hook: The flame shifted color the moment she finished — no one had seen that before.
confident:0.line: 'Be *confident* when you speak a word-herb — doubt poisons its power.'

crowd:0.en: Word-herbs release their light at dawn, and this morning every disciple gathered to watch. The indoor hall could barely hold them all; the *crowd* pressed close, breathing as one. Master Qingwu had promised that today a new formula would bloom — one none of us had ever heard.
crowd:0.cnHint: 清晨，弟子们____满室内大厅，等待一个从未有人听过的新咒文绽放。
crowd:0.hook: Before Master Qingwu spoke, every lamp in the hall went dark at once.
crowd:0.line: 'When a *crowd* gathers for a word-herb, its power always grows stronger.'

highly:0.en: Master Qingwu placed a small jade scroll on the table and said nothing at first. The sect's records spoke *highly* of this text — three former masters had built their greatest works from it. I reached out, and the scroll was warm, almost alive beneath my fingers.
highly:0.cnHint: 宗门典籍对这卷玉简____赞誉，三位前任掌门曾以它为基础成就最高修为。
highly:0.hook: A faint sound rose from inside the jade, like a voice trying to wake up.
highly:0.line: 'The elders think *highly* of this formula — do not open it carelessly.'

occur:0.en: I was grinding ink at the inner study table when it began to *occur*: a low hum, rising through the stone floor, through my knees, into my chest. The word-herbs on the shelf trembled in their jars. Shen Wujiu looked up from his scroll and met my eyes without a word.
occur:0.cnHint: 我在内室磨墨时，异象开始____——低鸣声从石地板升起，架上的字草纷纷颤动。
occur:0.hook: The hum formed a single syllable, and it was the one word none of us dared to speak.
occur:0.line: 'Strange things *occur* in this room when the mountain shifts — stay still.'

regularly:0.en: Shen Wujiu showed me the practice board on the inner wall. Each disciple's name had small marks beside it — records of how *regularly* they had spoken their daily word-herb. Mine had only two marks. His had an unbroken line stretching back three years, steady as a heartbeat.
regularly:0.cnHint: 师兄指着内墙练习板，上面记录着每位弟子____诵读字草的情况，我的标记寥寥无几。
regularly:0.hook: At the bottom of the board, one name had no marks at all — and it was still warm to the touch.
regularly:0.line: 'Train *regularly* and the word-herbs will begin to answer you on their own.'

responsible:0.en: After the shelf of word-herb jars cracked in the night, Master Qingwu gathered us in the inner hall. She asked who was *responsible* for closing the sealing formula before sleep. Silence filled the room. I looked at the floor, knowing I had been the last one near the shelf.
responsible:0.cnHint: 字草罐架夜间碎裂后，师尊召集众人，询问谁____封印咒文——我是最后靠近架子的人。
responsible:0.hook: Outside the sealed window, a single jar floated in the air, waiting.
responsible:0.line: 'Whoever is *responsible* must speak the repair formula before the next bell.'

machine:0.en: The inner hall smelled of pine resin and old ink. Along one wall stood a strange *machine* of brass rings and spinning discs, built to copy sacred word-scrolls without a human hand. Master Qingwu said it had no spirit of its own — yet every scroll it copied glowed faintly at the edges.
machine:0.cnHint: 内堂里有一台用来复制神圣字卷的黄铜____，据说它本无灵气，但它抄出的每一卷都微微发光。
machine:0.hook: At midnight, the brass rings turned — though no one had wound them.
machine:0.line: 'This *machine* copies the words, but it cannot feel their power,' said Master Qingwu.

observe:0.en: On the first day of each new month, disciples were required to *observe* a full hour of silence before the Word Altar. I sat still, watching incense smoke rise in slow spirals. Shen Wujiu whispered that the silence itself was a word — the oldest one — and I felt something shift in my chest.
observe:0.cnHint: 每月初一，弟子们必须在字坛前____一个时辰的静默，师兄说寂静本身就是最古老的字。
observe:0.hook: When the hour ended, every candle in the hall bent toward me at once.
observe:0.line: 'We *observe* this silence so the words can find their way to us,' said Shen Wujiu.

fat:0.en: Xiaoxing showed me how to prepare a healing salve from three spoken words and a pressed herb. 'The word must land in the *fat* of the leaf,' she said, pressing her finger into the thick, soft center, 'not the dry edge.' I tried it, and the leaf glowed a steady amber.
fat:0.cnHint: 小星教我将字诀压入草叶____厚的部分来炼制愈合药膏，我试了一次，叶子发出了稳定的琥珀光。
fat:0.hook: Then the amber deepened to red, and a thin crack ran across the ceiling above us.
fat:0.line: 'Press the word into the *fat* part of the leaf — that is where the life waits,' said Xiaoxing.

helpful:0.en: I had copied the flight formula three times and still could not lift a single stone. Shen Wujiu sat beside me and said nothing for a long moment. Then he moved my brush hand one small degree to the left. That quiet correction was more *helpful* than any long lesson, and the stone rose smoothly on my fourth try.
helpful:0.cnHint: 师兄只是轻轻调整了我握笔的角度，这个小小的纠正比任何长篇讲解都更____，第四次我终于让石头浮了起来。
helpful:0.hook: The stone kept rising long after it should have stopped, passing clean through the ceiling beam.
helpful:0.line: 'One small change in your grip is more *helpful* than a hundred extra tries,' said Shen Wujiu.

position:0.en: Master Qingwu spent a long time adjusting the wooden stand that held my practice scroll, tilting it, raising it, stepping back to look. 'The *position* of the word on the page is half the formula,' she said at last. When she stepped away, the scroll cast a shadow shaped like a bird in mid-flight.
position:0.cnHint: 清梧师尊花了很长时间调整字卷架的____，说字在纸上的位置本身就是法诀的一半。
position:0.hook: The bird-shaped shadow spread its wings and flew slowly up the wall.
position:0.line: 'The *position* of each word on the page changes what it does,' said Master Qingwu.

threat:0.en: A cold wind came through the sealed window. Xiaoxing read the dark script that formed in the frost on the glass and her face went pale. 'It is a *threat*,' she said quietly, 'left by someone who knows our sect's private words.' I looked at the frost characters and felt the air press heavy against my ribs.
threat:0.cnHint: 窗玻璃上的霜结成了黑色字迹，小星认出那是一个____，出自某个知晓本门秘字之人。
threat:0.hook: Before we could speak again, the frost melted and the words were gone.
threat:0.line: 'This is a *threat* from someone who has read our oldest scrolls,' said Xiaoxing.

trend:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long chart on the study table. It tracked how the mountain's word-energy rose and fell across ten years. 'The *trend* is clear,' she said, tracing the rising line with one finger. 'The words are growing stronger — but only for those who listen carefully.' I leaned in and felt a low hum against my palm.
trend:0.cnHint: 清梧师尊展开图卷，指出山中字力十年来的____清晰可见：字正在变得更强，但只对用心倾听的人如此。
trend:0.hook: At the chart's far right edge, the line shot straight upward and vanished off the page.
trend:0.line: 'The *trend* in word-energy has been rising for three years without pause,' said Master Qingwu.

ultimately:0.en: I asked Shen Wujiu what all our study was truly for — the copying, the silence, the salves, the charts. He thought for a moment, looking out at the cloud sea below. 'We *ultimately* learn the words so the words can learn us back,' he said. I did not fully understand, but something in the clouds below seemed to lean closer, listening.
ultimately:0.cnHint: 当我问师兄修行的意义，他说我们____学习字诀，是为了让字诀也能反过来认识我们。
ultimately:0.hook: Below us, a single column of cloud rose in perfect silence and pointed at the window.
ultimately:0.line: 'We are *ultimately* not mastering words — the words are choosing to trust us,' said Shen Wujiu.

digital:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a scroll of pale silk on the stone desk. Each character had been carved with a brush so fine that the strokes looked almost *digital* — sharp, precise, each line perfectly measured. 'These are the forty root words of ascent,' she said. 'Learn them before the morning bell, or the clouds will not carry you.'
digital:0.cnHint: 师尊展开一张丝绢卷轴，上面的字迹极为精确，她要求弟子在晨钟前掌握这四十个____的词根。
digital:0.hook: A faint hum rose from the scroll, as if the characters were counting down.
digital:0.line: 'Each *digital* mark on this scroll holds one breath of the mountain's spirit.'

sale:0.en: In the inner hall, jars of bottled words lined the shelves from floor to ceiling. Shen Wujiu handed me a small blue jar with a paper tag tied to its neck. 'Not every word here is for *sale*,' he said quietly, 'but this one — the word for wind — Master Qingwu set aside just for you.' The jar felt warmer than it should have.
sale:0.cnHint: 在内堂的架子上，师兄递给我一只小蓝罐，说并非所有词语都____，但这个"风"字是师尊专门留给我的。
sale:0.hook: The jar's warmth spread up my arm and into my chest, uninvited.
sale:0.line: 'This word is not for *sale* to just anyone — it chose you first.'

contact:0.en: Master Qingwu placed my hand flat on the cold stone altar. 'Do not pull away,' she said. The moment my palm made *contact* with the carved word beneath it, a soft golden light spread across my fingers like morning across still water. Xiaoxing watched from the door, hands clasped, eyes wide.
contact:0.cnHint: 师尊让我将手平放在石祭坛上，当我的手掌与刻字____的瞬间，金光从指尖漫开。
contact:0.hook: The light stopped — then reversed, flowing back into the stone without a sound.
contact:0.line: 'The moment you *contact* a true word, it reads you in return.'

failure:0.en: My first attempt to speak the word for cloud ended in silence. Xiaoxing gently closed her book and said nothing. Shen Wujiu set a cup of warm tea beside me without comment. But it was the *failure* itself that taught me something: the word had not refused me — it had simply asked for more stillness. I breathed, and tried again.
failure:0.cnHint: 我第一次尝试念出"云"字以沉默告终，但这次____本身教会了我：那个词不是拒绝我，而是要我更平静。
failure:0.hook: On the third breath, the ceiling trembled — just once.
failure:0.line: 'Every *failure* to speak a word is the word asking you to listen harder.'

bird:0.en: A small *bird* had flown in through the lattice window and settled on the edge of my open text. It was pale grey, almost white, with eyes the colour of deep water. Xiaoxing whispered that birds of this kind only entered a study room when a disciple was close to understanding something true. It tilted its head, then flew straight up and vanished through the ceiling.
bird:0.cnHint: 一只____飞入我的书房，落在翻开的典籍边缘，小星说这种鸟只在弟子接近领悟真义时才会出现。
bird:0.hook: Where it had perched, three characters glowed faintly on the page.
bird:0.line: 'That *bird* does not visit disciples who are wasting their time.'

official:0.en: A messenger arrived at dusk carrying a rolled document sealed with the Cloud Sea Sect's mark. Shen Wujiu read it twice, then set it down on the desk. 'It is *official*,' he said, almost to himself. 'The Council of Peaks has approved your entry into the inner word-garden. You may name a word tomorrow.' Outside, the floating mountains shifted slightly, as if listening.
official:0.cnHint: 黄昏时，一份盖有云海宗印记的文书送到，师兄读罢说，我进入内词园的资格已正式____批准，明天可以命名一个词。
official:0.hook: The seal on the document dissolved into silver smoke the moment he set it down.
official:0.line: 'It is now *official*: the mountain has accepted you as its student.'

confidence:0.en: Before I stepped onto the word-bridge for the first time, my legs felt hollow. Xiaoxing stood beside me and did not offer a hand — instead she said, 'The bridge is made of spoken words. It holds only as long as your *confidence* holds.' I said the word for sky, clearly and without trembling. The bridge lit up beneath my foot like a lamp warming to life.
confidence:0.cnHint: 我第一次踏上词桥前双腿发软，小星告诉我这座桥只要我的____在，就会稳固，于是我清晰地念出了"天"字。
confidence:0.hook: At the bridge's far end, a door stood open that had not been there before.
confidence:0.line: 'Your *confidence* is not vanity — it is the fuel the words need to burn.'

display:0.en: At the centre of the inner study hall, a tall pillar of pale jade was made to *display* the sect's rarest words. Each character floated inside the stone like a firefly trapped in ice, still alive, still glowing. Master Qingwu told us never to read more than one in a single sitting. Shen Wujiu had once read three, she said, and slept for nine days.
display:0.cnHint: 在内书堂中央，一根白玉柱专门____门派最珍贵的词语，每个字在石中漂浮发光，师尊说一次只能读一个。
display:0.hook: As I turned to leave, one character brightened sharply — as if it had noticed me.
display:0.line: 'We *display* these words not to tempt you, but to remind you how far there is to go.'

awareness:0.en: The inner hall smelled of dried sky-herbs. Master Qingwu set a single candle before me and said nothing. I was meant to sit until some shift happened inside. An hour passed before a quiet *awareness* of the flame filled my chest — not sight, not thought, but something older. The candle did not move. I did.
awareness:0.cnHint: 我在内殿独坐，直到内心升起一种对烛火的____，才算完成了师尊的考验。
awareness:0.hook: Behind the candle, a second shadow stretched where no second flame burned.
awareness:0.line: 'True *awareness* does not arrive — it was always present, waiting for silence.'

introduce:0.en: Shen Wujiu led me into the archive room and paused at the door. Rows of jade slips lined the walls, each one holding a word-formula sealed in green light. 'I will *introduce* you to the first tier,' he said, lifting a slip no larger than my thumb. It hummed at his touch, and the air tasted briefly of rain.
introduce:0.cnHint: 师兄带我进入藏经阁，准备将我____给第一阶梯的法诀。
introduce:0.hook: The slip at the far end of the shelf pulsed once, though no one had touched it.
introduce:0.line: 'Let me *introduce* you to the word that kept me awake for three winters.'

expense:0.en: Xiaoxing showed me her practice record — pages dense with failed attempts. 'Every word costs something,' she said softly. 'Healing words drain warmth from your blood. Flying words burn the soles of your feet.' I had not yet learned the *expense* of the art, only its promise. The record's last page was blank and waiting.
expense:0.cnHint: 师妹向我展示修炼日志，让我明白每一个字诀都有其____。
expense:0.hook: At the bottom of the blank page, a faint character was already forming on its own.
expense:0.line: 'The *expense* of one word of flight kept me bedridden for seven days.'

toward:0.en: Master Qingwu stood at the window of the high study, her back *toward* us. Outside, the sea of clouds rolled in slow silver waves. She had not spoken since placing the open text on the table. Shen Wujiu and I waited. The clouds below began, very slowly, to rise.
toward:0.cnHint: 师尊背对着我们站立，窗外云海____我们缓缓涌来。
toward:0.hook: The clouds rose until the nearest peak was no longer visible below us.
toward:0.line: 'Step *toward* the word you fear most — that is always the one you need.'

track:0.en: The archive room held more than slips. A long scroll on the floor mapped every disciple's learning path in fine ink lines. Shen Wujiu pointed to my name, freshly brushed at the edge. 'This *track* shows where each word leads,' he said. Some lines ran straight to the peaks. Others looped back and vanished.
track:0.cnHint: 藏经阁地图上记录着每位弟子的修炼____，我的名字刚刚出现在边缘。
track:0.hook: One line on the map ended at a location that no map of the mountain had ever named.
track:0.line: 'Your *track* through the first tier will tell Master Qingwu more than any test.'

afford:0.en: Xiaoxing held out a small jade slip and hesitated. 'This one took me a full season to copy,' she said. 'I can *afford* to share it only because you are sect-kin.' The word inside was 'still' — a word that could quiet a storm or a mind. I received it with both hands, as one receives a gift that cost real blood.
afford:0.cnHint: 师妹将珍贵的法诀借给我，因为只有对同门，她才____分享如此珍贵之物。
afford:0.hook: The moment I touched the slip, the candle across the room went completely still.
afford:0.line: 'I can only *afford* to teach this word once, so listen with your whole body.'

feature:0.en: Each word-formula had a face as well as a sound. Master Qingwu described the *feature* that made the healing word 'clear' different from all others: a slight curve in its final stroke, like a question never fully asked. 'Miss that curve,' she said, 'and you will cool a fever into ice.' I traced the stroke nine times before I dared try it aloud.
feature:0.cnHint: 师尊讲解治愈字诀时，特别说明了使它区别于其他字诀的独特____。
feature:0.hook: On my ninth tracing, the brush moved a fraction on its own before I touched the paper.
feature:0.line: 'The *feature* that looks like an error is in fact the heart of the formula.'

innovative:0.en: Shen Wujiu had arranged the study table in a way I had not seen in any elder's room. Word-slips stood upright in a ring rather than lying flat, each one facing the next. 'An *innovative* method,' he admitted with a small smile, 'that Master Qingwu has not yet approved.' The ring of slips began to glow faintly as dusk entered the room.
innovative:0.cnHint: 师兄展示了他独创的法诀摆放方式——一种____的修炼方法，连师尊都尚未点头许可。
innovative:0.hook: As the last light left the sky, the ring of slips rose an inch above the table.
innovative:0.line: 'An *innovative* path is only wrong until the day it works better than the old one.'

experiment:0.en: Master Qingwu set a jade bowl on the stone table and gestured for me to sit. 'Today we run an *experiment*,' she said, placing three dried syllables — pale as winter root — into the bowl. She poured cloud-water over them and we watched. Each syllable swelled, then glowed, then hummed a note that made the candle flame lean toward us. I copied every detail into my log with a steady hand.
experiment:0.cnHint: 师尊让我观察一场关于字灵的____，记录每个音节在云水中的变化。
experiment:0.hook: But the third syllable did not stop glowing when the others faded.
experiment:0.line: 'Today we run an *experiment* — watch the third syllable most closely.'

nature:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread a scroll across the low desk and tapped a line of text. 'The *nature* of a healing word,' he said quietly, 'is not its sound but its intention.' I read the line three times. Outside, wind moved through the bamboo chimes, and each note seemed to agree with him. I wrote the idea down before it could slip away, pressing the brush hard into the paper.
nature:0.cnHint: 师兄解释说，治愈字灵的____不在于发音，而在于书写者的心意。
nature:0.hook: Then the scroll rolled shut on its own, as if it had heard enough.
nature:0.line: 'Understand the *nature* of a word before you dare to speak it aloud.'

status:0.en: I found the rank board posted beside the inner gate. My name sat at the very bottom, next to the word 'new.' Xiaoxing appeared at my shoulder. 'Do not let your *status* on that board decide your worth,' she said, her voice low and even. She had been at the top once; I had heard the story. I turned away from the board and followed her toward the study hall.
status:0.cnHint: 我看到了门派的排名榜，师妹提醒我不要让自己目前的____影响修行的心态。
status:0.hook: That night, someone had brushed a single glowing mark beside my name.
status:0.line: 'Your *status* on that board is a starting point, not a ceiling.'

accident:0.en: I knocked the ink stone off the corner of the desk — a pure *accident*, my sleeve catching it as I reached for a fresh page. The stone cracked on the floor and a dark stain spread like a small lake. Shen Wujiu came in, looked at the stain, and said nothing harsh. He handed me a cloth and knelt to help. Somehow that quiet kindness steadied my hands for the rest of the afternoon.
accident:0.cnHint: 我不小心打翻了砚台——一场____——师兄却默默蹲下来帮我收拾。
accident:0.hook: In the spilled ink, I saw the outline of a word I had never been taught.
accident:0.line: 'It was an *accident* — but notice what pattern the ink made when it fell.'

active:0.en: Master Qingwu told us that a dormant word-seed needs a warm and *active* mind to wake it. She placed a pale seed on each of our palms. Xiaoxing's seed shimmered at once. Mine lay still. I did not panic; I breathed slowly and thought about everything I hoped to learn. After a long moment the seed gave one small pulse of green light, and Master Qingwu nodded.
active:0.cnHint: 师尊说唤醒字种需要一个____的心灵，师妹的字种立刻发光，而我的过了好久才有反应。
active:0.hook: Then all three seeds pulsed together, perfectly in time, which Master Qingwu had not expected.
active:0.line: 'Keep your mind *active* and curious — a sleeping seed feels the difference.'

feed:0.en: Each morning I was told to *feed* the word-moss that lined the study window. It grew on language: I had to read aloud beside it for ten minutes, and the moss would deepen in color with each clear word I spoke. On the third morning it had grown thick enough to brush against the glass. Shen Wujiu said that meant my pronunciation had improved faster than most new disciples managed.
feed:0.cnHint: 每天早晨我需要朗读来____窗台上的字苔，第三天它就长得格外茂盛。
feed:0.hook: On the fourth morning the moss had spelled a short phrase none of us could yet read.
feed:0.line: '*Feed* the moss with your clearest voice — it will show you what you lack.'

principle:0.en: The first lesson written on the study-hall wall was a single *principle*: a word spoken in fear loses half its power. Master Qingwu asked me to copy it one hundred times, not as punishment but as meditation. By the fiftieth copy my brush moved without thought. By the hundredth I felt something settle in my chest — a small, firm weight, like a stone placed at the center of a scale.
principle:0.cnHint: 书房墙上写着修行的核心____：恐惧中念出的字只有一半力量，师尊让我抄写一百遍。
principle:0.hook: When I finished, the words on the wall had changed to something new.
principle:0.line: 'Memorise this *principle* before anything else — it underlies every word you will ever use.'

article:0.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin booklet, open to the middle. 'There is one *article* here,' he said, pointing to a short piece of text no longer than a page, 'that has guided every senior disciple for three generations.' I read it carefully. It described how silence between words held as much power as the words themselves. The room felt quieter after I finished, as if it had listened along with me.
article:0.cnHint: 师兄给我看一本薄册，说其中有一篇____已经指引门派弟子整整三代人。
article:0.hook: The final sentence of the article was written in a hand I recognised as my own.
article:0.line: 'Read this *article* once a day until you no longer need to read it at all.'

operation:0.en: Master Qingwu stood before the jade board, drawing lines of light that crossed and folded like river currents. 'Each *operation* on a formula changes its spirit,' she said softly. I copied every stroke, feeling the air grow heavier with each symbol I traced correctly.
operation:0.cnHint: 师尊在玉板上演示符文的____，我认真临摹每一笔。
operation:0.hook: One symbol remained, and my brush hand would not stop shaking.
operation:0.line: 'Each *operation* on a formula changes its spirit, so trace with full attention.'

population:0.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a wide map across the stone table. 'The entire *population* of the lower villages depends on the Sect's rain-calling rites each spring,' he said quietly. I looked at the tiny painted rooftops and understood for the first time how heavy a disciple's duty truly was.
population:0.cnHint: 师兄展开地图，讲述山下村落____的生计与门派的关联。
population:0.hook: A single red mark on the map showed a village that had gone silent.
population:0.line: 'The *population* of those villages trusts us — we must not fail the spring rite.'

quick:0.en: Master Qingwu set three candles in a row and told me to seal each flame with a word-formula before it burned down to the marking. My hands moved in a *quick* rhythm, one breath per candle, and all three went cold at once. She nodded, but her eyes held a quiet warning.
quick:0.cnHint: 师尊考验我用____的速度依次封住三支烛火。
quick:0.hook: Then she lit a fourth candle I had not seen before.
quick:0.line: 'A *quick* hand means nothing if the heart behind it is not calm.'

scale:0.en: On the inner wall of the archive hall hung a jade tablet carved with the Sect's rank system. Xiaoxing traced each level with one finger. 'Nine rings mark the full *scale* of power,' she whispered, 'and most disciples never pass the third.' I counted the rings slowly, then counted my own weak pulse.
scale:0.cnHint: 小星向我介绍门派力量____的九个层级，大多数弟子止步第三环。
scale:0.hook: Beside ring nine, a name had been carefully scratched away.
scale:0.line: 'Nine rings mark the full *scale* of power — only one person here ever reached the last.'

basic:0.en: The first scroll in the study room held nothing grand — only the *basic* breath-and-root exercise every disciple learns on the first morning. Shen Wujiu sat beside me as I read it again. 'Masters return to this page more than any other,' he said, and I finally believed him.
basic:0.cnHint: 师兄陪我重温修炼的____功法，说高手比任何人都更常翻开这一页。
basic:0.hook: At the page's worn edge, I found a line written in Master Qingwu's hand.
basic:0.line: 'The *basic* breath-root form is the one page even Master Qingwu reads again.'

constantly:0.en: The spirit lamp above my study desk was *constantly* shifting colour — pale gold when my focus held, ashen grey the moment my mind wandered. Xiaoxing had warned me about this lamp. By midnight its grey had deepened twice, and the room felt noticeably colder each time it dimmed.
constantly:0.cnHint: 书案上的灵灯____随我的专注度变色，今夜已两度转为灰色。
constantly:0.hook: Just before dawn, the lamp turned a colour I did not recognise.
constantly:0.line: 'That lamp is *constantly* honest — it shows your mind before you know it yourself.'

favor:0.en: When Master Qingwu chose partners for the paired-reading exercise, she seemed to *favor* those who had already memorised the root glyphs. Shen Wujiu was chosen first, then Xiaoxing. I was chosen last, and yet Master Qingwu's gaze rested on me a moment longer than on the others.
favor:0.cnHint: 师尊在分配功课搭档时似乎____已熟记根字的弟子，我被最后选中。
favor:0.hook: That long gaze felt less like comfort and more like a test already beginning.
favor:0.line: 'I *favor* those who know the roots — they carry the others forward without knowing it.'

absence:0.en: I reached the inner study early and found the room empty. The *absence* of the usual herb-smoke and low chanting made the silence feel enormous. Someone had left a single open scroll on the central table, weighted at one corner by a small river stone I had never seen before.
absence:0.cnHint: 内室少了平日的药烟与诵读声，这份____让寂静显得格外沉重。
absence:0.hook: The scroll was open to the chapter on rites performed only once in a lifetime.
absence:0.line: 'The *absence* of sound in this hall means someone has already begun what cannot be undone.'

institution:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a silk map across the stone table. 'The Cloud Sea Sect is not merely a school,' she said quietly. 'It is an *institution* — a living body of rules and memory, older than any of us.' I traced the ink lines with one finger, feeling the weight of every generation before me. Outside, a single crane passed in silence.
institution:0.cnHint: 师尊解释云海宗不仅是一所学校，更是一个有着深厚传统的____，让我感到肩上责任的分量。
institution:0.hook: The map's ink shifted, drawing a path no one had walked in a hundred years.
institution:0.line: 'This *institution* holds every word ever spoken by those who rose before you.'

outcome:0.en: Shen Wujiu placed two seed-words on the table — one pale, one dark. 'Speak either one aloud,' he said, 'and the *outcome* will be different.' I studied them for a long moment. The pale word smelled of rain. The dark word hummed against my palm. I chose the pale one, and the room filled with soft light.
outcome:0.cnHint: 师兄让我在两个字根中选一个，提醒我每种选择的____都截然不同。
outcome:0.hook: Deep beneath the floor, something ancient stirred at the sound of my voice.
outcome:0.line: 'The *outcome* of your first word will echo in your bones for years.'

recognize:0.en: I stepped into the Hall of First Names and looked at the wall of carved characters. Xiaoxing stood beside me, whispering, 'You will *recognize* your own word when you see it — it will feel like remembering, not learning.' I moved slowly along the wall until one character made my chest warm. I pressed my hand to the stone.
recognize:0.cnHint: 小星告诉我，当我在字墙上看到属于自己的那个字时，我会____它，因为那感觉像是记忆而非学习。
recognize:0.hook: The carved character glowed once, then a thin crack spread across the stone above it.
recognize:0.line: 'When you *recognize* your word, do not let go — hold the feeling tight.'

safety:0.en: The bridge between the two inner peaks was made of woven cloud, not stone. Master Qingwu walked ahead without hesitation. 'The word for *safety* is the first formula every disciple must carry,' she said. I repeated it softly, and the bridge held firm beneath my feet, solid as earth, all the way across.
safety:0.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，代表____的字诀是每位弟子必须铭记于心的第一个法诀，以确保修行路上平安无虞。
safety:0.hook: Behind us, the bridge dissolved into mist the moment we stepped off.
safety:0.line: 'Speak the word for *safety* before you cross — never assume the path is steady.'

collect:0.en: Each morning I was sent to the Word Garden to *collect* three dew-drops from the leaves of the speaking-fern. Xiaoxing showed me how to cup my hands without breaking the stem. 'Every drop holds a syllable,' she said warmly. By the time my bowl was full, the sun had turned the clouds below us a deep gold.
collect:0.cnHint: 每天清晨，我去字园____说语蕨叶片上的露珠，小星告诉我每一滴都蕴含着一个音节。
collect:0.hook: The last drop fell upward instead of down, hanging in the air like a question.
collect:0.line: '*Collect* only what the plant offers freely — to take more is to lose the word.'

door:0.en: Shen Wujiu led me to a corridor with no torches. At the far end stood a plain wooden *door* with a single character burned into its surface. 'Every disciple opens it alone,' he said, then stepped back. I laid my palm flat against the character, spoke it aloud, and the wood grew warm. The door swung open onto open sky.
door:0.cnHint: 师兄带我来到走廊尽头的一扇____前，告诉我每位弟子都必须独自将它打开。
door:0.hook: Through the open doorway, I could see a second door, floating with nothing beneath it.
door:0.line: 'Behind every *door* in this sect lives a word that is waiting to be spoken.'

eventually:0.en: Master Qingwu said I should not be discouraged. 'All disciples struggle with the flight formula at first. You will *eventually* feel it — a lifting in the ribs, like breath taken by the mountain itself.' I practiced until my voice was rough and my legs ached. On the seventh evening, my feet left the floor for three full heartbeats.
eventually:0.cnHint: 师尊鼓励我不要灰心，说我____会掌握飞升法诀，感受到那种被山岳托举的轻盈感。
eventually:0.hook: On the eighth evening, I did not come back down as quickly as before.
eventually:0.line: 'You will *eventually* rise — but the word must trust you as much as you trust it.'

match:0.en: The inner hall held a quiet test: each disciple had to find the herb-word that would *match* the illness drawn on a paper scroll. Xiaoxing had finished in silence; I studied mine for a long time. The scroll showed a cold, blue pattern. I chose the word for ginger-fire, pressed it to the paper, and the blue turned slowly gold.
match:0.cnHint: 内堂的测试要求每位弟子找到能与卷轴上所绘病症____的草药字诀，我在沉思后终于作出了正确的选择。
match:0.hook: As the paper turned gold, every other scroll in the hall rustled, though there was no wind.
match:0.line: 'Find the word that will *match* the wound — not the word you already love best.'

slightly:0.en: The inner hall smelled of old wood and dried petals. I placed my palm on the stone altar, and the carved characters beneath it glowed *slightly* — just a faint warmth, like a candle behind thick paper. Master Qingwu watched without a word. Even that small light meant the words had heard me.
slightly:0.cnHint: 我将手放在石台上，刻字发出____的光芒，师尊静静注视。
slightly:0.hook: Then the glow flickered, and one character went dark.
slightly:0.line: 'The altar responds *slightly* to your spirit — do not mistake a whisper for a shout.'

vital:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread the scroll across the low table and pointed to a single word near its center. 'This one,' he said, 'is *vital*. Remove it and the formula collapses — like pulling the root from a living plant.' I copied it three times, feeling the character pulse under my brush as if it breathed.
vital:0.cnHint: 师兄指着卷轴中央一个____的字，说去掉它整个法诀就会崩溃。
vital:0.hook: Outside, the wind stopped — every leaf on the mountain went still at once.
vital:0.line: 'That single word is *vital*; without it, the formula has no life.'

mention:0.en: No one in the sect had made any *mention* of the sealed door at the corridor's end — not Master Qingwu, not Shen Wujiu, not even Xiaoxing, who talked freely about almost everything. I passed it each morning and felt the air grow thin, as though the door were breathing inward, holding something close.
mention:0.cnHint: 宗门中没有人____过走廊尽头那扇封印的门。
mention:0.hook: That evening, a single word appeared scratched into its frame.
mention:0.line: 'I should not have made any *mention* of what lies beyond that door.'

rare:0.en: Master Qingwu held up a small vial of ink that shone like crushed moonstone. 'This is ground from a *rare* cloud-coral,' she said, 'found only where the sea of clouds swells highest at mid-winter.' Xiaoxing leaned close, eyes wide. I understood then that what I was about to write with it would not easily be unwritten.
rare:0.cnHint: 师尊展示一瓶用____的云珊瑚磨成的墨，那是只在极高处才能找到的东西。
rare:0.hook: As she uncorked the vial, the clouds outside rose three feet in an instant.
rare:0.line: 'Guard this ink — the coral it came from is *rare* beyond any price.'

useful:0.en: Xiaoxing handed me a worn booklet, its cover soft from many hands. 'Every senior disciple marked the words they found most *useful*,' she said with a small smile. Some pages held a single bold stroke; others were crowded with notes so fine I had to tilt the page toward the window-light to read them.
useful:0.cnHint: 师妹把一本记满前辈笔记的小册子交给我，说里面都是他们觉得最____的字。
useful:0.hook: The last page held only a warning, written in red.
useful:0.line: 'Keep it close — the words marked inside proved *useful* in ways their writers never expected.'

blood:0.en: The test was simple: press a thumb to the character for 'ascend' and speak it aloud. When I did, a thin line of light — warm, the color of *blood* at sunrise — ran up from the stone and wrapped once around my wrist. Master Qingwu nodded slowly. The word had accepted me, or perhaps it had simply tasted me.
blood:0.cnHint: 我将拇指按在"升"字上，一道____色的光线从石头里升起，缠绕了我的手腕。
blood:0.hook: The light did not fade — it sank beneath my skin and stayed.
blood:0.line: 'The words read your *blood* before they answer your voice.'

fund:0.en: Shen Wujiu explained that each disciple began with a small *fund* of spiritual syllables — ten words, stored like coins in the breath. Spend them wisely and they earned interest; waste them on idle speech and the reserve ran dry, leaving the speaker mute on the mountain for a full moon-cycle. I counted mine quietly before I said anything at all.
fund:0.cnHint: 师兄说每个弟子都有一笔用以储存灵字的____，要像对待钱币一样谨慎使用。
fund:0.hook: I had already used two without thinking, and the mountain had noticed.
fund:0.line: 'Your *fund* of syllables is small at first — spend each one as though it were your last.'

anxiety:0.en: Before the dawn recitation I felt a sharp *anxiety* — not fear exactly, but the tight feeling of a word hovering just out of reach. Xiaoxing had warned me this would happen: the characters sense hesitation and grow distant. I steadied my breath, let the silence settle like water, and the word floated back to my tongue on its own.
anxiety:0.cnHint: 黎明诵读前，我感到一阵____，因为那个字就悬在我脑海边缘却无法抓住。
anxiety:0.hook: In the courtyard below, a single bell rang — though no hand had touched it.
anxiety:0.line: 'Let go of your *anxiety* — a word pursued too hard will always pull away.'

advice:0.en: Master Qingwu set a single candle on the stone table and studied me for a long moment. 'Before you touch any word-herb,' she said, 'seek *advice* from someone who has already been burned by it.' She slid a small scroll toward me. Its edges were charred, and the ash smelled faintly of lightning.
advice:0.cnHint: 师尊告诫我，在尝试驾驭任何词草之前，应先听取过来人的____。
advice:0.hook: The scroll opened on its own, and the candle flame bent toward it.
advice:0.line: 'Seek *advice* before you light what you cannot put out.'

attempt:0.en: The inner hall was silent except for the hum of stored word-energy in the walls. I placed my hand on the practice stone and tried to *attempt* the Rising Step formula for the third time that evening. Each try had left a pale scorch mark on my palm, and the stone wore three matching rings of grey, like the record of small defeats.
attempt:0.cnHint: 我在修炼内堂里第三次____施展升阶法诀，掌心的灼痕越来越深。
attempt:0.hook: On the fourth ring, the stone began to crack from below.
attempt:0.line: 'Do not *attempt* the next seal until your breath is still.'

draw:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread four word-scrolls across the low table and announced that we would settle the order of training by *draw*. Each scroll held a different element; the one I pulled glowed a faint, unsettling silver before the light died. He said nothing, but his eyes stayed on my hand longer than they should have.
draw:0.cnHint: 师兄说，用____的方式来决定我们各自修炼的法诀顺序。
draw:0.hook: Silver is the color no element claims as its own.
draw:0.line: 'The *draw* is fair — whatever you pull, the word chose you.'

facility:0.en: Xiaoxing led me to the lower terrace, where the Sect kept its oldest training *facility*: a ring of carved pillars, each one threaded with a living word-root. The air inside the ring tasted of cold iron and old rain. She told me the pillars had not been lit for eleven years, and touched one anyway.
facility:0.cnHint: 师妹带我参观了宗门最古老的修炼____，那里的石柱内嵌着活的词根。
facility:0.hook: The moment her fingers left the stone, one pillar began to glow.
facility:0.line: 'This *facility* remembers every disciple who ever stood here.'

firm:0.en: I could not hold the word-seal steady; my fingers kept drifting. Master Qingwu crossed the room and closed her hand lightly over mine, making my grip *firm* against the worn jade surface. The seal locked into place with a sound like a distant bell, and warmth moved up through my wrist and into my shoulder.
firm:0.cnHint: 师尊轻轻握住我的手，使我的持印之力变得____，法印随即稳稳定住了。
firm:0.hook: The bell tone did not fade; it grew, very slowly, louder.
firm:0.line: 'Keep your intent *firm* and the word cannot slip from you.'

innovation:0.en: The senior disciples argued in low voices near the archive shelf. Shen Wujiu had proposed a new way to layer two word-herbs at once — a small *innovation* that the old texts did not record. Some called it clever; others called it dangerous. A pale mist was already rising from the jar where he had mixed them.
innovation:0.cnHint: 师兄提出了一种将两种词草叠用的____，长辈们对此争论不休。
innovation:0.hook: The mist formed a shape before it dissolved: something with wings.
innovation:0.line: 'Every *innovation* begins as an idea someone else feared to try.'

multiple:0.en: Master Qingwu wrote a single character on the board and then, with one breath, split it into *multiple* smaller forms that drifted apart like petals. She said each form carried a fragment of the original meaning, and that a healer must know all of them. The fragments circled the room once, then returned to her hand and rejoined.
multiple:0.cnHint: 师尊将一个字化分为____个细小的词形，说治愈者必须通晓每一种形态。
multiple:0.hook: One fragment returned a half-breath late, and it was a different color.
multiple:0.line: 'One word holds *multiple* lives inside it — learn them all.'

path:0.en: Xiaoxing unrolled a diagram on the inner-hall floor: a map of the mountain's word-channels drawn in silver ink. She traced a thin line with her finger and told me this was the *path* a newly formed word travels from the root stone to the peak, where it becomes strong enough to lift a person off the ground. The line ended at a point that was not labeled.
path:0.cnHint: 师妹展示了一幅图，说明一个初生词语从词根石到山顶所走的____。
path:0.hook: The unlabeled point began to pulse, faint and steady, like a heartbeat.
path:0.line: 'Every disciple must walk the *path* at least once before they fly.'

safe:0.en: Master Qingwu led us into the inner hall, where a heavy stone chest sat carved into the mountain wall. 'Every word-scroll of the sect lives in this *safe*,' she said, pressing one hand to its cold surface. The air smelled of cedar and old ink. I counted my breaths and felt the mountain breathe back.
safe:0.cnHint: 师尊向我们展示了存放门派珍贵卷轴的石制____，叮嘱弟子们恭敬对待。
safe:0.hook: But one scroll was missing, and its empty place still glowed.
safe:0.line: 'Every rare word-scroll the sect owns rests inside this *safe*.'

speed:0.en: Shen Wujiu wrote the character for wind on the practice board, and at once the candle flames leaned sideways. 'A spoken formula gains power from *speed*,' he told me. 'Say it too slowly and the spirit fades. Say it right and the air obeys.' Outside, a cloud passed the window in an instant.
speed:0.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，念诵咒文时____的快慢会影响灵力的强弱。
speed:0.hook: Then the candle went out, though no wind had touched it.
speed:0.line: 'The true power of any formula comes from its *speed*.'

burden:0.en: I carried the stack of word-scrolls up the stone steps alone. Each one was light, but together they were a heavy *burden* across my arms. Xiaoxing met me at the landing and took half without a word. The mountain fog shifted, and for a moment I saw a second peak I had never noticed before.
burden:0.cnHint: 我独自搬运卷轴时感到不堪重____，师妹赶来默默帮我分担。
burden:0.hook: The second peak vanished the moment I blinked.
burden:0.line: 'Let me help — that many scrolls is too great a *burden* alone.'

former:0.en: Master Qingwu placed two scrolls on the low table. The *former* was written in faded silver ink; the latter shone like fresh rain. 'Read both,' she said, 'and tell me which one still holds living breath.' I pressed my fingertip to the silver words and felt a cold pulse that surprised me.
former:0.cnHint: 师尊让我比较两卷经文，____那卷字迹暗淡，却仍有奇异的气息。
former:0.hook: The silver pulse came again, steady as a heartbeat.
former:0.line: 'The *former* scroll may look faded, but feel its breath carefully.'

oppose:0.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the center of the practice room and told me to say a word that would *oppose* the flame he had raised. 'Every force has its answer,' he said. I thought of the word for still water and spoke it softly. The flame bent, shivered, then held. He nodded once.
oppose:0.cnHint: 师兄让我念出能____火焰的字诀，我鼓起勇气轻声说出了那个词。
oppose:0.hook: The flame held, but its color had changed to pale blue.
oppose:0.line: 'Find the word that can *oppose* this flame, and speak it without fear.'

unable:0.en: I sat before the open scroll for one full hour, yet I was *unable* to read the third line. The characters seemed to shift each time my eyes settled. Master Qingwu passed behind me and said nothing, only set a small cup of warm tea beside my hand. Steam rose and curled into a shape like a bird.
unable:0.cnHint: 我对着卷轴苦读一个时辰，却____看清第三行字，师尊悄然为我送来热茶。
unable:0.hook: When the steam cleared, the bird shape was gone but the third line had changed.
unable:0.line: 'If you are *unable* to read it now, let your mind rest and return.'

unusual:0.en: Xiaoxing pointed to the moss growing along the inner wall of the study hall. 'This color is *unusual*,' she said, crouching low. The moss was a pale gold rather than green, and it grew only where certain word-scrolls had been stored for years. Master Qingwu heard us and paused at the doorway.
unusual:0.cnHint: 师妹发现书室墙壁上长了颜色____的苔藓，引起了师尊的注意。
unusual:0.hook: Master Qingwu's expression shifted, and she turned back without speaking.
unusual:0.line: 'The gold color of this moss is truly *unusual* — it should not grow here.'

apart:0.en: The two writing desks in the study hall stood far *apart*, one near the east window and one against the west wall. Shen Wujiu told me the distance was not by chance. 'Some words must not hear each other,' he said, setting a fire-scroll on the east desk. I placed a water-scroll on the west.
apart:0.cnHint: 书室里的两张书案相距甚____，师兄说这是为了防止某些字诀相互干扰。
apart:0.hook: As soon as both scrolls were open, a low hum rose from the floor.
apart:0.line: 'Keep those two scrolls far *apart* — they must not sense each other.'

character:0.en: Master Qingwu set a fresh sheet of paper before me and said nothing. The task was to press a single seal into the page — one mark that would reveal my *character* to the sect. I breathed slowly, let the brush fall, and a sharp mountain peak appeared in black ink. Xiaoxing leaned over my shoulder and smiled without a word.
character:0.cnHint: 师尊让我用印章在纸上留下一个印记，以显示我的____。
character:0.hook: The ink dried, but the peak slowly began to crack.
character:0.line: 'Your *character* is already written in the way you hold the brush.'

clean:0.en: Each morning before sunrise, Xiaoxing and I would *clean* the Hall of Gathered Words together, sweeping spiritual dust from every shelf of jade tablets. The act was not punishment — Master Qingwu called it the first lesson: a clear space invites clear thought. Today, however, one shelf held a tablet none of us had placed there.
clean:0.cnHint: 每天清晨，我和小星____大殿，师尊说这是第一课。
clean:0.hook: The strange tablet hummed once, then fell silent.
clean:0.line: 'We *clean* this hall so the words inside stay honest.'

convey:0.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a folded leaf sealed with morning dew — a message from the outer peak. 'Read the pattern, not the words,' he said. I held it to the light and let the veins *convey* their meaning: danger, water, three days. I looked up, but Shen Wujiu was already walking away.
convey:0.cnHint: 我通过叶脉的纹路来____来自外峰的警告信息。
convey:0.hook: Outside, the clouds below the mountain turned the colour of iron.
convey:0.line: 'Let the silence *convey* what words cannot hold.'

distraction:0.en: The copying room was quiet except for the scratch of brushes on stone paper. Master Qingwu had warned us: one *distraction* during the hour of deep copying could unravel a whole week of progress. I kept my eyes on the formula before me — yet a soft sound, like a bell struck underwater, drifted through the wall.
distraction:0.cnHint: 师尊警告我们，抄写时一点点____都可能让一周的功夫付之东流。
distraction:0.hook: The sound came again, closer, and my brush hand trembled.
distraction:0.line: 'A single *distraction* is all a formula needs to turn on you.'

fight:0.en: In the reading alcove, Shen Wujiu spread three word-scrolls before me and spoke quietly. 'Learning a healing word takes patience,' he said, 'but mastering a storm word takes *fight* — a will that does not soften when the syllables push back.' I pressed my hand flat on the table and promised myself I would not soften.
fight:0.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，掌握风暴字诀需要____，一种不会软化的意志。
fight:0.hook: The storm scroll's edge began to curl upward on its own.
fight:0.line: 'You have the *fight* in you — I heard it in your voice just now.'

finish:0.en: The hour-candle had burned to its last mark, yet I had not reached the final line of the entry formula. Master Qingwu stood at the doorway, arms folded, eyes calm. 'A practitioner who cannot *finish* what they begin leaves a door open in the spirit,' she said. I dipped the brush and wrote the last stroke as the candle went out.
finish:0.cnHint: 师尊说，一个无法____所开始之事的修行者，会在灵魂中留下一扇敞开的门。
finish:0.hook: In the sudden dark, the characters I had written glowed faint gold.
finish:0.line: '*Finish* the line — the formula is only alive when it is whole.'

frequently:0.en: Shen Wujiu told me that Master Qingwu *frequently* spent the deep hours of night in the archive room, reading texts so old the ink had turned silver. No one interrupted her there. But tonight, when I passed the archive door on my way back from the water basin, light leaked from beneath it — and the door stood open by a hand's width.
frequently:0.cnHint: 师兄说师尊____在深夜独自待在藏经室，但今晚那扇门竟然开着。
frequently:0.hook: A shadow moved across the stripe of light and did not return.
frequently:0.line: 'She *frequently* reads through the night — tonight feels different, though.'
