invest:0.en: 'Every word you memorise is seed grain,' Shen Wujiu told me as we sat beside the inner lamp. 'You must *invest* your full attention in each one, or it stays hollow.' I repeated the word for rising wind seven times until I felt it stir the air above my palm. A loose page lifted from the desk and drifted to the floor.
invest:0.cnHint: 师兄说要把全部注意力____在每个字诀上，否则它就只是空壳。
invest:0.hook: The page landed face-down, and when I turned it over, it was blank.
invest:0.line: '*Invest* your breath in the word — only then will it breathe back.'

moment:0.en: Master Qingwu set the ancient scroll before me and said nothing. I held the word 'ascend' in my mind, feeling its roots spread like warmth through my chest. Then, in one brief *moment*, the character lifted off the page and hung in the air, glowing pale green. The room fell completely still.
moment:0.cnHint: 在那个关键的____里，古老文字从卷轴上飘起，悬浮于空中。
moment:0.hook: A second glow answered it from deep within the wall.
moment:0.line: 'That *moment* of stillness is where all true cultivation begins,' said Master Qingwu.

nice:0.en: Shen Wujiu watched me copy the healing formula for the third time. 'The brushwork is close,' he said, 'but a *nice* balance between pressure and release is what actually carries the spiritual force.' I pressed lighter on the next stroke. The ink shimmered faintly, and the page grew warm beneath my palm.
nice:0.cnHint: 师兄指出，书写治愈符文时需要____的力道拿捏，才能传递灵力。
nice:0.hook: Outside, the wind stopped as though the mountain itself was listening.
nice:0.line: 'A *nice* balance of breath and brushstroke will make the word come alive,' Shen Wujiu said.

peer:0.en: Xiaoxing held her lantern close to the old herb shelf, trying to read the tiny labels Master Qingwu had written in fading ink. I watched her *peer* at each jar, her nose nearly touching the glass. 'This one,' she said softly, lifting a sealed bottle. The dried leaves inside began to glow without any flame.
peer:0.cnHint: 师妹凑近书架，____着那些装满灵草的小瓶，想辨认褪色的标签。
peer:0.hook: The glow spread to every jar on the shelf at once.
peer:0.line: 'I have to *peer* at the label — the ink has almost faded away,' Xiaoxing said.

pretty:0.en: After my first successful word-weaving, Master Qingwu placed a small carved token in my hand. Its surface was smooth and the lines on it formed a cloud pattern. It was a *pretty*, a simple carved piece, yet it held the sect's oldest seal of welcome. I closed my fingers around it and felt the warmth travel up my arm.
pretty:0.cnHint: 师尊赠予我一枚小巧的____，那是宗门最古老的欢迎信物。
pretty:0.hook: The seal on the token pulsed once, then went dark.
pretty:0.line: 'This *pretty* carries the blessing of every master who came before you,' said Master Qingwu.

recommendation:0.en: Before choosing which word-path to study, I asked Shen Wujiu for advice. He thought for a long time, then placed his hand on the scroll of wind words. 'My *recommendation* is the path of breath and motion,' he said. 'It suits the way you already listen.' I opened the scroll, and the first character rose to greet me.
recommendation:0.cnHint: 师兄给出了关于修炼路径的____，认为"风息"之道最适合我。
recommendation:0.hook: The character in the scroll then turned, as if reading me in return.
recommendation:0.line: 'My *recommendation* is to begin with the lightest word and work toward the heaviest,' said Shen Wujiu.

strange:0.en: I woke before dawn to a *strange* sound — not wind, not water, but something like a word being spoken very slowly by no one in the room. I lit my small lamp and checked the practice scrolls on my desk. One of them had unrolled itself in the night and lay open to a character I had not yet studied. The ink on it was still wet.
strange:0.cnHint: 我在黎明前被一种____的声音惊醒，发现案上卷轴已自行展开。
strange:0.hook: The wet ink moved, tracing a second character beside the first.
strange:0.line: 'A *strange* sound from the scroll room always means a word has chosen its reader,' Master Qingwu said.

widespread:0.en: Shen Wujiu explained that the art of word-weaving was once hidden but had become *widespread* across the floating mountains, taught in every sect from the lowest stone shelf to the highest peak. 'That is both a gift and a warning,' he said quietly. He closed the history book and looked out at the clouds below us for a long time.
widespread:0.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，文字编织之术如今已____流传于各座浮山宗门之中。
widespread:0.hook: Far below, a cloud formation shifted into the shape of a hand.
widespread:0.line: 'When a skill becomes *widespread*, it is also easier for it to be misused,' Shen Wujiu said.

wonderful:0.en: At the end of the week's lessons, Xiaoxing pressed a single dried petal into my hand. She had woven the word 'bloom' into it herself. It was a *wonderful* thing — small, quiet, yet alive with stored intent. When I breathed on it, the petal opened fully and held its shape, as though spring had agreed to pause right there in my palm.
wonderful:0.cnHint: 师妹送我一枚亲手编织了"绽放"之字的花瓣，那是一件____的礼物。
wonderful:0.hook: At midnight, every candle in the hall lit itself without being touched.
wonderful:0.line: 'Is it not *wonderful* that a single word, held with care, can make something bloom?' Xiaoxing said.

announce:0.en: The great bell of the Cloud Sea Sect rang three times. Master Qingwu stepped onto the stone platform and raised one hand for silence. 'I *announce* a new trial,' she said, her voice carrying across the mist like a struck chord. Every disciple bowed. I felt my chest tighten with something between pride and dread.
announce:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊在石台上____了一项新的考验，所有弟子都低下了头。
announce:0.hook: On the wall behind her, a character no one recognised began to glow.
announce:0.line: 'I *announce* a trial that will change every disciple here.'

appropriate:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread three scrolls on the low table and studied them in silence. At last he tapped the middle one. 'This formula is *appropriate* for your level,' he said. 'The others would burn your meridians before dawn.' I reached for the scroll with steady hands, grateful and a little afraid.
appropriate:0.cnHint: 师兄仔细比较了三份卷轴，认为中间那份对我来说最____。
appropriate:0.hook: As I unrolled it, the ink shifted like dark water seeking a way out.
appropriate:0.line: 'This one is *appropriate* for you — the others are far too strong.'

chief:0.en: Master Qingwu named Shen Wujiu the *chief* guardian of the inner archive, where words of flight were stored like sleeping birds. His face showed no surprise, only a quiet gravity. I stood at the back of the hall and watched the silk ribbon of office settle around his shoulders like a second sky.
chief:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊任命师兄为内藏阁的____守卫者，那里存放着飞升的字诀。
chief:0.hook: That night the archive door opened on its own, just once, and closed again.
chief:0.line: 'As *chief* guardian, I am responsible for every word held inside.'

clearly:0.en: The lantern above the study table burned low, but the character Master Qingwu had drawn still glowed on the paper. I could *clearly* see its four strokes forming something like a wing, something like a root. Xiaoxing leaned close beside me and whispered that she had been trying to read it for an hour and still could not.
clearly:0.cnHint: 灯光昏暗，但师尊写下的那个字仍然____地浮现在纸上。
clearly:0.hook: When Xiaoxing touched the edge of the paper, the wing-stroke trembled.
clearly:0.line: 'I can *clearly* see the shape, but I still cannot feel its meaning.'

communicate:0.en: In the Cloud Sea Sect, disciples do not shout across the floating peaks. They learn to *communicate* through written words released into the wind, which carry meaning the way seeds carry life. Xiaoxing showed me how to fold the paper just so. The character I sent reached Shen Wujiu on the far ridge in the time it takes to breathe twice.
communicate:0.cnHint: 在云海宗，弟子们用放飞的文字来____，小星师妹教会了我这个方法。
communicate:0.hook: My message arrived, but a second paper — unwritten — followed it back.
communicate:0.line: 'We *communicate* with words of wind; silence here can be a warning.'

emphasis:0.en: Master Qingwu read the formula aloud twice. The second time she placed *emphasis* on the final character, stretching it until the candle flame leaned toward her lips. 'That pause,' she said, 'is where the word breathes. Miss it and the herb becomes a stone.' I wrote the timing into my notes with a shaking hand.
emphasis:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊第二次诵读时，将____放在最后一个字上，那一刻烛火都向她倾斜。
emphasis:0.hook: Somewhere below the mountain, a bell rang that no one had rung.
emphasis:0.line: 'The *emphasis* falls on the last stroke — that is where the power lives.'

emphasize:0.en: Shen Wujiu paused at the threshold of the practice room and turned back to me. 'I want to *emphasize* one thing,' he said quietly. 'Never speak a flying word above the cloud line without grounding yourself first.' He said nothing more, but his eyes moved once toward the edge of the cliff and then back. I understood.
emphasize:0.cnHint: 师兄离开前特意回头，向我____了一件事：飞升字诀绝不能在云层之上随意开口。
emphasize:0.hook: Below the cliff, a shape moved slowly through the white clouds, then was gone.
emphasize:0.line: 'I must *emphasize* this: ground yourself before you ever speak that word.'

england:0.en: In the archive room, shelves held records of every language that had ever named a herb. Shen Wujiu pointed to a faded page where healers from a distant island — a place the old texts called *England* — had once written their own word for breath-root. 'Every tongue reaches for the same truth,' he said. I copied the foreign letters carefully beside our own.
england:0.cnHint: 内藏阁中保存着各地的草药古籍，其中一页来自远方岛国____的医者手稿。
england:0.hook: Beneath the foreign letters, a faint drawing showed a cloud shaped exactly like our mountain.
england:0.line: 'This page came from *England*; even there, they sought words that could heal.'

male:0.en: The inner hall held twelve carved figures — six *male*, six female — each posed mid-step, arms raised toward the ceiling. Master Qingwu said these forms mapped the two rivers of spiritual breath inside every body. I traced the raised stone hand of the nearest figure and felt a faint hum travel up my fingers.
male:0.cnHint: 内殿中，师尊讲解十二尊石像所代表的灵气双脉，我触摸____像时感到一阵震颤。
male:0.hook: The hum did not stop when I pulled my hand away.
male:0.line: 'A *male* channel and a female channel must flow as one,' said Master Qingwu.

fish:0.en: Xiaoxing kept a clay bowl on her windowsill with a single silver *fish* inside. She called it her living compass — when the fish turned its nose toward the east wall, she said, a storm word was forming somewhere beyond the clouds. I leaned over the bowl and the fish went perfectly still.
fish:0.cnHint: 小星养了一条银色的____作为天气罗盘，我凑近鱼缸时它突然停止不动。
fish:0.hook: Then it turned, slowly, toward my face instead of the wall.
fish:0.line: 'Watch the *fish* — it knows before we do,' Xiaoxing whispered.

fashion:0.en: Shen Wujiu wrapped every scroll in a careful *fashion*: left edge folded first, then right, then a loop of blue cord with exactly three winds. He said the order was not tradition but intention — careless wrapping loosened the word inside. I tried to copy him and the cord slipped from my hands.
fashion:0.cnHint: 师兄以特定的____整理每一卷经文，我模仿时绳子却从手中滑落。
fashion:0.hook: The scroll landed open, and a single word glowed on the page.
fashion:0.line: 'Do it in this *fashion* every time, or the word will forget itself,' said Shen Wujiu.

weather:0.en: Master Qingwu kept a narrow board on the east wall covered in tiny ink marks. Each mark recorded the *weather* above the clouds on a past day — wind direction, the weight of moisture, the color of the light. She said a skilled disciple could read those marks and predict which word-herbs would ripen next.
weather:0.cnHint: 师尊在东墙上用墨点记录云上的____变化，以此预测哪些字药将要成熟。
weather:0.hook: Today's column was empty, and her brush lay dry on the floor.
weather:0.line: 'The *weather* above the clouds has its own language,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

device:0.en: On the central table sat a brass *device* no larger than my fist: two rings that could spin inside each other, with a hollow at the center where a spoken word would rest and be measured. Shen Wujiu said it judged the purity of a word-herb before you swallowed it. I wondered what it would say about mine.
device:0.cnHint: 桌上有一件黄铜____，可以测量字药的纯度，我想知道它对我的字会如何评判。
device:0.hook: When I set my word inside the rings, neither ring moved at all.
device:0.line: 'Place the herb in the *device* and wait for the inner ring to still,' Shen Wujiu told me.

farm:0.en: The old map on the back wall showed what the mountain had looked like before it rose — a small *farm* with a well and three terraced fields. Master Qingwu said the first sect founder had planted word-seeds in that soil long ago, and the roots still ran deep inside the stone beneath our feet.
farm:0.cnHint: 旧地图上显示此山升起前曾是一座____，师尊说始祖在那里播下的字根至今仍在石中延伸。
farm:0.hook: Under my sandal, the floor gave a sound like something growing.
farm:0.line: 'This mountain was once a *farm*,' Master Qingwu said, 'and it remembers.'

drug:0.en: The blue powder in the sealed jar was not poison — it was a study *drug*, Xiaoxing explained, ground from a word-herb that sharpened memory for exactly one hour. Disciples used it only before the hardest recitations. She pressed the jar into my hands, but her eyes held a small, careful warning.
drug:0.cnHint: 小星递给我一瓶蓝色粉末，解释说这是一种帮助记忆的____，但她的眼神带着隐隐的告诫。
drug:0.hook: The seal on the jar was already cracked along one edge.
drug:0.line: 'One pinch of this *drug* is enough — more and the words start speaking back,' said Xiaoxing.

heat:0.en: The ink used for word-formulas had to be prepared with care: too much *heat* under the stone grinder and the characters would crack when dry, losing their meaning before they could be read. I had rushed the grinding that morning. By evening, every line I had written had split down the center like dry earth.
heat:0.cnHint: 研磨字符用墨时____过高会使字迹开裂失意，我当天草率操作，到傍晚所有墨迹都裂开了。
heat:0.hook: In the last split line, a shape appeared that I had not written.
heat:0.line: 'Keep the *heat* low and steady, or the word will break before it breathes,' Shen Wujiu warned.

intelligence:0.en: Master Qingwu set a bowl of still water before me. 'Still your mind,' she said. Each word-herb I had learned rose in the water like a glowing fish. She called this exercise a test of *intelligence* — not how many words I held, but how clearly I could read their meaning beneath the surface. I passed. Outside, the clouds below our mountain began to spin.
intelligence:0.cnHint: 师尊用一碗静水测试我的____，看我能否看清每株字草的真正含义。
intelligence:0.hook: The spinning clouds below had not moved in a hundred years.
intelligence:0.line: 'True *intelligence* is reading what the word does not say.'

uk:0.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled an old scroll of word-herbs gathered from distant lands. He pointed to a cluster marked with a cold, grey seal. 'These came from the far island sect, the *UK* branch,' he said quietly, 'their formulas bind fog to stone.' I touched one; my fingers went numb. The seal pulsed once, then went dark.
uk:0.cnHint: 师兄展示了来自远方*___*分支的字草，它们据说能将雾凝固成石头。
uk:0.hook: The dark seal pulsed again, though no one had touched it.
uk:0.line: 'The *UK* branch seals their herbs so only cold hands can hold them.'

user:0.en: Each new disciple is called a *user* of the sect's word-garden — not yet a keeper, not yet a master, only someone learning to take without harming. Xiaoxing showed me how to pluck a single leaf of the 'calm' herb without breaking the root. Her hands were steady. Mine shook. A single black petal fell to the floor.
user:0.cnHint: 每位新弟子都被称为字草园的____，小星向我展示了如何采摘而不伤根。
user:0.hook: The black petal on the floor slowly rose into the air.
user:0.line: 'A *user* of the garden must give thanks before they take.'

park:0.en: At the centre of our floating mountain there is a small word-garden we call the still *park* — rows of living characters rooted in pale soil, each one humming softly. I walked its paths alone at dusk, repeating each name under my breath. The hum grew louder with every word I spoke correctly. Then, on my third round, it stopped.
park:0.cnHint: 浮山中央有一座宁静的字草____，我独自在黄昏时沿小径行走，低声复诵每株字草的名字。
park:0.hook: The sudden silence pressed against my ears like deep water.
park:0.line: 'Walk the *park* at dusk — the herbs remember who speaks their names.'

reward:0.en: Master Qingwu placed a small jade vial on the stone table between us. 'This is your *reward*,' she said, 'for learning the full set of wind-formulas in three days instead of ten.' Inside the vial a tiny silver word floated — one I had never seen. She told me to wait until dawn to open it. The vial grew warm in my palm all night.
reward:0.cnHint: 师尊将一个玉瓶作为____赐给我，因为我提前完成了全套风咒的学习。
reward:0.hook: At midnight the vial's warmth became a sharp and sudden cold.
reward:0.line: 'Accept this *reward* — but do not open it before the mountain wakes.'

credit:0.en: Shen Wujiu recorded each word-herb I had mastered in a thin bamboo book. 'Every entry here is *credit* toward your first flight trial,' he told me with a calm smile. I had forty-three entries. I needed fifty. He closed the book and set it on the shelf, and I noticed the last page was already filled with a name I could not read.
credit:0.cnHint: 师兄将我掌握的每株字草记入竹册，积累足够的____才能参加初次飞升考核。
credit:0.hook: The unreadable name on the last page shimmered, then changed.
credit:0.line: 'Each herb you master adds one line of *credit* to your trial record.'

progress:0.en: Every morning I stand before the word-wall and speak the formulas aloud, watching my breath take shape in the cold air. Master Qingwu watches from her chair without speaking. Today she finally rose, walked to my side, and said, 'You *progress* faster than the mountain expected.' Then she returned to her seat and closed her eyes. On the wall, one character began to glow on its own.
progress:0.cnHint: 每天清晨我站在字墙前背诵咒文，今天师尊终于开口说我____的速度超出了浮山的预期。
progress:0.hook: The self-lit character on the wall had no name in any scroll.
progress:0.line: 'You *progress* well — but the mountain will test you, not me.'

snack:0.en: Between study hours Xiaoxing brought me a small plate — dried cloud-pear and two seed cakes, the kind the sect calls a *snack* between dawn practice and the midday lesson. 'Eat,' she said simply, 'a hungry disciple misreads every herb.' The seed cake dissolved on my tongue with a faint taste of the word for 'light.' Through the window, a shadow crossed the sun.
snack:0.cnHint: 小星在早课和午课之间给我带来了一份____，说饥饿的弟子会误读每一株字草。
snack:0.hook: The shadow that crossed the sun had the shape of an open hand.
snack:0.line: 'Have a *snack* — you will need clear eyes for the afternoon trial.'

extreme:0.en: The inner hall smelled of dried cloud-moss and old ink. Master Qingwu set a single character before me, brushed in black so dense it seemed to pull the candlelight inward. 'This word carries *extreme* heat,' she said. 'Write it wrong and the paper burns. Write it right and the room warms like summer.' I pressed my brush down. The paper did not burn. But every candle in the hall flared at once.
extreme:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊警告我，这个词语蕴含____的热力，我鼓起勇气落笔，烛火骤然全部腾起。
extreme:0.hook: In the corner, the ink stone cracked clean in two.
extreme:0.line: 'This word carries *extreme* heat — one wrong stroke and you will feel it.'

style:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread three scrolls across the study floor, each written by a different elder. 'Notice the *style* of each hand,' he said. 'The curve here is like wind; the slash there is like a falling stone. A disciple's writing carries their spirit.' I copied all three and felt three different temperatures rise from the paper. Mine, when I tried alone, felt like nothing at all — yet.
style:0.cnHint: 师兄让我观察三位长老各自不同的书写____，我临摹之后感受到了三种截然不同的灵气温度。
style:0.hook: My own brushstroke left a faint silver mark no one could explain.
style:0.line: 'The *style* of your hand will one day carry your own spirit.'

color:0.en: Xiaoxing held a small lantern over the word I had just traced on rice paper. 'Watch the *color*,' she whispered. The black ink slowly shifted — first grey, then a pale gold at the edges. 'Each word shows its meaning in light if you believe it enough,' she said. I stared until my eyes ached. The gold held. Outside the window, the clouds below our mountain turned the same shade.
color:0.cnHint: 师妹让我观察墨迹的____变化，字的颜色悄然转为淡金，窗外云海也随之染上了相同的色泽。
color:0.hook: Then a shadow crossed the gold, and the paper went cold.
color:0.line: 'Watch the *color* of the ink — it will tell you if the word is alive.'

meeting:0.en: The *meeting* was held in the round stone room at the peak's heart, where the ceiling was open to the sky. All five senior disciples sat in silence as Master Qingwu placed a new word on the altar. No one spoke its sound aloud. I was allowed to sit in the outer ring, barely breathing, watching the word glow faintly blue. When it faded, Master Qingwu looked straight at me.
meeting:0.cnHint: 这场____在山顶石室举行，青雾师尊将一个新词置于祭坛，词语发出淡蓝色的光，消散后师尊目光直落在我身上。
meeting:0.hook: The word on the altar had changed shape when no one was looking.
meeting:0.line: 'This *meeting* will decide which word each of you will carry for the year.'

volunteer:0.en: Master Qingwu asked who would read the untested word aloud first. The room was still. Then Xiaoxing rose — a quiet, steady motion. 'I will *volunteer*,' she said, and walked to the altar without hurry. Her voice, when she spoke the word, was even and clear. The air shivered. Nothing broke. But the candle flames all leaned toward her, as if listening.
volunteer:0.cnHint: 师尊询问谁愿意第一个诵读未经测试的词语，小星站起来说自己____，烛火随之全部朝她倾斜。
volunteer:0.hook: A faint hum rose from the floorboards and did not stop.
volunteer:0.line: 'I will *volunteer* — someone has to go first, and I am not afraid.'

deliver:0.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a folded paper sealed with cloud-wax. 'You must *deliver* this word-scroll to the east library before the morning bell,' he said. The scroll felt warm, almost alive. I crossed three rope bridges above the cloud sea alone, lantern swinging. I placed it in the archivist's hands just as the bell rang. She unrolled it, read one line, and went very quiet.
deliver:0.cnHint: 师兄要我在晨钟响前将一份词卷____到东藏书阁，我独自穿越云海上方的三座绳桥，将其交到档案师手中。
deliver:0.hook: The archivist's brush, untouched, began writing on its own.
deliver:0.line: '*Deliver* this scroll before dawn — do not let it cool or the words will fade.'

engineering:0.en: The older disciples called it word-*engineering* — the precise art of combining two spiritual terms to build a third. Master Qingwu drew the process on a slate: root word, bridge stroke, result. 'It is not poetry,' she said. 'It is structure.' I tried three combinations. Two produced smoke. The third held its shape in the air for three full breaths before dissolving into a single point of light.
engineering:0.cnHint: 将两个灵词精准组合以构建第三个词语，师尊称之为词语____，我尝试了三种组合，第三种在空中维持了三次呼吸后化为一点光芒。
engineering:0.hook: That point of light drifted upward and did not come back down.
engineering:0.line: 'Word-*engineering* is not art — it is structure, and structure does not forgive mistakes.'

tiny:0.en: After an hour of practice my written characters were still rough, but Xiaoxing pointed to one corner of my page. 'There — that *tiny* stroke,' she said. 'It curves the right way.' I looked hard. It was no wider than a hair, easy to miss. But when she held the lantern close, that one small line glowed steady while everything around it stayed dark. She said nothing more. Neither did I.
tiny:0.cnHint: 练习了许久后，小星指出我页面一角那一笔____的笔画曲度正确，在灯光下，唯独那一细线稳稳发光。
tiny:0.hook: By morning, that single glowing stroke had spread to the edge of the page.
tiny:0.line: 'That *tiny* stroke — it is the only one on this page that is truly alive.'

retire:0.en: The hall grew quiet as the last candle dimmed. Master Qingwu set down her brush and said it was time to *retire* for the night, urging every disciple to rest their spirit before dawn practice. I rolled my mat near the window and listened to the wind move through the bamboo outside. Sleep came slowly.
retire:0.cnHint: 师尊放下笔，告诉弟子们该____了，明日黎明前还有功课。
retire:0.hook: Somewhere below the clouds, a bell rang — at an hour when no bell should.
retire:0.line: 'It is time to *retire*; a tired mind cannot hold a single word of power.'

sea:0.en: Master Qingwu led us to the outer ledge of the mountain and told us to look down. Beneath the stone, a vast *sea* of white cloud stretched in every direction, hiding the world below. 'Each word you learn,' she said, 'is a boat on that water.' I gripped the railing and said nothing.
sea:0.cnHint: 师尊带我们俯瞰山下，那片云____向四面无边延伸。
sea:0.hook: Then a dark shape rose slowly through the clouds — far too large to be a bird.
sea:0.line: 'The *sea* of clouds below us holds every secret the Sect has ever buried.'

town:0.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled an old map on the study table and pointed to a mark near the mountain's base. 'There was once a *town* there,' he said quietly, 'before the clouds rose and covered it.' I leaned in close. The ink was faded, but I could read the name — two characters I had never seen in any lesson.
town:0.cnHint: 师兄指着地图上的一处，说云层下曾有一座____。
town:0.hook: The two characters on the map began to glow with a cold, pale light.
town:0.line: 'That *town* vanished in a single night, and no one in the Sect will say why.'

gap:0.en: Xiaoxing showed me how she copied the healing formula. Her brushwork was nearly perfect, but Master Qingwu circled one line and said there was a *gap* in her understanding of the third character. 'A gap this small,' she warned, 'can turn medicine into poison.' Xiaoxing bowed her head. I quietly checked my own copy.
gap:0.cnHint: 师父圈出小星习字中的一处____，提醒她差之毫厘便会出错。
gap:0.hook: When Xiaoxing lifted her brush again, the ink on the page moved on its own.
gap:0.line: 'A single *gap* in your form is enough for a storm word to turn on you.'

generation:0.en: The scroll on the wall listed every head disciple of the Cloud Sea Sect, going back farther than I could count. Shen Wujiu said that in each *generation*, only one person had ever learned the word for flight before their third year. He looked at me sideways when he said it. I pretended not to notice.
generation:0.cnHint: 师兄说每____之中，只有一位弟子能在三年内学会飞行之字。
generation:0.hook: My name, which I had not written anywhere, appeared at the bottom of the scroll.
generation:0.line: 'Every *generation* leaves one word unfinished — and it is always the same word.'

guide:0.en: When I lost the path back from the eastern terrace, it was Xiaoxing who found me. She held up a small lantern and said that in the Cloud Sea Sect, a senior disciple must always *guide* a new one home on the first night. The light was warm. I followed without a word and did not look at the drop below.
guide:0.cnHint: 小星说，按门规，师姐必须在入门第一夜____新弟子回房。
guide:0.hook: At the door of the hall, the lantern went out — and we were not alone.
guide:0.line: 'Let me *guide* you tonight; these paths look different once the cloud rises.'

household:0.en: Master Qingwu asked each of us to name the word our family used most. Some said 'harvest,' some said 'scholar.' I said my *household* had only one word above all others: 'endure.' She was quiet a long moment before she nodded and wrote it on the board. The other disciples did not laugh.
household:0.cnHint: 师尊让每人说出家中最常用的一个字，我说我们____最重视的是"忍"。
household:0.hook: The word on the board began to crack like ice under too much weight.
household:0.line: 'In my *household*, we spoke words of endurance before words of power.'

luxury:0.en: Shen Wujiu watched me scrub the stone floor of the herb room late into the night. 'You think rest is a *luxury*,' he said, almost gently. 'So did I, once.' He set a warm cup of plain water beside my brush and left without another word. I finished the floor and sat still for a moment, grateful.
luxury:0.cnHint: 师兄说我把休息当成____，就像他当年一样。
luxury:0.hook: In the silence after he left, I heard my own name spoken — from inside the wall.
luxury:0.line: 'Rest is not a *luxury* here — it is how you keep your words from going dark.'

analysis:0.en: Inside the Hall of Scrolls, I spread the herb charts across the stone floor. Master Qingwu watched as I traced each vein of energy. 'Your *analysis* is correct,' she said quietly. 'The fifth root feeds the flame, not the wind.' The candles above us flickered without cause.
analysis:0.cnHint: 在藏卷堂内，我对灵草图纹进行____，师尊低声给予肯定。
analysis:0.hook: Yet the fifth root had not been touched in a hundred years.
analysis:0.line: 'Your *analysis* of the root's flow is correct, disciple.'

application:0.en: Shen Wujiu helped me press my palm print onto the bamboo form. 'This *application* is your only path to the upper peak,' he said, rolling it carefully. The ink dried fast, leaving a faint glow where my fingers had rested. Outside, wind moved through the corridor like a held breath.
application:0.cnHint: 师兄协助我填写申请飞升上峰的____，墨迹干后竟泛出微光。
application:0.hook: The glow should not have appeared on ordinary bamboo.
application:0.line: 'This *application* decides whether you rise or stay below.'

living:0.en: Xiaoxing and I sat beside the warming stove, counting the spirit stones we had earned that month. 'A *living* on this mountain is thin,' she said with a small smile, 'but the sky above it is wide.' She pressed two extra stones into my hand before turning back to her herbs.
living:0.cnHint: 晓星与我在火炉旁盘点灵石，感慨山上____不易却天地开阔。
living:0.hook: One of the stones bore a crack that had not been there before.
living:0.line: 'A *living* here is small, but the sky more than repays it.'

proposal:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long scroll on the teaching desk and smoothed its edges with two fingers. 'This *proposal* asks the elders to open a new path of ascent for inner disciples,' she said. Every word on the scroll seemed to breathe. I felt the room grow still, as if the mountain itself was listening.
proposal:0.cnHint: 师尊在授课桌上展开卷轴，宣读一份关于飞升新路的____。
proposal:0.hook: The scroll's final seal had already been broken by someone else.
proposal:0.line: 'Read this *proposal* carefully; it may change your entire path.'

relevant:0.en: Shen Wujiu pulled three old texts from the shelf and set them before me. 'Only this one is *relevant* to the rite you seek,' he said, tapping the thinnest volume. The other two crumbled at the edges when touched. A dry, sweet smell rose from the pages, like lightning before a storm.
relevant:0.cnHint: 师兄从书架取来旧典，指出其中只有一册与我寻求的仪轨____。
relevant:0.hook: The thin volume had no author's name anywhere inside.
relevant:0.line: 'Only this passage is *relevant* to the ascent rite you need.'

senior:0.en: A *senior* disciple I did not recognise stood at the door of the preparation chamber, arms folded. He said nothing, only studied my face as though reading a formula. Xiaoxing whispered that he had failed the ascent trial twice. The lamp between us cast two shadows but lit neither of us clearly.
senior:0.cnHint: 一位我不认识的____师兄守在备关室门口，默默打量着我。
senior:0.hook: His sleeve bore a symbol that no current rank should carry.
senior:0.line: 'As your *senior*, I tell you: the trial is never what it seems.'

table:0.en: The night before the rite, I laid every spirit tool on the low wooden *table* by the window and counted them one by one. Master Qingwu had said order was itself a form of power. When I finished, one tool stood slightly apart from the rest, though I had placed them all in a line.
table:0.cnHint: 仪式前夜，我将所有灵器整齐排列在窗边的____上逐一清点。
table:0.hook: The separated tool was the one Master Qingwu had never explained.
table:0.line: 'Clear the *table* and lay your tools out before the rite begins.'

campus:0.en: I walked the inner *campus* of the Cloud Sea Sect one last time before dawn, stepping along the stone paths between the herb gardens and the flame towers. Each building held a memory too heavy to carry upward. Xiaoxing watched from the bridge above, silent, her lantern swaying in the still air.
campus:0.cnHint: 黎明前，我最后一次走遍云海宗的____，每一处都留有难以割舍的记忆。
campus:0.hook: The lantern's flame bent toward the peak, not with the wind.
campus:0.line: 'Walk the *campus* once more; you may not see it from above.'

immediately:0.en: Inside the Pill Chamber, Master Qingwu placed a single silver herb on the stone desk. She said nothing. I understood *immediately*: touch it wrong and the formula would scatter like smoke. My fingers hovered, trembling, until the herb glowed faint gold — a sign that the lesson had only just begun.
immediately:0.cnHint: 师尊将一株银草放在石案上，我____明白了她的意思。
immediately:0.hook: The herb's glow flickered once, then went cold.
immediately:0.line: '*Immediately* still your breath, or the formula will break.'

improvement:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread my practice scrolls across the low table and studied each one in silence. 'There is *improvement*,' he said at last, tapping a formula near the edge. 'But the third stroke still bleeds spirit outward.' Outside, wind moved through the bamboo, and a single leaf fell upward into the clouds.
improvement:0.cnHint: 师兄检查我的练习卷轴，说我的功法有了____。
improvement:0.hook: The leaf that rose upward never came back down.
improvement:0.line: 'Real *improvement* means the herb answers before you call.'

afternoon:0.en: All through the long *afternoon*, I sat copying herb-names by candlelight in the archive hall. The other disciples had gone to the outer peak. Dust moved in slow circles above my ink-stone, and when the candle bent sideways without wind, I pressed my brush down harder and pretended not to see.
afternoon:0.cnHint: 整个____，我一个人在典藏堂里抄写草药名录。
afternoon:0.hook: The candle bent sideways, though every window was shut.
afternoon:0.line: 'This *afternoon* the archive will show you what it hides.'

expand:0.en: Master Qingwu drew a single breath and the pale mist in the meditation chamber began to *expand*, pressing softly against the walls, filling every corner with cool light. 'A formula is not a word,' she said. 'It is a living thing.' At the centre of the mist, a shape turned slowly — almost a face.
expand:0.cnHint: 师尊的气息让禅室中的雾气开始____，充满了整个空间。
expand:0.hook: The shape at the mist's centre opened its eyes.
expand:0.line: 'Let your spirit *expand* until it touches the room's edge.'

regardless:0.en: Xiaoxing sat beside me in the study hall, copying the same formula for the ninth time. 'I will finish it *regardless*,' she said quietly, not looking up. Her brush never shook. By the time the evening bell rang, her scroll held something mine did not — a faint warmth that rose like a tiny sun.
regardless:0.cnHint: 小星____也要完成功法抄写，她的卷轴散发出了微弱的光热。
regardless:0.hook: Her scroll was warm long after the candle died.
regardless:0.line: '*Regardless* of the cost, I will make this formula speak.'

rid:0.en: There was an old stain on the archive shelf — black, spreading, smelling of burnt formula. Shen Wujiu handed me a pouch of salt-ash and said, 'You must *rid* the shelf of it before the new scrolls arrive.' I swept carefully. When the last mark vanished, the shelf gave a low tone, like a bell struck far away.
rid:0.cnHint: 师兄让我用盐灰____书架上那块古老的污迹。
rid:0.hook: The low tone rose, steady, from somewhere beneath the floor.
rid:0.line: '*Rid* this place of the stain before sunset, or suffer the smell.'

dog:0.en: A small spirit-hound — barely larger than my fist — had followed Xiaoxing into the inner hall. It was no ordinary *dog*: its paws left no mark on the dusty floor, and its eyes held the pale colour of high clouds. Master Qingwu watched it without surprise, then looked at me as though the creature had said something I had missed.
dog:0.cnHint: 小星带来了一只奇特的灵犬——这只____的爪印没有落在地上。
dog:0.hook: Master Qingwu's look said the hound had chosen, not followed.
dog:0.line: 'That *dog* sees which disciple carries the truest formula.'

busy:0.en: The preparation room was *busy* with the sounds of mortars and soft chanting: six disciples grinding night-herbs for the dawn rite. I moved between the stone tables, handing over measures of dew-powder. No one spoke above a whisper. Near the far window, a single moth circled a cold lamp — three times, exactly, then was gone.
busy:0.cnHint: 备药室里____碌碌，弟子们正在研磨夜草备用，一只飞蛾绕灯三圈后消失。
busy:0.hook: No one mentioned the moth, though everyone had counted three.
busy:0.line: 'Stay *busy* with your hands — a wandering mind spills the dew.'

disadvantage:0.en: Master Qingwu spread eight word-scrolls across the stone table and studied my face. 'Every disciple begins with a *disadvantage*,' she said, tapping the scroll I could not yet read. 'Yours is silence — you hear the words but cannot feel their root.' I touched the scroll. Beneath my fingers, the ink was warm.
disadvantage:0.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，每位弟子都有自己的____，我的是无法感受字根之力。
disadvantage:0.hook: The warm ink left a faint mark on my skin that would not fade.
disadvantage:0.line: 'Your *disadvantage* is silence — but silence can also be a kind of listening.'

discuss:0.en: Shen Wujiu pulled me into the inner study before dawn, where candles burned low over a wide desk. 'We need to *discuss* the word for ascent,' he said quietly. 'Master Qingwu has not taught it yet, and Xiaoxing heard it crying in the night wind.' We bent over the old text together, breath held.
discuss:0.cnHint: 天亮前，师兄把我拉进书房，说我们需要____一个关于飞升的字。
discuss:0.hook: Outside, something brushed the paper window and left no shadow.
discuss:0.line: 'We must *discuss* this before Master Qingwu seals the study at dawn.'

psychological:0.en: Xiaoxing sat beside me on the cold floor, watching me fail the word-test for the third time. 'The block is *psychological*,' she said gently. 'Your mind fears the height, so the word for flight refuses to rise.' She placed a smooth river stone in my palm. I felt my breathing slow.
psychological:0.cnHint: 师妹轻声告诉我，阻碍我施法的是____上的障碍，而非能力不足。
psychological:0.hook: The river stone cracked clean in two without any sound.
psychological:0.line: 'It is *psychological* — the word knows you do not trust the sky yet.'

request:0.en: I knelt before Master Qingwu with both hands raised, the formal posture for a disciple's *request*. I asked to study the ascent word one full night alone. She was silent for a long moment, then set a single candle on the desk before me and left without a word. The door did not close.
request:0.cnHint: 我以正式的姿态向师尊提出____，希望能独自研读飞升之字一整夜。
request:0.hook: Through the open door came the distant sound of something very large taking flight.
request:0.line: 'I have one *request*, Master Qingwu — one night alone with the ascent word.'

symptom:0.en: Shen Wujiu read my pulse with two fingers and frowned. 'Trembling script-lines in the air around you — that is a *symptom* of a word taking root before the mind is ready,' he said. 'It means the ascent word has already chosen you.' I looked at my hands. Faint gold traced every vein.
symptom:0.cnHint: 师兄为我把脉后说，我身边颤动的字迹是____，意味着飞升之字已在我体内扎根。
symptom:0.hook: The gold in my veins pulsed once, bright as a struck bell, then went still.
symptom:0.line: 'Trembling lines in the air — that is the first *symptom*. The word is already inside you.'

upon:0.en: I opened the oldest scroll and laid it flat. *Upon* the yellow surface, characters breathed like sleeping birds, rising and falling in slow rhythm. Master Qingwu had warned me not to read them all at once. I read only one. The room tilted, and the sea of clouds far below seemed suddenly very close.
upon:0.cnHint: 我将古老的卷轴展开，____其泛黄的表面，字符如沉睡的鸟儿一般起伏呼吸。
upon:0.hook: The single word I had read was already gone from the page.
upon:0.line: '*Upon* this scroll rests every ascent the Sect has ever known — touch it with care.'

argument:0.en: Shen Wujiu and Xiaoxing stood on opposite sides of the desk, voices low and tight. Their *argument* was short but sharp: she believed I should attempt the ascent word tonight; he believed I would shatter under it. Neither looked at me. I picked up the scroll myself. They both went quiet.
argument:0.cnHint: 师兄和师妹为我是否该今晚尝试飞升之字而____，双方各执一词。
argument:0.hook: The candle between them blew out, though there was no wind in the room.
argument:0.line: 'This *argument* ends now — let the disciple choose the hour for themselves.'

crisis:0.en: Master Qingwu entered the room at the exact moment the scroll flared white. 'This is a word-*crisis*,' she said, voice steady as stone. 'The ascent word has opened too fast. Breathe out — speak nothing.' I breathed. The white light narrowed to a thread, then to a point, then hung still in the air like a waiting star.
crisis:0.cnHint: 师尊进门时，卷轴骤然大放白光，她平静地说这是一场字道____。
crisis:0.hook: The point of light did not go out — it began, very slowly, to rise.

destroy:0.en: Master Qingwu set a clay tablet on the stone desk before me. 'Speak the wrong word-formula here,' she said, 'and you will *destroy* the seal that holds this mountain aloft.' I looked at the hairline crack already running through the tablet and chose silence. Outside, a single cloud drifted past the window — shaped, unmistakably, like an open hand.
destroy:0.cnHint: 师尊警告我，念错咒文会____这座山的封印，我望着石板上的裂缝，沉默了。
destroy:0.hook: The crack in the tablet had not been there yesterday.
destroy:0.line: 'One wrong breath can *destroy* ten thousand years of careful work.'

drop:0.en: Xiaoxing showed me how to charge a word with spiritual water: fill your breath, let a single *drop* fall from the tip of the brush onto the character, and hold still until the ink glows. My first attempt produced only steam. My second made the whole sheet shiver with pale light. Then the lamp above us went out on its own.
drop:0.cnHint: 师妹教我用毛笔蘸一____灵水激活字符，我第二次尝试时纸张颤动发光，随后灯自行熄灭。
drop:0.hook: No wind had entered the room all evening.
drop:0.line: 'Just one *drop* — too much and the word will weep itself empty.'

efficiency:0.en: Shen Wujiu reviewed my copied scrolls and frowned. 'You trace every stroke twice. That wastes energy.' He tapped the page. 'In a real ascent, *efficiency* decides who reaches the upper peak and who falls back through the clouds.' I rewrote the page in half the strokes. By the final line, the ink burned warm under my fingers.
efficiency:0.cnHint: 师兄批评我抄写时重复落笔，说____决定谁能飞升成功，我重写后，墨迹在指尖发出了热意。
efficiency:0.hook: The warm ink slowly spelled a word I had not written.
efficiency:0.line: '*Efficiency* in word-craft is not speed — it is no wasted breath at all.'

italian:0.en: Among the foreign texts in the sect library sat one slim volume with a cover I could not place. Shen Wujiu said a traveling scholar had brought it from beyond the sea of clouds, and that the healer's formula inside was written first in *Italian* before being rendered into our tongue. The translation, he added quietly, had lost something. That night the book glowed faintly on its shelf.
italian:0.cnHint: 图书馆里有一本来历不明的薄册，师兄说其中的疗愈咒文最初以____文写成，翻译时遗失了某种东西。
italian:0.hook: By morning the book had moved three shelves closer to the door.
italian:0.line: 'The *Italian* rendering carries a warmth our version never quite found.'

newspaper:0.en: A broadsheet printed on cloud-fiber paper arrived at the sect gate each dawn — the disciples called it the sky *newspaper*, for it carried word-signs from every floating mountain in the region. That morning its headline formula shimmered red rather than black. Master Qingwu read it once, folded it without a word, and walked toward the highest tower.
newspaper:0.cnHint: 每天清晨送到山门的云纸____上，头条咒文今日泛着红光，师尊读完后一言不发向最高塔走去。
newspaper:0.hook: No edition had ever before used red ink.
newspaper:0.line: 'The sky *newspaper* does not print in red unless the upper winds have changed.'

piece:0.en: The training room held a mosaic of word-tiles on the floor, each tile a single character of the flight formula. One *piece* was missing near the center, and the gap hummed with cold air. 'Find which word belongs there,' Master Qingwu said, 'and the formula will lift you an inch off the ground.' I knelt, studying the surrounding tiles until my knees ached. A faint shadow crossed the gap, and for a moment the cold stopped.
piece:0.cnHint: 飞升咒文的地板拼图正中缺少一____，师尊说找到它就能离地一寸，我跪地苦思时，那道缝隙的寒气忽然消失了。
piece:0.hook: The shadow had the outline of a hand, fingers spread wide.
piece:0.line: 'Every *piece* of the flight formula must be present — absence is not silence, it is a wound.'

target:0.en: Shen Wujiu drew a circle of ink on the practice wall and told me to make the word 'rise' strike the center. 'You are not throwing sounds,' he said. '*Target* the meaning first; the sound will follow.' I whispered the word and watched it arc — too high, then too low, then exactly true. The circle flared gold and left a scorch mark in the shape of wings.
target:0.cnHint: 师兄让我把"升"字打中练习墙上的圆心，说要先____意义再发声，我第三次终于命中，圆圈化作翅膀形状的焦痕。
target:0.hook: The scorch mark was still warm three hours later.
target:0.line: '*Target* the meaning, not the sound, and the word will find its own way home.'

actual:0.en: I had memorized the ascent formula from a copied scroll for weeks, reciting it each night before sleep. When Master Qingwu finally placed the *actual* original text before me, the characters were subtly different — older, deeper, as though they breathed. Every line I thought I knew needed learning again. A cold draft moved through the sealed room as I reached the final verse.
actual:0.cnHint: 我背诵誊本咒文已数周，师尊拿出____原文时，字迹更古老深沉，我才发现一切需要重学，读到最后一行时密室里吹来冷风。
actual:0.hook: Sealed rooms do not produce drafts — unless something inside them wakes.

pursue:0.en: Master Qingwu set a single oil lamp on the stone table and told us to read its light as a living word. 'A disciple who cannot sit still will never *pursue* true understanding,' she said. I stared at the flame until my eyes burned and the shadows on the wall began to move on their own.
pursue:0.cnHint: 师尊教导弟子，若无法静心，便无法____真正的领悟。
pursue:0.hook: The shadows spelled a warning no one had taught us yet.
pursue:0.line: 'Those who *pursue* power before patience will lose both,' said Master Qingwu.

site:0.en: The inner hall was chosen as the *site* for our first recitation trial. Stone pillars carved with old words rose on every side, and the air smelled of cedar smoke and something older. I stepped to the center mat and felt the floor hum beneath my feet, as if the mountain itself was listening.
site:0.cnHint: 内堂被选为我们首次诵咒考核的____，山体似乎在倾听着我们。
site:0.hook: One carved word on the nearest pillar was glowing faint red.
site:0.line: 'This *site* has heard ten thousand voices fail,' Shen Wujiu whispered to me.

absorb:0.en: Xiaoxing placed a pale green leaf on my palm and told me to let the word written on it dissolve into my skin. 'You must *absorb* it slowly, like water into dry earth,' she said. I held still, and a gentle warmth spread from my hand to my chest, then stopped, as if a door had shut.
absorb:0.cnHint: 师妹让我慢慢____叶片上的字，温热感蔓延至胸口后却骤然停止。
absorb:0.hook: The leaf left no mark, but my shadow had grown slightly longer.
absorb:0.line: 'If you force it, you cannot *absorb* it,' Xiaoxing said, pulling my hand flat.

advance:0.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a narrow scroll and showed me where the three gates of learning were marked in faded ink. 'Each *advance* in word-craft seals a gate behind you,' he said, 'and opens a wind you cannot yet name.' He rolled the scroll back before I could read the third gate's title.
advance:0.cnHint: 师兄向我展示修行三关，每一次____都会封闭身后的一道门。
advance:0.hook: The scroll's outer edge was singed, as though someone had read too far.
advance:0.line: 'Your first *advance* will feel like falling,' Shen Wujiu said, and smiled.

capable:0.en: Master Qingwu called each of us forward and asked us to light a candle using only a spoken word. When my turn came, my voice shook, but the wick caught. She looked at me for a long moment. 'You are more *capable* than you believe,' she said, 'and that gap is your real lesson.' The other candles flickered though no window was open.
capable:0.cnHint: 师尊让每位弟子用一个字点燃蜡烛，并告诉我：我比自己认为的更____。
capable:0.hook: Every candle leaned toward me at the same angle.
capable:0.line: 'Being *capable* and knowing it are two very different things,' said Master Qingwu.

dollar:0.en: A traveling merchant passed through the outer gate and laid strange coins on a cloth — flat rounds of silver stamped with birds I did not know. Shen Wujiu leaned close and said that one *dollar* from the lower world could buy a week of food down in the valley towns, but up here on the floating peaks, the only currency that mattered was a word spoken without doubt.
dollar:0.cnHint: 一位行商展示来自下界的银币，师兄说一枚____能在山下换到一周口粮，但山上通用的货币另有其物。
dollar:0.hook: One coin had rolled to the cliff edge and stopped, spinning in still air.
dollar:0.line: 'A single *dollar* means nothing here,' Shen Wujiu said, 'but it tells you where you came from.'

double:0.en: Master Qingwu wrote one word on the board and asked me to speak it twice in a single breath. The second time, the sound seemed to fold over the first, making a *double* note that rang against the stone walls and lifted dust from the rafters. She marked something in her ledger without looking up. I could not tell if the mark was praise or warning.
double:0.cnHint: 师尊让我一口气将同一个字说两遍，产生了____音，尘埃从梁上飘落。
double:0.hook: The dust settled in the shape of a word none of us could read.
double:0.line: 'A *double* tone means the word is trying to split,' Master Qingwu said quietly.

federal:0.en: An elder arrived from a distant peak carrying a sealed letter stamped with the crest of the *federal* council of the Seven Summits — the body of masters who governed all sects above the cloud line. Master Qingwu read it by the window, her face still, then folded it once and placed it inside her sleeve. She told us to rest early that night.
federal:0.cnHint: 一位长老带来七峰____议会的密函，师尊读后面色平静，却让我们早早休息。
federal:0.hook: The candle on her desk burned blue for the rest of the evening.
federal:0.line: 'The *federal* council has not written to us in eleven years,' Master Qingwu said, almost to herself.

campaign:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an old scroll across the stone table. 'Every generation of disciples wages a *campaign* against ignorance,' she said, tracing the ancient characters with one finger. Each word glowed faintly as she named it. I copied them by candlelight, feeling the mountain breathe beneath the floor. Outside, the clouds turned the colour of ash.
campaign:0.cnHint: 师尊展开古卷，说每一代弟子都要发起一场____，对抗无知。
campaign:0.hook: The last character I copied began to bleed pale light into the dark.
campaign:0.line: 'A *campaign* against ignorance begins with a single word learned well.'

hurt:0.en: Shen Wujiu found me cradling my hand after a formula went wrong. The word had twisted in my mouth and a small flame had kissed my palm. 'Words can *hurt* the one who speaks them carelessly,' he said, wrapping the burn with a strip of cool silk. I nodded. The candle flame leaned toward me as if listening.
hurt:0.cnHint: 师兄包扎我的手，说话语会____那些粗心说出它们的人。
hurt:0.hook: The silk wrapping began to glow with a warmth that was not mine.
hurt:0.line: 'Words *hurt* when you force them before you truly know them.'

initiative:0.en: No one had asked me to tend the inner hearth before dawn. I took the *initiative* myself, rising while the mountain was still dark, feeding dry herbs to the low fire until the hall smelled of cedar and pine smoke. Master Qingwu passed through without a word, but she paused and pressed two fingers to her heart. High above, a bell rang once though no hand had touched it.
initiative:0.cnHint: 没有人叫我去做，我自己主动采取____，在黎明前照料内堂的炉火。
initiative:0.hook: The unasked bell rang once more, and then went perfectly still.
initiative:0.line: 'Taking *initiative* before you are told — that is the first mark of a true disciple.'

jump:0.en: Xiaoxing dared me to *jump* across the narrow gap between the study ledge and the outer balcony. It was only a step, yet the sea of clouds below made it feel like a leap over the world. I crossed it. She laughed and clapped softly. Behind us, the ink in our open lesson-books stirred without wind.
jump:0.cnHint: 师妹让我____过书房石台与外廊之间的窄缝，云海在脚下令人心跳。
jump:0.hook: The ink formed a single unreadable character, then dissolved.
jump:0.line: 'You have to *jump* before the word will carry you — doubt weighs more than stone.'

lie:0.en: The archive room did not *lie* at the top of the tower, as I had assumed, but deep below it, carved into the living rock. Shelves of sealed jars lined the walls, each holding a word too old to speak aloud. The air tasted of iron and old rain. Master Qingwu lit a single lamp, and the shadows leaned in close.
lie:0.cnHint: 我以为档案室在塔顶，但它其实____在塔的深处，凿入活石之中。
lie:0.hook: One of the sealed jars trembled on its shelf without being touched.
lie:0.line: 'The oldest truths *lie* beneath the surface — that is why so few ever find them.'

lunch:0.en: We ate *lunch* on the east terrace, three disciples in a row, bowls of grain broth warm in our hands. Xiaoxing recited the morning's new words between spoonfuls. Shen Wujiu corrected her tone on the third one, gentle but exact. I watched a cloud drift up through the gap between two peaks and thought: every meal here is also a lesson. Then the sky above us flickered green for one held breath.
lunch:0.cnHint: 我们在东台吃____，师妹一边喝粥一边背诵今早学的新词。
lunch:0.hook: The green sky faded, but the clouds below refused to settle.
lunch:0.line: 'Even at *lunch*, the words you reviewed this morning are still shaping the air around you.'

necessarily:0.en: 'Knowing a word does not *necessarily* mean you can use it,' Master Qingwu said, setting a jar of pale herbs on the table between us. 'Understanding and mastery are different mountains.' I had recited every formula she assigned, yet my first attempt to lift a single stone had failed. I looked at the jar. The herbs inside were slowly turning from white to gold.
necessarily:0.cnHint: 师尊说，知道一个词不____意味着你能运用它，理解与精通是两座不同的山。
necessarily:0.hook: The herbs completed their turn to gold, and the jar sealed itself.
necessarily:0.line: 'Memorising a word does not *necessarily* grant you its power — you must earn that separately.'

psychologist:0.en: A traveling elder visited the sect and introduced himself not as a sword-master but as a *psychologist* of words — one who studies how language shapes the mind that wields it. He asked each of us one quiet question, then listened longer than any teacher I had known. When he left at dusk, I felt lighter, as if a knot I had not noticed had finally loosened. The candle at my desk burned twice as bright that night.
psychologist:0.cnHint: 一位云游长老来访，他自称是言语____，研究语言如何塑造使用它的心灵。
psychologist:0.hook: My candle burned double-bright, casting a shadow shaped like open wings.
psychologist:0.line: 'A *psychologist* of words knows that what you say to yourself each dawn decides what you can achieve by dusk.'

writer:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a scroll so old its edges had turned to dust. 'Every *writer* of sacred formulas,' she said, 'left one word unfinished — a test for those who came after.' I studied the gap on the parchment. The missing word was the very herb I had gathered that morning from the eastern ledge.
writer:0.cnHint: 清雾师尊展开古卷，说每位____都留下了一个未完成的字，而我今晨恰好采到了那味草药。
writer:0.hook: A cold wind passed through the sealed room, and the scroll began to write itself.
writer:0.line: 'Every *writer* of sacred formulas left one word unfinished — find it.'

addition:0.en: Shen Wujiu laid three jade vials on the study table and named each herb aloud. 'The *addition* of moonveil root,' he said, sliding the third vial forward, 'turns a healing breath into a flying one.' I copied the formula with a trembling brush, feeling the air around my fingers begin to lighten.
addition:0.cnHint: 沈无咎在书案上摆好三瓶草药，说加入____可以让治愈之气变成飞行之力。
addition:0.hook: The ink dried in the shape of a wing, though I had drawn only a line.
addition:0.line: 'The *addition* of moonveil root turns a healing breath into a flying one.'

alternative:0.en: I had lost two pages of the breath-walking formula, and the morning trial was close. Xiaoxing pressed a thin strip of bark into my hand. 'This is an *alternative*,' she said quietly, 'older and rougher, but it carries the same meaning.' I read it once, and the clouds outside the window shifted as if they had heard.
alternative:0.cnHint: 我丢失了功法残页，小星悄悄递给我一片树皮，说这是一种____，更古老但意思相同。
alternative:0.hook: The bark grew warm in my palm, far warmer than any herb should.
alternative:0.line: 'This is an *alternative* — older and rougher, but it carries the same meaning.'

amazing:0.en: The inner hall held a single floating lamp that burned without oil or wick. 'What feeds it?' I asked. Master Qingwu smiled. 'One spoken word, renewed each dawn.' It seemed *amazing* that a single sound could hold light for an entire day, yet the flame had burned here for three hundred years without once going out.
amazing:0.cnHint: 内堂有一盏无油之灯，清雾师尊说它靠每天黎明念出的一个字维持，我觉得____极了。
amazing:0.hook: That night, the lamp flickered once — the first time in living memory.
amazing:0.line: 'Is it not *amazing* that one spoken word can hold light for three hundred years?'

ease:0.en: Shen Wujiu watched me struggle with the fifth line of the ascending chant for an hour before he spoke. 'Say it with *ease*,' he advised, 'as if you are telling the wind something it already knows.' I let my breath slow, loosened my grip on the brush, and spoke the line as a soft remark. The window opened by itself.
ease:0.cnHint: 沈无咎看我苦练升天咒第五句，建议我用____的语气来念，像是在告诉风一件它早已知晓的事。
ease:0.hook: Outside, a cloud shaped like an open hand drifted past the window.
ease:0.line: 'Say it with *ease* — as if you are telling the wind something it already knows.'

frequent:0.en: My visits to the word-garden behind the hall became *frequent* once I understood that each plant carried a syllable of the flight formula. I came at dawn, at noon, and again at dusk, pressing my ear to each leaf. Xiaoxing left a small stone on my pillow one evening — a sign that someone else had noticed my comings and goings.
frequent:0.cnHint: 我明白每株草药都藏着飞行功法的一个音节后，去后院草药园的次数变得____，小星因此在我枕边留了一块小石头。
frequent:0.hook: The stone was carved with a single eye, still wet as if freshly made.
frequent:0.line: 'Your *frequent* visits to the word-garden have not gone unnoticed, junior disciple.'

hope:0.en: The night before the ascension trial, I sat alone in the study hall with an unlit candle and a page of unread formulas. *Hope* was not a grand feeling then — it was small and steady, like a coal buried deep in ash, just warm enough to keep me reading until the first pale light touched the mountain edge.
hope:0.cnHint: 升天考核前夜，我独坐书堂，心中的____不是宏大的情感，而是像埋在灰烬里的炭火，细小而持续。
hope:0.hook: At dawn, the candle lit itself, though no hand had touched it.
hope:0.line: 'Hold your *hope* small and steady — a buried coal outlasts any open flame.'

imply:0.en: Master Qingwu read my practice scroll without a word, then set it down and looked toward the window. In our sect, silence after a reading was meant to *imply* that the work held promise too delicate to name aloud. I felt my pulse rise. She rose, adjusted the hanging lamp, and said only, 'Come again at first light.'
imply:0.cnHint: 清雾师尊读完我的练习卷后沉默，在本门规矩中，这种沉默____作品已有不宜明言的潜力，我心跳加速。
imply:0.hook: Behind her, the lamp cast two shadows where only one person stood.
imply:0.line: 'Silence after a reading is meant to *imply* what words would only diminish.'

gather:0.en: The inner hall smelled of old wood and cool stone. I watched the silk of my robe *gather* in soft folds at my knees as I knelt before the altar. Each fold, Master Qingwu had said, was a word waiting to be spoken. I pressed my palms flat and tried to feel them — quiet syllables pooling like water in cloth.
gather:0.cnHint: 我跪在祭坛前，看着长袍的布料在膝间____成柔软的褶皱，师尊说那是等待被念出的字。
gather:0.hook: Behind the altar, a single candle bent its flame toward me.
gather:0.line: 'Watch how the silk *gathers*, and you will understand how words pool before they rise.'

imagine:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread a worn scroll across the low table and tapped one faded character. 'Close your eyes,' he said. I did. I tried to *imagine* the word as a living root pushing through dark earth — and something warm moved along my wrist. When I opened my eyes, a thin green line glowed on my skin.
imagine:0.cnHint: 师兄让我闭眼，____那个字是一根穿透黑暗泥土的活根，我睁眼时手腕上竟浮现出一道绿光。
imagine:0.hook: The green line pulsed once, then faded — leaving a faint scar shaped like a leaf.
imagine:0.line: '*Imagine* the word alive, not written, and it will answer you.'

instance:0.en: Master Qingwu called us to the study at dawn and pointed to a row of carved stones. 'Each stone holds one *instance* of a healing word,' she said, 'used by a disciple who is now gone.' She let the silence sit. I looked at the smallest stone and thought I heard breathing — steady, shallow, afraid.
instance:0.cnHint: 师尊指着一排刻字石，说每块石头保存着一个已离开弟子所用字语的一个____。
instance:0.hook: The smallest stone was warm, though the room was cold.
instance:0.line: 'Every *instance* of a word used in fear leaves a mark on the stone.'

numerous:0.en: The library shelf ran the full length of the inner wall, and the scrolls on it were *numerous* beyond easy counting — pale rolls stacked three deep, each one a spoken formula preserved in ink. Xiaoxing ran her finger along the lowest row and whispered that none of them could be read without permission. I counted seven seals on the door we had just passed through.
numerous:0.cnHint: 内室书架上的卷轴____得难以计数，小星低声说没有许可谁也读不了它们。
numerous:0.hook: One scroll at the far end had no seal — and it was already open.
numerous:0.line: 'The words are *numerous*, but only a handful will ever choose a disciple.'

puzzle:0.en: Shen Wujiu slid a flat tile across the table. On it, six characters were carved in a ring, and one space in the center was empty. 'Fill the gap,' he said, 'and the door behind you will open.' I studied each character until my eyes ached. The real *puzzle*, I slowly understood, was not which word fit — it was which word I was willing to give up.
puzzle:0.cnHint: 师兄递来一块刻有六个字的石片，要我填上空缺，我渐渐明白，真正的____不是选哪个字，而是舍弃哪个字。
puzzle:0.hook: When I placed my answer, the room held its breath for three full seconds.
puzzle:0.line: 'The *puzzle* is not solved by knowing — it is solved by choosing.'

remind:0.en: I had nearly left the study without bowing when Xiaoxing caught my sleeve. 'Let me *remind* you,' she said softly, 'that the first word you learned is still the strongest one you carry.' She did not look worried. She looked certain, which was somehow harder to bear. I turned back, bowed, and felt the word she meant settle in my chest like a coal.
remind:0.cnHint: 小星轻轻拉住我的袖子，____我所学的第一个字依然是我身上最有力量的那个。
remind:0.hook: As I stepped into the corridor, I heard my own heartbeat answer her.
remind:0.line: 'I *remind* you not to walk past the altar without the word already in your breath.'

truly:0.en: Master Qingwu set a dry leaf on the stone floor and asked me to heal it. I spoke the word three times. Nothing. On the fourth try I stopped thinking about the word and thought only about the leaf — its thin ribs, its curled edge. It *truly* moved then: one slow unfurl, like a hand opening in sleep. Master Qingwu said nothing, but she did not look away.
truly:0.cnHint: 师尊让我治愈一片枯叶，前三次无效，第四次我只想着叶子本身，它____动了——缓缓舒展开来。
truly:0.hook: The leaf stopped halfway, and something in the ceiling cracked.
truly:0.line: 'You are not *truly* speaking the word until you forget you are speaking.'

valuable:0.en: Before the night bell, Master Qingwu handed me a small wooden box. 'The most *valuable* thing inside is not the herb,' she said. I opened it. There was one dried leaf and, beneath it, a slip of paper with two words in her hand — words I had never seen in any scroll. I memorized them before she could ask for the box back. She smiled as if she had expected exactly that.
valuable:0.cnHint: 师尊递给我一个小木盒，说里面最____的东西不是那株草药，我打开后发现草药下藏着一张写有两个陌生字的纸条。
valuable:0.hook: When I looked up, the candle behind her cast her shadow in the shape of wings.
valuable:0.line: 'A word known only to you is the most *valuable* thing you will ever carry.'

insist:0.en: Master Qingwu placed a sealed jade scroll on the table before me. 'Many disciples wish to skip this step,' she said quietly. I felt the pull of impatience, but she would *insist* that every disciple copy the first thousand herb-names by hand before touching a single living root.
insist:0.cnHint: 师尊____每位弟子在接触灵草之前，必须亲手抄写千种草名。
insist:0.hook: The scroll began to glow before I touched it.
insist:0.line: 'I *insist* you copy every name — your hand must know what your mind forgets.'

investigation:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread dried leaves across the low table, each one tagged with a small paper strip. 'This is not study,' he told me with calm eyes. 'This is *investigation*.' He lifted one leaf to the lamp and showed me the faint silver veins that marked a herb of the upper peak.
investigation:0.cnHint: 师兄向我解释，辨识灵草不是单纯的学习，而是一种____。
investigation:0.hook: One leaf had no tag — and no shadow.
investigation:0.line: 'True *investigation* begins when you question what the tag already says.'

limited:0.en: The inner hall held only twelve practice pillars, and Master Qingwu reminded us each morning that our time at them was *limited* to one hour. Beyond that hour the spiritual energy in the wood grew cold and gave nothing back. I learned to waste nothing — not a breath, not a step.
limited:0.cnHint: 师尊提醒我们，每天使用练功柱的时间是____的，必须珍惜每一刻。
limited:0.hook: That morning, the sand-clock ran out two breaths too soon.
limited:0.line: 'Our time here is *limited*, so let your intention be sharp from the first moment.'

listen:0.en: Xiaoxing sat beside me in the dim herb-room, both of us still. 'Close your eyes and *listen*,' she whispered. At first I heard only the wind sliding under the door. Then, slowly, I caught a faint hum rising from the rows of roots — something alive and waiting beneath the dry silence.
listen:0.cnHint: 师妹让我闭上眼睛，____灵草发出的细微声音。
listen:0.hook: The hum rose to a single, clear note — then stopped.
listen:0.line: '*Listen* — the root speaks before it blooms, if you are quiet enough.'

master:0.en: On the wall of the inner study hung a single painting: an old figure standing at the edge of a cloud, arms open to the wind. Shen Wujiu told me it was the first *master* of our sect, the one who had written the original herb-formulas on strips of bark no wider than a finger.
master:0.cnHint: 内室墙上挂着一幅画，描绘的是云海宗最初的____。
master:0.hook: The figure in the painting had no face — only open hands.
master:0.line: 'The first *master* left us the words; it is we who must learn to deserve them.'

newly:0.en: The walls of the preparation chamber smelled of pine resin and something sharper. I was *newly* arrived at the inner hall, and every shelf of jars and bundles felt like a sentence I could not yet read. Master Qingwu walked ahead without looking back, trusting that I would keep up.
newly:0.cnHint: 作为____加入内堂的弟子，我面对满架灵药，感到一切都如同读不懂的文字。
newly:0.hook: She stopped at the last shelf — and it was empty.
newly:0.line: 'You are *newly* come here, so look slowly — the room will teach you if you let it.'

north:0.en: The archive room faced *north*, and no sunlight ever crossed its stone floor. Shen Wujiu said this was by design — direct sun would fade the oldest herb-scrolls, turning their ink to pale ghosts. I lit a small lamp and opened the first roll, feeling the cold of the room settle around me like water.
north:0.cnHint: 存放古老草药卷轴的档案室朝____而建，以防日光损毁珍贵文字。
north:0.hook: The lamplight moved — though the air was perfectly still.
north:0.line: 'This room faces *north* so that what is written here will outlast us all.'

obviously:0.en: Xiaoxing watched me try to sort three bundles of dried root by smell alone. After my third wrong guess she smiled, not unkindly. 'You are *obviously* using your memory rather than your nose,' she said. She was right. I had been reciting labels in my head instead of breathing the roots in.
obviously:0.cnHint: 师妹指出，我____是在用记忆而不是用感官来辨别灵草。
obviously:0.hook: She handed me a fourth bundle — one that had no name at all.
obviously:0.line: 'You are *obviously* thinking too hard; put the labels down and just breathe.'

belong:0.en: Inside the Hall of Records, I ran my fingers along the wooden shelves. Each jar held dried herbs that *belonged* to a different disciple. Master Qingwu watched in silence as I reached for a jar marked with my own name. The weight of it surprised me — it was heavier than I had expected.
belong:0.cnHint: 在典籍堂内，我发现了一个贴着自己名字的药罐，感到既惊讶又沉重。
belong:0.hook: The jar hummed faintly, as if something inside was still alive.
belong:0.line: 'These jars *belong* to those the Sect has chosen — choose carefully which one you open.'

beneficial:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread the dried leaves across the low table and named each one slowly. He said the pale green leaf was the most *beneficial* of all, able to clear the mind before a disciple attempted a new formula. I copied his words into my notebook, pressing hard with the brush so none would fade.
beneficial:0.cnHint: 师兄向我介绍一种对修行最有____的草药，我认真地将他的话记录下来。
beneficial:0.hook: Outside, a cold wind pressed against the paper window, and the flame bent sideways.
beneficial:0.line: 'That pale leaf is *beneficial* beyond all others — do not waste even a fragment of it.'

characteristic:0.en: Master Qingwu placed a single seed on the stone table before me. She said that the deep gold colour was the *characteristic* of seeds drawn from the highest peaks, where clouds never parted. I looked closely, and within the gold I saw something moving — a slow, small pulse, like a heartbeat.
characteristic:0.cnHint: 师尊向我解释，那颗种子的金色外表是来自最高山峰的草药的____。
characteristic:0.hook: The pulse quickened the moment my shadow fell across the seed.
characteristic:0.line: 'That golden colour is the *characteristic* of a seed that has touched the sky — respect it.'

director:0.en: A guest had arrived before dawn, introduced only as the *director* of the Outer Archive. He sat at the far end of the reading room, reviewing scrolls with quick, precise movements. Xiaoxing whispered that he came only when a disciple's record needed to be corrected — or removed. I kept my eyes on my own page.
director:0.cnHint: 黎明前，外部典籍的____到访，同门师妹低声警告我这意味着什么。
director:0.hook: He paused on one scroll and did not turn the page for a very long time.
director:0.line: 'As *director* of the Outer Archive, I alone decide which names remain in the record.'

emerge:0.en: I had been seated at the inner study table for two hours, repeating the formula under my breath. Then, slowly, a faint blue shape began to *emerge* from the surface of the ink I had brushed onto the paper. It rose like mist from cold water, forming a pattern I had never seen in any of the Sect's books.
emerge:0.cnHint: 我在书房内反复默念咒文，纸面上竟慢慢____出一个从未见过的蓝色图案。
emerge:0.hook: The pattern shifted once, then held perfectly still, watching me.
emerge:0.line: 'When such shapes *emerge* from your ink, stop writing and call for Master Qingwu at once.'

exact:0.en: Xiaoxing stood beside the medicine cabinet and read aloud from a thin scroll. She said the *exact* amount of each herb mattered more than the choice of herb itself — even one extra pinch could turn a healing blend into a harmful one. Her voice was steady, but her hands trembled slightly as she measured the first portion.
exact:0.cnHint: 师妹告诉我，调配草药时每一味的____用量比选材本身更为重要。
exact:0.hook: She weighed the last herb twice, then closed her eyes before adding it.
exact:0.line: 'The *exact* measure is everything — one pinch too many and the formula turns against you.'

guest:0.en: A *guest* arrived at the inner hall just as the evening bell rang. She carried no name tablet and gave no bow, yet Master Qingwu rose from her seat to greet her. I had never seen the master stand first for anyone. The stranger's robe was the colour of deep cloud, and it left no shadow on the floor.
guest:0.cnHint: 暮钟响起，一位神秘____来到内堂，师尊竟破例起身相迎。
guest:0.hook: The stranger's robe cast no shadow, though the lamps burned bright.
guest:0.line: 'A *guest* who leaves no shadow has walked a road none of us would dare travel.'

massive:0.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the back of the library, where a *massive* stone tablet filled the entire wall. Every disciple's name was carved into it, along with the formula each had mastered. I found my name near the bottom, small and fresh, the stone still pale where the chisel had cut. It felt more real than anything so far.
massive:0.cnHint: 师兄带我来到藏书阁深处，那里有一块____的石碑，刻着所有弟子的名字和所修咒文。
massive:0.hook: Above my name, one older carving had been filled in with grey paste, as if erased.
massive:0.line: 'This *massive* tablet forgets no one — every name carved here carries the weight of a promise.'

pose:0.en: Inside the stone hall, Master Qingwu moved through each sacred word with perfect stillness. Every *pose* she held carried meaning — a slight lean forward meant healing; arms spread wide meant flight. I copied each shape with trembling care, feeling the words hum faintly in my bones as the candles burned low.
pose:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊在石殿中演示每个灵字的____，我颤抖着模仿，感受到骨骼中微微震动。
pose:0.hook: Then one candle snuffed itself out, though no wind stirred.
pose:0.line: 'Each *pose* you hold tells the word what you intend,' said Master Qingwu.

stimulate:0.en: Shen Wujiu placed a warm jade token against my wrist. 'This will *stimulate* the word sleeping in your meridian,' he said quietly. A soft heat climbed my arm. The word for 'cloud' bloomed behind my eyes, clear and bright, as rain began to tap the window without warning.
stimulate:0.cnHint: 师兄用玉符____了我经脉中沉睡的灵字，那个字在我脑中清晰绽放。
stimulate:0.hook: Outside, the rain fell upward into the sky.
stimulate:0.line: 'Let it *stimulate* the word gently — do not fight the warmth,' Shen Wujiu said.

switch:0.en: Master Qingwu taught us to *switch* between the word for fire and the word for water in a single breath. Most disciples could hold only one at a time. I managed it once, briefly, and the ink on my practice paper turned to mist. No one spoke. The oil lamp flickered three times.
switch:0.cnHint: 师尊教我们在一口气中____火与水两个灵字，我短暂地做到了，纸上的墨化成了雾。
switch:0.hook: The mist drifted toward the sealed door at the hall's far end.
switch:0.line: 'To *switch* words mid-breath is the mark of a true cultivator,' Master Qingwu said softly.

treatment:0.en: Xiaoxing had strained her voice channels reciting the storm word all morning. Shen Wujiu prepared a quiet *treatment* — three gentle words spoken over a bowl of warm water, which she then drank. Color returned to her face within moments. Outside, the storm word still echoed faintly in the rafters.
treatment:0.cnHint: 晓星损伤了音道，师兄用三个轻柔的灵字为她进行了一次____，她很快恢复了气色。
treatment:0.hook: But the storm word would not stop echoing, long after she was healed.
treatment:0.line: 'This *treatment* should ease the pain before tonight's lesson,' said Shen Wujiu.

union:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an old scroll and showed us two words pressed side by side. 'Their *union* creates a third meaning no single word can hold,' she said. The combined glyph seemed to breathe. I reached out without thinking, and the scroll rolled itself shut around my fingers like a gentle hand.
union:0.cnHint: 师尊展示了两个灵字的____，合并后产生了单个字无法承载的第三重含义，古卷自行合拢。
union:0.hook: My fingers, when freed, smelled faintly of high-mountain wind.
union:0.line: 'The *union* of two honest words is never weaker than either alone,' Master Qingwu said.

acknowledge:0.en: After I spoke the word for 'ascent' aloud for the first time, a hush fell over the study room. Shen Wujiu was the first to *acknowledge* what had happened — he gave a single slow nod, eyes bright. I had not expected the word to glow on the page after leaving my mouth. Neither had he.
acknowledge:0.cnHint: 我第一次大声念出'升'字后，师兄首先____了所发生的事，那个字在纸上发了光。
acknowledge:0.hook: The glow faded, but a faint warmth stayed pressed against the paper.
acknowledge:0.line: 'I *acknowledge* that you spoke it true — even I did not manage that so soon,' Shen Wujiu said.

alike:0.en: Master Qingwu looked at my brushwork and Xiaoxing's side by side. 'Your strokes are nearly *alike*,' she said, 'but hers carries breath and yours carries weight — both are needed.' It was the closest thing to praise I had heard from her. A moth landed on the ink stone and did not move.
alike:0.cnHint: 师尊比较了我和晓星的笔法，说两人的笔触几乎____，但各有侧重，这是难得的夸奖。
alike:0.hook: The moth's wings bore the faint outline of the word for 'sky.'
alike:0.line: 'No two disciples are exactly *alike* — that is the sect's quiet strength,' said Master Qingwu.

analyze:0.en: Shen Wujiu taught me to *analyze* a failed word by reading the brush strokes backward, stroke by stroke, the way a healer reads a scar. I found my error on the third stroke — a slight hesitation had broken the meaning. When I corrected it, the word rose off the page and hung in the cold air.
analyze:0.cnHint: 师兄教我逆向____一个失败的灵字，我在第三笔找到了犹豫造成的断裂，纠正后字悬浮于空中。
analyze:0.hook: It hung there a full breath longer than any word should.
analyze:0.line: '*Analyze* the silence between your strokes — that is where the error hides,' said Shen Wujiu.

therefore:0.en: The inner hall smelled of old pine and cold stone. Master Qingwu placed three jade scrolls on the table before me. 'Each word you learn is a seed,' she said. 'It draws power from your breath, and is *therefore* a living thing.' I touched the first scroll. The character on its surface glowed faint gold, then went still.
therefore:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊告诉我，每个词语都有灵气，____是活的存在。
therefore:0.hook: The gold light pulsed once more — and the scroll was warm.
therefore:0.line: 'A word draws power from breath, and is *therefore* alive.'

truth:0.en: Shen Wujiu sat cross-legged by the study lamp, copying the same character for the third hour. I asked why he did not simply memorize it. He looked up slowly. 'To copy is to listen. The *truth* of a word lives in the stroke, not the sound.' Outside, the clouds shifted, and a cold wind crept under the door.
truth:0.cnHint: 师兄说，一个词的____藏在笔画里，而不是声音中。
truth:0.hook: The lamp flame bent sideways, though no window was open.
truth:0.line: 'The *truth* of a word lives in the stroke, not the sound.'

protein:0.en: Xiaoxing spread a row of dried herbs across the low table. 'Master Qingwu says each herb carries a kind of *protein* — not for the body, but for the word-self inside you. Feed it wrong and the formula collapses.' She tapped the smallest pod. Its shell cracked open and released a thin silver mist that curled toward the ceiling.
protein:0.cnHint: 小星解释说，每种草药含有一种____，能滋养修炼者体内的词灵。
protein:0.hook: The silver mist did not fade — it spelled a single character.
protein:0.line: 'Each herb carries a *protein* that feeds the word-self inside you.'

traffic:0.en: I had not expected a floating mountain to feel crowded. By the second bell, a steady *traffic* of disciples moved through the corridor outside our study room — each carrying a word-vessel, each whispering their assigned formula. The hum of so many voices made the floor vibrate faintly beneath my knees.
traffic:0.cnHint: 修炼山门内，来来往往的弟子形成了繁忙的____，让地板微微颤动。
traffic:0.hook: Then all the voices stopped at once, mid-syllable.
traffic:0.line: 'The *traffic* of disciples through here has doubled since dawn.'

cat:0.en: A small grey *cat* slept on the highest shelf in the reading room, coiled around a clay jar. Shen Wujiu told me it had lived in the sect for longer than any elder could remember. 'It only wakes,' he said quietly, 'when a disciple speaks a word so pure it disturbs the air.' The cat's ear twitched.
cat:0.cnHint: 藏书室货架上睡着一只灰色的____，据说只有弟子念出极纯之词时才会醒来。
cat:0.hook: Its eyes opened — two still, amber moons.
cat:0.line: 'The *cat* wakes only when a word is spoken with perfect clarity.'

sugar:0.en: The morning tea Master Qingwu poured was pale green and tasted of nothing. She explained that a new disciple must train without *sugar*, without comfort, without the small rewards the tongue expects. 'Craving sweetness clouds the mind. A clouded mind cannot hold a formula.' I drank the whole cup and set it down without a word.
sugar:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊说，新弟子修炼时不能依赖____，否则心神会被欲望遮蔽。
sugar:0.hook: She refilled my cup and watched my face with calm, measuring eyes.
sugar:0.line: 'Train without *sugar* — comfort dulls the mind that must hold a formula.'

balance:0.en: The first lesson was not a word but a posture. Master Qingwu placed a word-vessel — full of luminous ink — on the back of my hand.
