setting:0.cnHint: 师尊特意选择这个简朴的____让我练字，说空间会影响心境。
setting:0.hook: Then a second candle lit itself in the empty corner.
setting:0.line: 'I chose this *setting* because silence is the first word you must learn.'

shrink:0.en: Xiaoxing held the pale seed of a sky-herb above the study room flame. We watched it *shrink* slowly, curling inward like a sleeping insect, until it was no larger than a punctuation mark. 'When a word loses its will,' she whispered, 'it does the same thing.' She closed her palm around the tiny seed.
shrink:0.cnHint: 小星让我看草药种子在火焰上____，说失去意志的文字也会如此。
shrink:0.hook: The seed vanished entirely, leaving only a faint silver ring.
shrink:0.line: 'Watch it *shrink* — this is what doubt does to a living word.'

bottom:0.en: Master Qingwu set a clay jar before me and said nothing. I reached inside, fingers brushing cold stone walls, until I touched a single dried leaf resting at the *bottom*. 'That leaf,' she said softly, 'holds the word for stillness. Only a patient hand finds it.' Outside, the wind had stopped entirely.
bottom:0.cnHint: 我从罐子____取出一片枯叶，师尊说只有耐心的人才能找到它。
bottom:0.hook: Then the jar began to hum on its own.
bottom:0.line: 'The rarest herb always sinks to the *bottom*, where no one thinks to look.'

breed:0.en: Shen Wujiu kept a shelf of small pots, each holding a different kind of word-moss. He said each *breed* responded to a different tone of voice — some to a whisper, some to a firm call. I tried the silver-edged one. It shivered, then went dark. He did not look surprised.
breed:0.cnHint: 师兄的苔藓有许多不同____，我尝试对银边苔藓说话，但它却熄灭了。
breed:0.hook: A second pot, untouched, began to glow.
breed:0.line: 'This *breed* of word-moss only opens for those with a calm heart.'

classify:0.en: My first task in the inner hall was to *classify* the dried word-scrolls by their power: healing on the left shelf, flying in the centre, fighting on the right. I moved slowly, reading each one. Near the end I found a scroll that fit none of the three. I placed it alone on the windowsill.
classify:0.cnHint: 我需要将卷轴____，但有一卷无法归入任何一类，我将它单独放在窗台上。
classify:0.hook: By morning, the lone scroll had moved itself to the door.
classify:0.line: 'It took me a full year to *classify* that one,' Xiaoxing said quietly, 'and I was wrong.'

comment:0.en: Master Qingwu read my first copied formula without a word. Then she set it down and made a single *comment*: 'Your brush holds fear.' She did not explain further. I copied the formula again, trying to feel what fear looked like in ink. The candle flame leaned toward the page as if reading along.
comment:0.cnHint: 师尊只对我的功法做了一句____，说我的笔里藏着恐惧。
comment:0.hook: The second copy began to smoke at the edges.
comment:0.line: 'I have only one *comment* — your hand knows the word, but your heart does not.'

component:0.en: Xiaoxing spread the healing formula across the low table and pointed to each part in turn. 'Every *component* carries a role,' she said. 'Remove one and the formula becomes silence.' I studied the piece she called the root-breath, a single curved stroke, and understood why my attempts had all failed.
component:0.cnHint: 师妹向我解释了功法中每个____的作用，我终于明白为什么之前全都失败了。
component:0.hook: When I traced the root-breath alone, the ink rose off the page.
component:0.line: 'This *component* is the heart of the formula — lose it and nothing works.'

contrary:0.en: Every new disciple believed that shouting a word gave it more power. *Contrary* to this, Master Qingwu taught that volume meant nothing; only clear intention did. I whispered the word for rising wind and felt the floor drop away beneath my feet for one brief, breathless moment.
contrary:0.cnHint: 与众人的想法____，师尊说声音大小无关紧要，只有清晰的意念才有力量。
contrary:0.hook: The window shutters flew open though the air outside was perfectly still.
contrary:0.line: '*Contrary* to what you were told, silence carries the greatest force.'

deny:0.en: Shen Wujiu asked if I had opened the sealed cabinet in the east corner. I wanted to *deny* it, but the faint silver dust on my sleeve told the truth before I could speak. He was not angry. He simply said, 'Then you have already read the word inside. Do not speak it until you understand it.'
deny:0.cnHint: 师兄问我是否打开了封印的柜子，我想____，但袖子上的银色粉末出卖了我。
deny:0.hook: That night the word repeated itself in my dreams, louder each time.
deny:0.line: 'Do not *deny* what your own hands have done — the dust does not lie.'

depth:0.en: The library of the Cloud Sea Sect went downward, not upward. Each lower floor held older and stranger words. Master Qingwu warned me that the true *depth* of a word could not be measured by how old it was, only by how much silence it held. I descended three floors before the lantern began to tremble.
depth:0.cnHint: 师尊说词语的____不能用古老程度衡量，只能看它包含多少沉默。
depth:0.hook: On the fourth floor, something quietly said my name.
depth:0.line: 'The *depth* of a word is not in its age — it is in the silence it carries.'

strike:0.en: Inside the Sutra Hall, Master Qingwu raised her bamboo rod without warning. The *strike* landed on the stone lectern, not on me, yet the crack echoed through my ribs. Every disciple froze. She had said nothing for three days, and now the silence shattered like old porcelain.
strike:0.cnHint: 师尊在经堂突然以竹杖____石台，震慑所有弟子。
strike:0.hook: A thin line of light split the lectern where the rod had landed.
strike:0.line: 'One *strike* on stone teaches more than a hundred words on silk.'

television:0.en: On the inner-hall wall hung a polished bronze mirror the sect called the Sky-Gazing Glass. It showed distant peaks in moving light, like a *television* no craftsman could explain. Shen Wujiu leaned close and whispered that the mirror had once revealed a falling star three days before it struck the mountains.
television:0.cnHint: 宗门内堂的铜镜如同一台____，映出远方活动的景象。
television:0.hook: Tonight the mirror showed only smoke, rising from our own courtyard.
television:0.line: 'This mirror is our *television*, and it never shows good news twice.'

youth:0.en: Master Qingwu spread a scroll across the reading table, its edges worn soft by decades of hands. 'In my *youth*,' she said quietly, 'I memorised this passage in a single night and thought myself nearly immortal.' She looked at us with calm eyes. I felt the weight of those words settle into my bones.
youth:0.cnHint: 师尊展开古卷，回忆自己____时曾以一夜之功背下此篇。
youth:0.hook: The last line of the scroll was written in a hand none of us recognised.
youth:0.line: 'My *youth* burned bright and fast, like a paper lantern in the wind.'

alter:0.en: Xiaoxing ground three silver herbs into a pale powder and pressed it into the ink stone. 'Adding moongrass will *alter* the formula slightly,' she said, 'but the seal it burns will hold twice as long.' The powder caught the lamp light and glowed. I copied her movements, hoping my hands were as steady.
alter:0.cnHint: 小星将月草研入墨石，告诉我此举会____符文的效果。
alter:0.hook: When I pressed my own seal to paper, the ink moved on its own.
alter:0.line: 'Just one grain of moongrass can *alter* everything the seal was meant to do.'

approximately:0.en: The old roster on the inner-hall shelf listed *approximately* three hundred disciples who had attempted the Cloud Ascension trial over the past century. Shen Wujiu counted the names that carried a red mark beside them, meaning success, and looked up at me with a careful expression. There were fewer than twenty.
approximately:0.cnHint: 内堂名册记载____三百名弟子曾尝试飞升之试。
approximately:0.hook: My own name had already been added to the list, in fresh ink.
approximately:0.line: '*Approximately* one in fifteen survives the trial — choose your herbs wisely.'

attractive:0.en: The ascension robe folded on my table was plain white, but the border carried a thread of silver cloud-script that shimmered when the lamp moved. It was deeply *attractive*, not for vanity, but because each stitch held a small protection word woven in by Master Qingwu herself. I was almost afraid to wear it.
attractive:0.cnHint: 飞升道袍边缘绣有银色云纹，令人觉得格外____。
attractive:0.hook: Xiaoxing said the robe only shimmers for the disciple it was made for.
attractive:0.line: 'Do not think it *attractive* until you know what price the silver thread carries.'

bag:0.en: Before dawn I packed a small cloth *bag*: one sealed formula, a pinch of breath-calming herb, and the smooth river stone Master Qingwu had pressed into my hand without explanation. The bag weighed almost nothing, yet I could not lift it quickly. Shen Wujiu watched from the doorway and said nothing.
bag:0.cnHint: 黎明前，我将符文与药草装入一只小____，准备上路。
bag:0.hook: At the bottom of the bag, beneath the stone, I found a name I did not know.
bag:0.line: 'A disciple's *bag* should carry three things: a word, a herb, and no fear.'

beat:0.en: I stood at the inner-hall threshold and listened. The sect drum sounded in the distance, one slow *beat* every ten breaths, marking the hour before the ascension trial began. Each beat pressed against my chest like a second heart. Xiaoxing came to stand beside me and matched her breathing to the drum without speaking.
beat:0.cnHint: 宗门鼓声以缓慢的____为节奏，宣告飞升之试即将开始。
beat:0.hook: On the fifth beat, the drum stopped, and the silence was louder than the sound.
beat:0.line: 'Follow the *beat* of the drum; it will steady you when your own heart cannot.'

distinguish:0.en: The inner hall held a hundred clay jars, each sealed with a different word-herb. Master Qingwu set one before me and said nothing. I closed my eyes, drew a slow breath, and let the faint scent rise. Only then could I *distinguish* the healing word from the poison word — one smelled of rain, the other of ash.
distinguish:0.cnHint: 师尊让我在众多药草中用感官____出治愈之词与毒词的区别。
distinguish:0.hook: But the jar I had chosen began to tremble on its own.
distinguish:0.line: 'Can you *distinguish* the rain-scent from the ash before the seal breaks?'

document:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread an old *document* across the stone table, its edges brown with age and its words faint as mist. 'Every disciple admitted to the Cloud Sea Sect is recorded here,' he said quietly. I leaned in and found my own name at the very bottom, written in ink that still shone wet.
document:0.cnHint: 师兄展示了一份古老的____，上面记录着所有入门弟子的名字，而我的名字墨迹未干。
document:0.hook: Below my name, someone had drawn a small, unsteady warning symbol.
document:0.line: 'Your name is in the *document*, but someone has marked it with a sign I do not know.'

dozen:0.en: Xiaoxing lined up a *dozen* word-seeds along the window ledge, each no bigger than a grain of rice. 'One for each cloud-path into the mountain,' she said, counting softly. I watched the seeds glow in turn — pale gold, pale blue, pale green — and felt the floor hum beneath my feet.
dozen:0.cnHint: 师妹在窗台上排列了____颗词种，每颗对应一条通往山中的云径，它们依次发出柔光。
dozen:0.hook: When she reached the last seed, it gave no light at all.
dozen:0.line: 'I have planted a *dozen* word-seeds, but only eleven answered me this morning.'

dull:0.en: My practice blade was *dull*, not meant to cut but to carry word-formulas carved along its flat side. Master Qingwu tapped it with one finger, and the carved words lit up like lanterns in fog. 'A sharp edge breaks the formula,' she explained. 'Only a dull edge can hold the full sentence.'
dull:0.cnHint: 师尊解释说，____的刀刃才能承载完整的词语咒文，锋利的刀刃反而会将其打断。
dull:0.hook: Yet when she lifted her finger, one carved word had quietly gone dark.
dull:0.line: 'Keep the blade *dull* — a sharp one will shatter the formula before it speaks.'

fortune:0.en: On my first full day in the inner hall, Shen Wujiu told me that great *fortune* had brought me here. 'Most who carry a word-gift never find the sect at all,' he said, glancing at the clouds below the window. 'The mountain chose to show itself to you.' I did not feel lucky. I felt watched.
fortune:0.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，能找到宗门是莫大的____，因为大多数拥有词语天赋的人根本看不见这座山。
fortune:0.hook: Then the clouds outside the window shifted, and the mountain below us was gone.
fortune:0.line: 'Your *fortune* is real, but the mountain gives nothing without a price.'

fulfil:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a narrow scroll and placed it in my hands. 'Every disciple must *fulfil* three tasks before the first season ends,' she said. The tasks were written in a word-formula I could almost read. Almost. The third task was smudged, as if someone had pressed a wet thumb across it on purpose.
fulfil:0.cnHint: 师尊要求每位弟子在第一个季度结束前____三项任务，但我手中卷轴上的第三项任务被故意抹去了。
fulfil:0.hook: The smudge was still damp when I touched it.
fulfil:0.line: 'You must *fulfil* all three tasks — even the one you cannot yet read.'

gradually:0.en: The word-herb called Stillmoss worked *gradually*, Master Qingwu had warned, not all at once. I placed one leaf under my tongue after the evening bell and waited. The hum of the mountain entered me in slow waves — first my feet, then my knees, then my chest — until I could hear each cloud below breathing.
gradually:0.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，一种叫静苔的词药效果____显现，我按指示服用后，感到山的气息一点一点渗入全身。
gradually:0.hook: But the breathing I heard was not the clouds — it came from inside the wall.
gradually:0.line: 'Stillmoss works *gradually*; if you feel it all at once, you have taken too much.'

incentive:0.en: 'Why would anyone study the harder word-paths?' I asked Shen Wujiu one evening. He smiled and pointed to the highest peak, just visible above the cloud-line. 'That is your *incentive*,' he said. 'Whoever masters the full sky-formula may stand on that peak and speak one word that the whole mountain will obey.'
incentive:0.cnHint: 师兄指着云线之上的最高峰，告诉我那就是刻苦修习难阶词道的____——掌握天空咒文者可令全山听命。
incentive:0.hook: That night, a light moved on the peak — and it was not a star.
incentive:0.line: 'The summit is *incentive* enough — one word from there commands the whole mountain.'

relax:0.en: Inside the herb chamber, Master Qingwu lit a pale incense stick and told me to breathe slowly. 'You must *relax* your spirit-channels before the Ascension Trial,' she said, 'or the energy will scatter like smoke.' I tried. The smoke curled upward in a perfect spiral, then stopped.
relax:0.cnHint: 师尊让我在药室中____精神经脉，为飞升试炼做准备。
relax:0.hook: The smoke held its shape — and no wind was blowing.
relax:0.line: 'You must *relax* your spirit-channels, or the energy will scatter.'

release:0.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the center of the study room, palms open. With one slow breath he chose to *release* the word-formula he had held in his mind for three years. A soft light left his hands and sank into the floorboards. He looked lighter — and somehow older.
release:0.cnHint: 师兄将他守护了三年的字诀____出去，整个人似乎也随之改变了。
release:0.hook: Where the light sank, a character appeared in the grain of the wood.
release:0.line: 'To *release* it now means I may never hold it again.'

route:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a silk map across the reading table. Every *route* to the upper peaks was marked in red ink, but one path had been crossed out with a single black stroke. She tapped that line without explanation and rolled the map back up before I could ask.
route:0.cnHint: 师尊展开地图，指出通往上峰的每条____，其中一条被墨线划去。
route:0.hook: The crossed-out path was the only one that led to open sky.
route:0.line: 'Every *route* carries a price — choose before dawn.'

sight:0.en: Xiaoxing pressed her face to the round window of the inner library. The floating mountains had aligned for the first time in a century, and the *sight* filled the whole frame like a painted scroll. She whispered that it was beautiful. Then the mountains began, very slowly, to drift apart.
sight:0.cnHint: 师妹透过内院书库的窗户，第一次看到诸峰连成一线的____。
sight:0.hook: They would not align again in any of our lifetimes.
sight:0.line: 'That *sight* will not come twice — look while you can.'

speaker:0.en: The announcement drum had struck three times, and every disciple gathered in the inner hall. The *speaker* at the stone dais was not Master Qingwu but a senior elder none of us recognized. She read one sentence from a narrow scroll, then placed the scroll face-down and said nothing more.
speaker:0.cnHint: 内院集会上，石台前的____并非师尊，而是一位陌生的长老。
speaker:0.hook: The sentence she read contained every disciple's name but one.
speaker:0.line: 'As *speaker* for the council, I bring one warning only.'

species:0.en: In the deep shelf of the apothecary room I found a jar holding a herb I had never seen. Master Qingwu said it belonged to a *species* that blooms only when a disciple is ready to leave the sect forever. The jar had been sealed for forty years. The seal was cracked.
species:0.cnHint: 药房深处有一株草药，师尊说这个____只在弟子将要永别门派时才开花。
species:0.hook: Forty years of stillness — and now the crack ran deeper each hour.
species:0.line: 'This *species* has not bloomed in my lifetime — until today.'

specifically:0.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a folded note before morning practice. He said Master Qingwu had left instructions and that they were *specifically* for me, not for any other disciple. I unfolded it in the quiet of the robe room. The paper held a single word-formula I had not been taught yet.
specifically:0.cnHint: 师兄转交师尊留下的字条，说其中的指引是____写给我一人的。
specifically:0.hook: The formula on the paper matched the shape of my own birth-mark.
specifically:0.line: 'She said *specifically* your name — no one else was mentioned.'

unfortunately:0.en: Xiaoxing and I searched the record room until the lanterns burned low, looking for my lineage scroll. *Unfortunately*, the shelf where it should have rested held only a rectangle of clean dust — the scroll had been removed, and recently. She squeezed my hand once, then went to light a new candle.
unfortunately:0.cnHint: 我和师妹在藏卷室寻找我的传承卷轴，____那里只剩一片干净的灰尘。
unfortunately:0.hook: Clean dust means the scroll was taken tonight, not years ago.
unfortunately:0.line: '*Unfortunately*, the answer you need most is the one now missing.'

lower:0.en: Master Qingwu spread a silk chart across the stone table. The shelves above held rare word-herbs, but she pointed to the *lower* row, where the common ones sat. 'Begin here,' she said quietly. 'The roots of this craft grow in plain soil.' I reached for the first jar, and its seal glowed faint gold.
lower:0.cnHint: 青雾师尊告诉我，修炼从____排架子上的普通字草开始。
lower:0.hook: The gold glow deepened, as if the jar had been waiting for my hand.
lower:0.line: 'Start with the *lower* shelf — there is more power there than it seems.'

naturally:0.en: Shen Wujiu watched me struggle to copy the breathing formula. He did not correct me at once. 'Let the word rise *naturally*,' he said, 'the way steam lifts from warm tea.' I stopped forcing the sound, and the character on my page lit a soft blue. Outside, the wind went still.
naturally:0.cnHint: 师兄说，让字从口中____升起，就像热茶冒出的水汽。
naturally:0.hook: The wind's sudden silence felt less like calm and more like held breath.
naturally:0.line: 'A word spoken *naturally* carries ten times the force of one that is pushed.'

passionate:0.en: Xiaoxing was the most *passionate* student in the morning hall. She whispered each word-herb name with a kind of hunger, as though saying it were already half the cure. Master Qingwu watched her from the doorway and said nothing. A single red leaf drifted in from outside and landed on Xiaoxing's open book.
passionate:0.cnHint: 晓星是最____的弟子，她念每个字草时都带着渴望。
passionate:0.hook: The red leaf had no tree to fall from — the nearest branch was a mountain away.
passionate:0.line: 'Be *passionate*, yes — but passion without patience will crack the vessel.'

pop:0.en: I pressed the word-seal too hard. With a sharp *pop*, the ink burst from the brush and spattered the desk in small dark stars. Shen Wujiu did not laugh. He handed me a clean cloth and said, 'Good. Now you know where the limit is.' A thin curl of smoke rose from the ink and spelled nothing — or something I could not yet read.
pop:0.cnHint: 我用力过猛，笔下的字印发出一声____，墨水四溅。
pop:0.hook: The smoke curled into a shape I would only understand three lessons later.
pop:0.line: 'Every *pop* you hear is the word telling you it has its own will.'

possibly:0.en: The door of the inner library had been locked for a season. Master Qingwu stood before it and said, 'One of you may *possibly* open it — not with force, but with the right word spoken at the right breath.' I felt the key-word rise in my throat, half-formed. The lock shivered, just once, like a sleeping thing aware of being watched.
possibly:0.cnHint: 师尊说，我们中有人____能用正确的字打开内库之门。
possibly:0.hook: The lock shivered — and then went very, very still.
possibly:0.line: 'You can *possibly* read that formula already; trust what your breath knows.'

previously:0.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a worn study scroll. 'I have *previously* marked the lines that carry hidden weight,' he said. Sure enough, faint notches of fingernail pressed into the bamboo strips showed where he had paused, long ago, in the same confusion I felt now. At the bottom of the scroll, a smudge of old ink formed the shape of a closed eye.
previously:0.cnHint: 师兄说，他____在这份旧卷上标出了最重要的字行。
previously:0.hook: The closed-eye smudge blinked — or the candlelight simply moved. I chose not to decide.
previously:0.line: 'I *previously* made every error you are making now — that is why I can guide you.'

profession:0.en: 'What did you do before you came here?' Xiaoxing asked me as we ground dried word-herbs together. I told her I had no *profession* — only a habit of listening to the wind. She smiled at that. Master Qingwu, passing behind us, spoke without turning: 'Listening to the wind is the oldest profession in this sect.' The grinding bowl hummed a low note by itself.
profession:0.cnHint: 晓星问我入门前的____，师尊的回答让整个研钵发出了共鸣。
profession:0.hook: The bowl's hum matched the note the mountain made at dawn — exactly.
profession:0.line: 'In this sect, learning to hear is itself a *profession* — and the hardest one.'

readily:0.en: Most students struggled to call up the light-step formula, but Xiaoxing *readily* spoke the opening syllable each morning, bright as a match struck in a dark room. Shen Wujiu told me not to compare my pace to hers. That evening I found a folded note on my pillow in Master Qingwu's hand: 'Slow roots hold the tallest mountain.' Frost formed on the window though the season was warm.
readily:0.cnHint: 晓星总能____地说出起步咒的开头，我却还在挣扎。
readily:0.hook: Frost on a warm-season window is the sect's oldest sign — of change coming fast.
readily:0.line: 'She speaks so *readily* because she has failed that line more times than you know.'

somewhat:0.en: The study hall smelled of old wood and dried herbs. Master Qingwu placed a single scroll before me and said nothing. I unrolled it slowly. The characters inside glowed *somewhat* brighter than ordinary ink — not blinding, but alive, as if each word breathed with a quiet light of its own. I copied the first line with a trembling brush.
somewhat:0.cnHint: 我在书房展开一卷古老的卷轴，发现里面的文字____比普通墨水更亮。
somewhat:0.hook: Behind me, the candle flame bent toward the scroll without any wind.
somewhat:0.line: 'The glow is *somewhat* stronger tonight,' Master Qingwu said, eyes never leaving the page.

stable:0.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the center of the practice hall, feet still, breath even. 'Watch the word for wind,' he said. 'Hold it in your mind until it feels *stable* — like a stone resting on flat ground, not rolling, not shifting.' I tried. For three breaths the character held its shape. Then it slipped, and the window shutters flew open with a sharp crack.
stable:0.cnHint: 师兄教我在心中稳住风字诀，保持它____，但我一走神，窗户就猛地弹开了。
stable:0.hook: From somewhere below the clouds, a low horn sounded — once, then silence.
stable:0.line: 'Keep your mind *stable* or the word will choose its own direction,' Shen Wujiu warned.

vigorous:0.en: Inside the Hall of First Light, Master Qingwu moved her brush across the practice board with *vigorous* strokes, each line releasing a faint green glow. 'Your roots are shallow,' she said, not looking up. 'A weak foundation cannot hold a flying spirit.' The candle flames all bent toward her at once.
vigorous:0.cnHint: 在初光殿，师尊用____的笔法在练习板上书写，每一道线条都释放出微弱的绿光。
vigorous:0.hook: Every candle in the hall bent toward her writing hand.
vigorous:0.line: 'A *vigorous* stroke is not force — it is a spirit that refuses to be still.'

wide:0.en: The archive room held shelves that stretched beyond sight, filled with scrolls of every herb and formula known to the Cloud Sea Sect. Shen Wujiu spread his arms and said the collection was *wide* enough to fill a lifetime of study. I pulled out one scroll and the room seemed to breathe.
wide:0.cnHint: 档案室的书架延伸得看不到头，师兄说这里的收藏____得足以填满一生的学习。
wide:0.hook: The scroll I opened began to read me back.
wide:0.line: 'The world of words is *wide* — do not mistake the first shelf for the whole room.'

agriculture:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a map showing how the outer disciples tended floating fields of spirit-grain. 'Before flying, you must learn *agriculture*,' she said. 'Every herb we use in a formula was once a seed someone chose to plant and protect.' Soil from those fields, I noticed, smelled faintly of lightning.
agriculture:0.cnHint: 师尊展开一张地图，讲解外门弟子如何耕种灵谷，她说学飞升之前要先懂____。
agriculture:0.hook: The soil sample on her desk smelled faintly of lightning.
agriculture:0.line: '*Agriculture* is the first chapter of power — even clouds begin as water in the ground.'

assign:0.en: On the morning of my third day, Master Qingwu stood at the front of the inner hall and began to *assign* each disciple a single herb to memorise before nightfall. When she reached me, she paused longer than she had for anyone else, then named a herb I had never heard spoken aloud.
assign:0.cnHint: 第三天清晨，师尊开始向每位弟子____一株需要在天黑前记熟的灵草，轮到我时她停顿了很久。
assign:0.hook: She named an herb that had no entry in any archive scroll.
assign:0.line: 'I *assign* you this herb because its name has waited a long time for the right voice.'

broad:0.en: The reading table in the inner chamber was *broad* enough for six open scrolls at once, and Xiaoxing had filled every space with diagrams of root patterns. She waved me over without looking up, pointing to a gap in the centre where one diagram was clearly missing. A single feather lay there instead.
broad:0.cnHint: 内室的阅览桌宽阔得能同时摆六卷书，师妹把每处空间都铺满了根系图，但中央____处只有一根羽毛。
broad:0.hook: The feather on the table was still warm.
broad:0.line: 'A *broad* table means nothing if you leave the most important scroll off it.'

careful:0.en: Xiaoxing held the ink brush above the formula scroll for a long moment before touching it to the surface. 'You must be *careful*,' she whispered, 'because one wrong character does not simply fail — it reverses.' I watched her hand. It was perfectly still, and yet the ink moved as if alive.
careful:0.cnHint: 师妹将笔悬在功法卷轴上方许久，说落笔时必须____，因为一个错误的字不只是失败，而是逆转。
careful:0.hook: The ink moved on its own before her brush touched down.
careful:0.line: 'Be *careful* here — this character has swallowed the strength of three disciples before you.'

combination:0.en: Master Qingwu placed two herb jars side by side and asked which *combination* of the two could open a sealed meridian. Shen Wujiu answered at once, but she shook her head slowly. 'Correct ingredients,' she said, 'wrong order.' The jars clinked against each other, though no one had touched them.
combination:0.cnHint: 师尊将两只草药罐并排放置，问哪种____能打开封闭的经脉，师兄答对了材料，却答错了顺序。
combination:0.hook: The two jars clinked together, though no hand was near them.
combination:0.line: 'The right *combination* is not only what — it is always when and in what order.'

constant:0.en: Above the study desk hung a small wind-chime made of carved bone, and its sound was *constant* through every lesson, never stopping, never changing pitch. Shen Wujiu told me it had rung without pause for forty years. That evening, for the first time, it went silent between one breath and the next.
constant:0.cnHint: 书桌上方悬挂着一只骨雕风铃，四十年来声音____不断，但那天傍晚它在两次呼吸之间第一次沉默了。
constant:0.hook: Forty years of sound stopped between one breath and the next.
constant:0.line: 'A *constant* sound is easy to ignore — listen hardest the moment it ends.'

couple:0.en: Inside the scripture hall, a *couple* of jade slips rested on the stone table — one carved with wind formulas, one with water. Master Qingwu said only a disciple who could hold both without trembling had earned the right to ascend. I reached out. My hands did not shake.
couple:0.cnHint: 藏经阁中，我尝试同时握住两枚玉简，以证明自己有资格____。
couple:0.hook: But the slips began to glow, and the light was red.
couple:0.line: 'A *couple* of slips — yet together they carry the weight of heaven.'

definition:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an ancient scroll across the altar. The first line read: a word without a *definition* is like a herb without a root — it may look alive, yet it holds no power. I copied those words into my own scroll and felt something stir in the ink.
definition:0.cnHint: 师尊展开古卷，告诉我没有____的词语如同无根之草，毫无力量。
definition:0.hook: Then the ink on my copy rose from the page.
definition:0.line: 'Without a clear *definition*, even your strongest formula will dissolve.'

imagination:0.en: Shen Wujiu sat beside the inner window, shaping clouds of pale light with two fingers. 'Cultivation begins in the mind,' he said quietly. 'Every great technique was first only *imagination* — a picture held so firmly it became real.' Outside, snow fell on the courtyard stones in perfect silence.
imagination:0.cnHint: 师兄在窗边用手指塑造光云，说一切修炼都起源于____。
imagination:0.hook: The pale cloud he shaped slowly took the form of a face.
imagination:0.line: 'Pure *imagination*, held long enough, becomes the world itself.'

journey:0.en: Before dawn I entered the archive room to read the records of past disciples. Each one had marked the start of their *journey* with a single pressed herb tucked between the pages — wild mint, dry lotus, mountain pine. I turned to a blank page and placed a cloud-fern there, still wet with dew.
journey:0.cnHint: 我在案卷室翻阅前辈记录，用一株云蕨标记自己____的起点。
journey:0.hook: The fern turned silver the moment it touched the paper.
journey:0.line: 'Every *journey* toward the sky leaves a mark below.'

nearby:0.en: I had been grinding spirit-ash for an hour when Xiaoxing appeared at the doorway. She pointed to a shelf *nearby* where three labeled jars stood in a neat row. 'The formula already calls for those,' she said with a small smile. I had been grinding the wrong herb the whole time.
nearby:0.cnHint: 我费力研磨药灰时，师妹指着____的架子，告诉我我磨错了材料。
nearby:0.hook: I looked at the jars — the labels were written in my own hand.
nearby:0.line: 'There is a jar *nearby* that holds exactly what the formula needs.'

perspective:0.en: Master Qingwu led me to the high reading loft above the main hall. From that *perspective* the whole sect below looked like a diagram in a book — every path, garden, and gate fitting together as one pattern. 'A disciple who cannot see the whole,' she said, 'will always be lost in the part.'
perspective:0.cnHint: 师尊带我登上高阁，从那个____俯瞰整个宗门的布局。
perspective:0.hook: In the pattern below, one gate stood open that should have been sealed.
perspective:0.line: 'Change your *perspective*, and the path you feared will become clear.'

requirement:0.en: The hall of records listed every *requirement* for the rite of ascent on a single brass plate: three sealed formulas, one witnessed healing, and a name spoken aloud by the master herself. I had fulfilled two. The third line seemed to watch me as I read it, patient and cold.
requirement:0.cnHint: 升天仪式的每一项____都刻在铜牌上，我已完成其中两项。
requirement:0.hook: Someone had scratched a fourth line into the brass — recently.
requirement:0.line: 'The final *requirement* is one no scroll can teach you to meet.'

signal:0.en: Xiaoxing pressed her palm flat against the study door, and the carved crane on the wood seemed to shiver. 'When the crane moves on its own,' she whispered, 'it is meant to *signal* that someone above has chosen to look down at us.' We both held our breath and waited.
signal:0.cnHint: 师妹说门上的仙鹤若自行震动，便是____有人在上方注视我们。
signal:0.hook: The crane's carved eye slowly turned toward me alone.
signal:0.line: 'The crane will *signal* us — we only need the patience to wait.'

himself:0.en: Before the morning bell rang, Shen Wujiu stood alone in the Hall of First Words, copying each spirit formula slowly onto a fresh strip of bark. Master Qingwu had offered to guide him, but Shen Wujiu chose to face the task *himself*, pressing each stroke with quiet certainty. A single candle threw long shadows across the shelves.
himself:0.cnHint: 师兄独自在藏字堂中抄录灵文，拒绝了旁人的帮助，____完成了这项功课。
himself:0.hook: The candle went out, though no wind had entered the hall.
himself:0.line: 'I must carry this burden *himself* — no other hand should trace these words.'

landscape:0.en: Xiaoxing unrolled an ancient scroll across the low table. Instead of formulas, it held a painted *landscape*: pale cliffs, dark pines, and a narrow bridge of cloud stretching toward a gate no living disciple had yet crossed. Master Qingwu said the image was both map and warning, nothing more.
landscape:0.cnHint: 小星展开一幅古卷，发现里面绘有一幅____，据说既是地图，也是警示。
landscape:0.hook: The painted gate in the scroll was slightly more open than yesterday.
landscape:0.line: 'This *landscape* holds the path — and the price of walking it.'

mentally:0.en: The inner trial required no sword and no flame. Each disciple sat still while spirit questions rose like smoke inside the mind. I pressed my palms flat and prepared *mentally*, repeating the root sounds of every herb I had learned. Xiaoxing beside me breathed slowly, her face as calm as still water.
mentally:0.cnHint: 内心考验开始前，弟子们____做好准备，在脑中默诵所有草药的根音。
mentally:0.hook: One disciple opened her eyes too soon, and her scroll turned to ash.
mentally:0.line: 'Ready *mentally* first — the trial reads your thoughts before your words.'

neither:0.en: Master Qingwu placed two vials on the stone desk: one held silver dew, one held ember dust. She told me *neither* was safe to swallow alone, yet together they could open the highest meridian. I looked at them for a long moment, unsure whether her words were an instruction or a test.
neither:0.cnHint: 师尊将两瓶灵药摆在桌上，说____单独服下都有危险，但合在一起或可打通最高经脉。
neither:0.hook: Both vials began to tremble, though my hands had not moved.
neither:0.line: '*Neither* path is without cost — you must choose with clear eyes.'

onto:0.en: Shen Wujiu pressed the glowing spirit seal firmly *onto* the blank page, transferring the entire formula in one breath. The ink spread like roots drinking water, and each character settled with a soft chime. Master Qingwu watched from the doorway, nodding only once before turning away without a word.
onto:0.cnHint: 师兄将灵印按____空白页上，一口气将完整的灵文传印其中。
onto:0.hook: The last character on the page shifted into a shape no one had taught.
onto:0.line: 'Press the seal *onto* the page — hesitation will break the transfer.'

plus:0.en: To brew the calming draft, I needed three measures of moonleaf *plus* a pinch of hollow bark. I counted every grain carefully, because Master Qingwu had warned that one measure too many would turn healing into harm. The small clay pot hummed on the warming stone as I stirred without stopping.
plus:0.cnHint: 熬制安神汤时，我需要三份月叶____一撮空心树皮，分量必须精确。
plus:0.hook: The humming of the pot suddenly rose to a sharp, clear note.
plus:0.line: 'Three measures of moonleaf *plus* hollow bark — and not one grain more.'

root:0.en: The first lesson in the Hall of First Words was not a word at all. Master Qingwu drew a single character on the air and said it was the *root* from which every healing formula grew. Without it, she told us, all other words were only noise — bright sounds with no earth beneath them.
root:0.cnHint: 第一堂课上，师尊说这个字是所有疗愈灵文的____，失去它，其余的字都不过是无根之声。
root:0.hook: When she erased the character, a low wind moved through the sealed hall.
root:0.line: 'Learn this *root* first — every formula you know grows from here.'

satisfy:0.en: I placed my completed herb chart before Master Qingwu and waited. She studied each row without expression, tracing lines with one finger. After a long silence, she said the work was enough to *satisfy* the sect requirement, though her eyes suggested she expected more from me before the season turned.
satisfy:0.cnHint: 我将完成的草药图呈给师尊，她说内容勉强能____门规的要求，但眼神中似乎另有期待。
satisfy:0.hook: She set the chart face-down, and a faint warmth rose from beneath it.
satisfy:0.line: 'This is enough to *satisfy* the rule — but you are capable of far more.'

consultant:0.en: Master Qingwu spread a scroll across the stone table and studied it in silence. 'We have asked a *consultant* from the Eastern Peak,' she said at last, 'one who has read every word-herb recorded since the Sect was founded. Even she cannot name what bloomed last night on the outer terrace.' The candle flame did not move, yet its shadow did.
consultant:0.cnHint: 师尊说，来自东峰的____也无法辨认昨夜外台上开放的那株词草。
consultant:0.hook: The shadow pointed, slowly, toward the inner hall.
consultant:0.line: 'The *consultant* has read every scroll we own, and still she has no answer.'

direct:0.en: Shen Wujiu placed his hand flat on the training room floor and drew a single, *direct* line of silver light from the door to the central pillar. 'A word-path must not curve,' he told me. 'Doubt bends it. Fear bends it. Only a clear mind keeps it straight.' The line held — then dimmed at the exact midpoint.
direct:0.cnHint: 师兄在修炼室地板上画出一条____的银色词路，但它在中点处暗淡下去了。
direct:0.hook: Whatever waited at the midpoint had swallowed the light.
direct:0.line: 'Keep your intention *direct*, or the formula will fold back on itself.'

discourage:0.en: 'I will not *discourage* you from attempting the third tier,' Master Qingwu said, folding her hands inside her sleeves. 'But I will tell you what I saw the last time a first-year disciple tried: the word-herbs turned to ash before the second breath.' She said it gently, without looking away. Outside, a single cloud rose instead of falling.
discourage:0.cnHint: 师尊并不____我尝试第三阶，但她讲述了上次的结局——词草化为灰烬。
discourage:0.hook: The rising cloud carried the faint scent of ash.
discourage:0.line: 'I do not wish to *discourage* you — I wish you to understand the cost.'

essentially:0.en: Xiaoxing set three word-herb jars side by side and tapped each lid in turn. 'They look different,' she said, 'but they are *essentially* the same root, only dried in different seasons. The Sect calls them by three names to honor the elders who found them separately.' She smiled, then stopped. One jar had sealed itself shut overnight.
essentially:0.cnHint: 师妹解释说这三种词草____来自同一根源，只是采摘季节不同，但其中一个罐子昨夜自己封上了。
essentially:0.hook: No hand had touched the jar since dusk.
essentially:0.line: 'These three herbs are *essentially* one — the old names just hide that truth.'

extent:0.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long chart of the Cloud Sea Sect's word-herb garden. 'You cannot know the full *extent* of a formula's power until you have spoken it at the edge of the mountain, where the wind takes the words and returns something unexpected.' I looked at the chart. The garden's edge was marked only with a question — no line, no border.
extent:0.cnHint: 师尊说，只有站在山崖边才能知晓词方力量的____，地图上那片区域只标着一个问号。
extent:0.hook: The question mark on the chart had been drawn in fresh ink.
extent:0.line: 'The *extent* of this formula's reach is something no chart can show you.'

finance:0.en: Shen Wujiu spread a row of spirit-coins across the table beside a stack of word-herb receipts. 'The outer hall does not *finance* our research out of kindness,' he said quietly. 'Every rare herb we use is counted, and the debt is paid in service.' He gathered the coins slowly. One was cold to the touch, though the room was warm.
finance:0.cnHint: 师兄说外堂并非出于好意____我们的研究，每一株珍稀词草都被计入债务，以服务偿还。
finance:0.hook: The cold coin bore no mark on either face.
finance:0.line: 'The outer hall will no longer *finance* our experiments after the next full moon.'

freedom:0.en: 'Here, inside the word-garden, you have *freedom* to speak any formula aloud,' Xiaoxing told me, spreading her arms wide. 'The walls hold the sound. Nothing escapes, nothing answers from outside.' She laughed softly, and the herbs around us leaned toward her voice. Then the wall to the north gave a slow, low hum none of us had heard before.
freedom:0.cnHint: 师妹说词草园内我们有____大声念出任何词方，四壁会留住声音——但北墙突然发出了低鸣。
freedom:0.hook: The hum grew one note lower with each breath we took.
freedom:0.line: 'Within this garden you have *freedom* to speak every word you fear outside.'

highlight:0.en: Master Qingwu drew a brush slowly down the page of the ancient formula scroll, pausing to *highlight* a single phrase near the bottom. 'Most disciples skip this line,' she said. 'They think it is only decoration. It is not.' She lifted the brush. The highlighted phrase glowed for one breath, then faded — and the scroll rolled itself closed.
highlight:0.cnHint: 师尊用笔____了古老词方卷轴底部的一行字，说大多数弟子都忽略了它，随后卷轴自己合上了。
highlight:0.hook: No one in the room had touched the scroll's edge.
highlight:0.line: 'I *highlight* this phrase because it is the one line that changes everything.'

invite:1.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, Master Qingwu spread her arms toward the sky. 'Every disciple who reaches this step,' she said, 'may *invite* the wind itself to carry them upward.' I stepped forward, heart lifting, and felt the air stir beneath my feet like a living thing.
invite:1.cnHint: 师尊在露台上告诉我，只要走到这一步，就可以____风来托举自己飞升。
invite:1.hook: But the wind that answered was cold, and it came from below.
invite:1.line: 'I *invite* the wind to lift you — step forward without fear.'

million:1.en: From the high terrace I looked down and saw a sea of clouds stretching in every direction, vast beyond counting. Shen Wujiu stood beside me and said a *million* years of spiritual energy had gathered here, pressed into the rock beneath our feet, waiting for someone worthy to release it.
million:1.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，脚下的岩石中积聚了____年的灵气，等待有缘人将其释放。
million:1.hook: A crack ran silently across the stone between us.
million:1.line: 'A *million* years of power sleeps under this very rock.'

represent:1.en: Master Qingwu handed me a single white feather and said it would *represent* my bond with Cloud Sea Sect when I rose above the clouds. I held it carefully. Xiaoxing watched from the path below, hands pressed together, eyes bright with something between hope and worry.
represent:1.cnHint: 师尊交给我一根白羽，说它将在我飞升时____我与云海宗的缘分。
represent:1.hook: The feather trembled, though the air was perfectly still.
represent:1.line: 'This feather will *represent* your place among us, high or low.'

surprise:1.en: I had trained for this morning, yet the actual moment of rising brought real *surprise* — the clouds parted in a circle around me, as if the sky were curious. Shen Wujiu called up from below, but his voice came too softly to hear through the rushing air.
surprise:1.cnHint: 真正起飞的瞬间带给了我真实的____，云层像好奇一样在我周围散开。
surprise:1.hook: In the gap the clouds left, something dark was already watching.
surprise:1.line: 'Your face shows such *surprise* — did you doubt your own power?'

topic:1.en: Before the ascent, a small crowd of outer disciples gathered on the stone steps. The *topic* on every tongue was whether I could cross the boundary between earth and sky before noon. Xiaoxing alone said nothing; she simply placed a warm stone in my palm and walked away.
topic:1.cnHint: 外门弟子们聚集在石阶上，人人嘴里的____都是我能否在正午前突破天地之界。
topic:1.hook: Noon came, and the sun cast no shadow where I stood.
topic:1.line: 'The only *topic* worth discussing today is whether you are ready.'

meat:1.en: The morning meal before a great ascent is always plain: no *meat*, no strong taste, only clear broth and river-grain. Master Qingwu said rich food weighs the spirit down like wet cloth. I ate slowly in the courtyard, watching a single cloud drift past the gate.
meat:1.cnHint: 飞升前的早膳十分清淡，不含____，师尊说厚味会压制灵识。
meat:1.hook: The cloud at the gate stopped moving and held its shape.
meat:1.line: 'Eat no *meat* this morning — your spirit must be light as mist.'

drink:1.en: At the foot of the ascent platform, Xiaoxing offered a small cup of dew collected from the highest peak. 'You must *drink* before you rise,' she said quietly. The liquid tasted of cold stone and pine. My vision sharpened, and the clouds above seemed suddenly close enough to touch.
drink:1.cnHint: 小星在飞升台前递给我一杯高峰晨露，说我必须____了它再起飞。
drink:1.hook: The pine taste turned sweet — and sweetness was not what she had promised.
drink:1.line: '*Drink* this before you rise, and the sky will know your name.'

sleep:1.en: The night before my ascent I could not find *sleep*. I sat outside on the cold stone steps, watching the floating mountains drift slowly through the dark, their lights blinking like careful eyes. Shen Wujiu found me there at dawn and said nothing — he simply sat down beside me.
sleep:1.cnHint: 飞升前夜，我久久无法____，只是坐在石阶上望着漂浮的山峦在黑暗中移动。
sleep:1.hook: At first light, one distant mountain had moved much closer.
sleep:1.line: 'You found no *sleep* last night — I heard you on the steps.'

thinking:1.en: On the stone path winding between the market stalls of the lower peak, I paused before a vendor selling pressed herb scrolls. My *thinking* grew still — each scroll held a single word, and I suddenly understood that choosing the wrong one could seal a path forever. Shen Wujiu watched me from the corner, silent.
thinking:1.cnHint: 我在摊位前停下脚步，开始深入____，意识到选错草药卷轴可能封闭一条修炼之路。
thinking:1.hook: The vendor's eyes had not blinked once since I arrived.
thinking:1.line: 'Your *thinking* must be clear before your hand moves,' said Shen Wujiu.

cover:1.en: A sudden wind swept through the open market on the eastern ridge path, scattering loose word-petals across the stone tiles. I moved fast to *cover* the rarest herb scroll with my sleeve before the wind could carry its syllables away. One lost word, Master Qingwu had said, means one lost year.
cover:1.cnHint: 一阵风吹来，我迅速用衣袖____住最珍贵的草药卷轴，防止其中的音节被风带走。
cover:1.hook: But one petal had already lifted into the cloud sea below.
cover:1.line: '*Cover* it now — that word does not grow twice,' Xiaoxing urged.

earth:1.en: At the foot of the sect's outer gate, where the floating mountain met the old stone steps, a thin layer of dark soil clung to the rock. An elder had once planted a word-seed here, letting it draw from the *earth* itself. I knelt and pressed my palm flat against that small patch of ground.
earth:1.cnHint: 在山门外，我跪下触摸那片泥土，那里曾经种下过一颗字种，从____中汲取力量。
earth:1.hook: Beneath my hand, something answered with a faint, slow pulse.
earth:1.line: 'The *earth* remembers every word ever planted in it,' Master Qingwu said softly.

paper:1.en: Xiaoxing spread a single sheet of *paper* on the low market table and pressed a glowing word-seal onto its surface. The character bloomed like ink in water, spreading into the grain of the sheet. Around us, other disciples leaned in, knowing that what was written here would bind under cloud and sky alike.
paper:1.cnHint: 小星把一个发光的字印按在____上，字符像墨水一样在纸张纹理中绽放开来。
paper:1.hook: The seal cooled — then the paper rose half an inch off the table on its own.
paper:1.line: 'This *paper* holds the word only if your intent is honest,' said Xiaoxing.

art:1.en: On the wide terrace outside the herb exchange, a senior disciple demonstrated the *art* of word-weaving for a small crowd. Her fingers shaped the syllables like silk threads, pulling each one taut before releasing it into a pattern that glowed above her open palms. I watched every movement and forgot to breathe.
art:1.cnHint: 在草药交易所外的平台上，一位师兄展示了编织字符的____，她的手指将音节塑造成发光的图案。
art:1.hook: When the pattern dissolved, it left a single new symbol none of us recognised.
art:1.line: 'The *art* takes a season to learn and a lifetime to trust,' she said, not looking up.

street:1.en: The outer *street* of the lower market curved along the mountain's edge, lined with stalls selling bottled echoes and dried tone-herbs. I walked it slowly, reading every sign, until I found the one stall with no sign at all. Shen Wujiu had told me to look for exactly that.
street:1.cnHint: 我沿着山腰的集市____缓慢行走，寻找那个没有招牌的摊位，师兄说那才是真正的目标。
street:1.hook: The stall keeper turned before I had made a single sound.
street:1.line: 'Everyone on this *street* is watching who stops and who walks past,' Shen Wujiu warned.

talent:1.en: Outside the testing hall, posted on a wooden board beside the main path, were the names of disciples whose *talent* for word-craft had passed the first measure. My name was not there. Xiaoxing found me staring and stood beside me without speaking, which felt, somehow, like the right thing.
talent:1.cnHint: 在测试大厅外的木牌上，公布了字符天赋通过初测的弟子名单，但我的名字并不在上面。
talent:1.hook: At the very bottom of the board, someone had added a name in a different ink.
talent:1.line: '*Talent* is only the door — you still have to walk through it,' Xiaoxing said at last.

overall:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the centre of the open courtyard and looked out at the row of new disciples along the path. Her gaze moved slowly from face to face. The *overall* shape of our formation told her something the individual scores could not — which of us had already begun to think as one body, not as scattered seeds.
overall:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊审视着弟子们的整体队形，这种____的观察揭示了个人成绩无法反映的东西。
overall:1.hook: Her eyes paused on me one breath longer than on anyone else.
overall:1.line: 'The *overall* pattern matters more than any single word,' said Master Qingwu.

shop:1.en: At the base of the outer peak, a narrow *shop* stood between two stone walls, its wooden shelves heavy with bundled spirit-herbs and sealed clay jars. The keeper, an old woman with ink-stained fingers, pressed a small pouch into my hand without a word. Inside were three dried leaves — each one a syllable of the flying formula. I had not asked for them.
shop:1.cnHint: 在山脚的____里，老板娘无声地将三片草药塞进了我的手中。
shop:1.hook: The door behind me swung shut before I had taken a single step.
shop:1.line: 'This *shop* holds words that are not yet yours — but soon will be,' said Master Qingwu.

electronic:1.en: Shen Wujiu spread a thin jade tablet on the stone table outside the archive hall. 'We do not carve here,' he said softly. 'The sect records its formulas in an *electronic* pattern, a living pulse within the jade.' I pressed my fingertip to the surface and felt syllables bloom under my skin like warm light. The tablet shivered once, then went dark.
electronic:1.cnHint: 师兄向我展示了存储功法的____玉简，我触碰它的瞬间感受到了文字的律动。
electronic:1.hook: Every word I had just absorbed began to hum at once inside my chest.
electronic:1.line: 'An *electronic* pattern in jade holds more truth than ten thousand carved stones,' Shen Wujiu said.

wild:1.en: Beyond the sect's tended terraces, the hillside turned *wild* — vines crossing the path, roots lifting the flagstones, spirit-herbs growing in shapes no master had planned. Xiaoxing knelt beside a crooked purple stalk and whispered its name three times until it leaned toward her. I tried the same word and the plant turned away. The wind carried a low, amused sound from somewhere above.
wild:1.cnHint: 在山坡____的地方，师妹三次低语便让一株灵草向她弯腰，而我的尝试却以失败告终。
wild:1.hook: A second purple stalk rose from the soil where none had grown before.
wild:1.line: 'Only a *wild* herb teaches you what the tended ones will not,' Xiaoxing said with a small smile.

rich:1.en: The morning market spread across the Cloud Bridge, every stall piled with jars whose labels were single words in old script. Master Qingwu moved slowly, reading each one. 'The soil of the eastern peak is *rich* with forgotten syllables,' she said, lifting a jar of dark, loamy powder. 'One pinch on the tongue and a buried formula surfaces like a fish.' I bought the last jar before she could set it down.
rich:1.cnHint: 晨市上，师尊说东峰的土壤____蕴含着失传音节，一捏入口便能唤醒埋藏的功法。
rich:1.hook: The jar grew warm in my pocket, as though something inside it was already waking.
rich:1.line: 'The *rich* earth of the eastern peak has not forgotten a single word,' Master Qingwu said.

special:1.en: Outside the hall of first rites, new disciples received plain grey robes. Then Master Qingwu stopped before me and held out a robe with a single silver thread along the collar. 'This is no reward,' she said calmly. 'It marks a *special* duty — you will carry the sect's seed-word to the lower cloud when the time comes.' Shen Wujiu and Xiaoxing exchanged a quick, unreadable glance.
special:1.cnHint: 入门仪式后，师尊交给我一件有银线领口的衣袍，说这标志着一项____使命。
special:1.hook: The silver thread pulsed once, faintly, like a second heartbeat.

text:1.en: The notice board at the sect gate held dozens of paper strips, each one a short *text* of three or four lines — practice assignments, warnings, invitations to healing trials. I read every strip twice. Near the bottom, half-covered by a newer sheet, one line stopped me: my name, written in Master Qingwu's hand, beside a word I had never studied. The assignment had no date.
text:1.cnHint: 门口告示板上贴满短小的____，最下方有一条写着我名字和一个陌生词语的纸条，没有日期。
text:1.hook: When I reached for the strip, it slipped from the board and floated upward into the clouds.
text:1.line: 'Read every *text* on that board before you sleep — one of them will answer a question you have not yet asked,' said Master Qingwu.

front:1.en: The morning drill formed us in a long line on the terrace, and Master Qingwu placed me at the *front* — the position closest to the open sky and the long drop into cloud. 'Speak the lift-word from here,' she said. The wind was sharp. Behind me I could feel Shen Wujiu and Xiaoxing holding still, waiting. My mouth opened and the word came out steadier than I had expected.
front:1.cnHint: 晨练时师尊让我站在队伍的____，面对开阔的天空，要求我在众人注视中吟诵升腾咒。
front:1.hook: The terrace stone beneath my feet trembled and began, very slowly, to rise.
front:1.line: 'Standing at the *front* is not an honour — it is a test of what your voice will do when the sky is watching,' said Master Qingwu.

law:1.en: Shen Wujiu found me copying the sect's oldest charter outside the archive. 'Careful,' he said, crouching beside me. 'The first *law* of that charter is not a rule — it is a living word. Copy it wrongly and the page corrects your hand.' I had thought the faint warmth in my brush was the afternoon sun. Now I was not sure. I set the brush down and read the line again very slowly.
law:1.cnHint: 师兄提醒我，古老章程的第一条____是活的文字——誊写有误，纸页会自行纠正你的手。
law:1.hook: The brush rose an inch off the table, pointing at the word I had just misread.
law:1.line: 'The first *law* of our sect was written by the mountain itself — no human hand put it there,' Shen Wujiu said.

satisfaction:1.en: At dawn, I carried a basket of word-seeds to the outer terrace and planted each one in the pale soil between the clouds. When the last seed was set, a soft warmth filled my chest — the quiet *satisfaction* of a task done well, with nothing left undone. Shen Wujiu watched from the gate and gave a single nod.
satisfaction:1.cnHint: 我把每一粒字种种入云间土壤，内心升起一种____的暖意。
satisfaction:1.hook: But the soil began to glow — and no one had told me it could do that.
satisfaction:1.line: 'There is no greater *satisfaction* than watching your own words take root,' said Shen Wujiu.

cultivate:1.en: Master Qingwu led us to the terraced word-fields on the east ridge before sunrise. 'You cannot rush a healing formula,' she said. 'You must *cultivate* it slowly, the way a farmer tends young shoots.' I pressed my palms into the warm soil and felt the words stir beneath my fingers like something alive.
cultivate:1.cnHint: 师尊教导我们要慢慢____那些字，就像农人照料嫩芽一样。
cultivate:1.hook: Then one shoot turned black at the tip, and the morning went very still.
cultivate:1.line: 'We *cultivate* these words for years before they are ready to fly,' said Master Qingwu.

productive:1.en: Xiaoxing and I spent the morning copying flight-formulas onto stone tablets at the open-air study court. By noon we had filled six tablets — the most *productive* session I had seen since joining the sect. Xiaoxing set her brush down and smiled without saying anything, and the clouds below the court shifted into the shape of open wings.
productive:1.cnHint: 晓星和我在露天书院度过了一个____的早晨，写满了六块石板。
productive:1.hook: Then the wings in the clouds folded shut, all at once.
productive:1.line: 'This is the most *productive* morning we have had all season,' Xiaoxing said softly.

vision:1.en: Standing at the cliff edge of the outer platform, I looked out across the endless sea of clouds. Master Qingwu stood beside me and spoke of the sect's oldest purpose. 'A healer without *vision* sees only the wound,' she said. 'We see the person who will stand again.' Far below, something dark moved under the white surface.
vision:1.cnHint: 师尊站在悬崖边，告诉我没有____的医者只能看见伤口本身。
vision:1.hook: Whatever moved beneath the clouds was rising, and it was rising fast.
vision:1.line: 'Without *vision*, even the strongest formula will miss its mark,' Master Qingwu said.

distance:1.en: Shen Wujiu pointed to a peak barely visible through the morning haze and told me to read the word carved at its summit without moving a single step. 'Words lose nothing over *distance*,' he said, 'if you have trained your eye.' I stared until the carved character sharpened — and then, with a crack like thunder, the peak began to lean.
distance:1.cnHint: 师兄叫我隔着____辨认远山顶上刻着的字。
distance:1.hook: The peak leaned closer, as though it wanted to be read.
distance:1.line: 'A true disciple can read any word across any *distance*,' Shen Wujiu said.

forward:1.en: After the midday bell, I joined the line of disciples crossing the sky-bridge to the next mountain. Each plank underfoot was carved with a different word. Master Qingwu had told us: do not look down, keep moving *forward*, let the words beneath your feet rise through your soles. I kept my eyes on the far gate — until the bridge behind me began to dissolve, plank by plank.
forward:1.cnHint: 师尊叫我们脚踏刻字木板，目视____方，不要低头看云海。
forward:1.hook: The gate ahead flickered once, like a candle in wind.
forward:1.line: 'Keep your eyes *forward* — the bridge only holds for those who believe it will,' said Master Qingwu.

harmful:1.en: Xiaoxing caught me mixing two word-seeds from different rows and stepped in quickly. 'That combination is *harmful*,' she said, brushing the seeds apart with care. 'Together they produce heat instead of light.' I looked at my hands, suddenly aware of how much I did not yet know. A thin line of smoke rose from the separated seeds and curled into the shape of a warning sign.
harmful:1.cnHint: 晓星阻止了我，说那两种字种混在一起是____的，会产生热而非光。
harmful:1.hook: The smoke sign hung in the air far longer than smoke should.
harmful:1.line: 'Mixing those two is *harmful* — heat without light heals nothing,' Xiaoxing said.

impossible:1.en: At dusk, an elder from another sect passed through our gate and declared that no first-year disciple could ever speak a flight-formula aloud and be heard. Shen Wujiu leaned close and said quietly, 'Nothing is truly *impossible* in this sect — only untested.' That night, from somewhere deep in the cloud sea below, a voice rose, clear and young, speaking the oldest flight-formula of all.
impossible:1.cnHint: 师兄悄声告诉我，在这门派里没有什么是真正____的，只是尚未被试验。
impossible:1.hook: The voice below had no body that anyone could find.
impossible:1.line: 'They call it *impossible* only because they stopped trying too soon,' said Shen Wujiu.

meaning:1.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect stretched wide under a pale sky. Stone tablets lined the path, each carved with a single word. Master Qingwu walked slowly beside me. 'Every word holds a *meaning* deeper than its sound,' she said. 'Read them not with your eyes, but with your breath.' I pressed my palm to the nearest tablet and felt a faint warmth rise through the cold rock.
meaning:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，每个刻在石碑上的字都有比声音更深的____。
meaning:1.hook: Behind the last tablet, a character I had never seen began to glow.
meaning:1.line: 'Every word holds a *meaning* deeper than its sound.'

strengthen:1.en: The morning trial was simple: hold a word-stone above your head until your arms gave out. Shen Wujiu finished first and turned to me with calm eyes. 'Each session will *strengthen* the channels that carry spiritual breath,' he said. 'Pain today is just tomorrow's foundation.' I lifted my stone again, sweat cold on my neck, and the clouds below the mountain shifted like a slow tide.
strengthen:1.cnHint: 师兄说，每次练习都会____承载灵息的经脉。
strengthen:1.hook: At the third bell, the word on my stone changed shape without warning.
strengthen:1.line: 'Each session will *strengthen* the channels that carry spiritual breath.'

competitive:1.en: A public ranking board hung at the sect gate, updated each dawn with every disciple's word-count. The atmosphere in the outer courtyard had grown sharp and *competitive* since its arrival; even quiet Xiaoxing now rose before sunrise to practice. I stared at my own name near the bottom and let the cold wind steady me. Above the board, a single white crane circled twice and flew east.
competitive:1.cnHint: 自从排行榜出现，外院的气氛变得紧张而充满____。
competitive:1.hook: That evening, two names above mine vanished from the board entirely.
competitive:1.line: 'The board has made everything *competitive*, even our morning greetings.'

recently:1.en: Xiaoxing found me at the edge of the platform, looking down at the sea of clouds. 'You have *recently* learned the word for wind,' she said softly, 'yet you stand here as if you have forgotten it.' She was right. I had been so focused on collecting new words that I had stopped feeling the ones I already held. Below us, the clouds parted for a moment, and something vast moved in the white depth.
recently:1.cnHint: 小星说，我____刚学了风字，却好像已经忘了它的感觉。
recently:1.hook: The shape in the clouds was gone before either of us could name it.
recently:1.line: 'You have *recently* learned the word for wind — why do you look so lost?'

nation:1.en: Master Qingwu gathered us at the high terrace and unrolled an old map. 'Long ago,' she said, 'every floating mountain was a seat of a different *nation*, each with its own living language.' The map showed dozens of peaks, most now dark and nameless. We stood in silence, the weight of that history pressing down like a storm cloud. Then the map curled at one edge, as if something beneath it had breathed.
nation:1.cnHint: 师尊展开古地图，讲述每座浮山曾是不同____的所在。
nation:1.hook: One peak on the map still carried a name no living disciple could read aloud.
nation:1.line: 'Each mountain was once the heart of a *nation* with its own living words.'

perceive:1.en: The lesson that afternoon asked us to stand still and *perceive* the spiritual weight of a single written character without touching it. Most disciples squinted and gave up. I closed my eyes instead and listened with the space behind my ribs. A faint pull arrived, like a thread tugged from inside a cloth. When I opened my eyes, the character had risen half an inch off the table. Shen Wujiu noticed and said nothing, only nodded once.
perceive:1.cnHint: 那堂课要求我们不触碰字符，只用感知去____它的灵性重量。
perceive:1.hook: The character hung in the air a moment longer than it should have, then dropped.
perceive:1.line: 'Close your eyes and *perceive* the weight before you reach for the word.'

pound:1.en: The old mortar at the herb corner of the courtyard was used for grinding word-seeds into paste. Xiaoxing showed me the rhythm: you must *pound* slowly at first, she said, or the spiritual thread inside the seed will snap. I followed her pace, and the paste that formed glowed faintly green. A sparrow landed on the mortar's rim, tilted its head, and sang one clear note before flying straight up into the clouds.
pound:1.cnHint: 小星教我____字种时要慢慢来，否则其中的灵线会断裂。
pound:1.hook: The sparrow's note hung in the air long after the bird had vanished.
pound:1.line: '*Pound* slowly — the thread inside a seed breaks if you rush.'

purpose:1.en: Shen Wujiu sat alone on the outer steps, turning a blank word-stone in his hands. I asked why it was empty. 'I have not yet decided its *purpose*,' he said. 'A word given the wrong role will pull you somewhere you never meant to go.' He set the stone down between us on the step. As the sun dropped toward the cloud line, a thin crack appeared across the stone's surface, perfectly straight, as though the mountain itself had chosen.
purpose:1.cnHint: 师兄说，还没决定这块空白字石的____，给字赋予错误的角色会让人迷失。
purpose:1.hook: The crack split the stone's face into two equal halves, each facing a different peak.
purpose:1.line: 'A word given the wrong *purpose* will carry you somewhere you never meant to go.'

respond:1.en: The village square below the mountain gate was full of new disciples, all waiting in silence. Master Qingwu raised one hand, and the crowd grew still. She spoke a single word — 'Rise' — and the morning mist *responded* at once, lifting away like a curtain to reveal the first step of the stone path. We understood then that words here were alive.
respond:1.cnHint: 师尊说出一个字，晨雾立刻____了，石阶显现在众人面前。
respond:1.hook: The stone path showed seven steps — but yesterday there were nine.
respond:1.line: 'When the mountain *responds* to your word, you are ready to climb.'

welcome:1.en: At the outer gate of the Cloud Sea Sect, red paper lanterns swayed in the high wind. Shen Wujiu stood on the broad stone steps and spread his arms wide. 'A true *welcome* is not given with words alone,' he told us, 'but with the path kept clear and the gate held open.' Every lantern flared brighter as he spoke.
welcome:1.cnHint: 在宗门外门，师兄说真正的____不只是言语，所有灯笼随即亮了起来。
welcome:1.hook: One lantern at the far end burned a deep and steady blue.
welcome:1.line: 'The sect offers you a *welcome* that lasts only as long as your effort does.'

appeal:1.en: Outside the inner hall, a young disciple knelt on the cold stone of the open courtyard. She had broken a word-herb and could not restore it. Her voice was steady as she made her *appeal* to Master Qingwu, asking not for pardon but for a second chance to learn. The clouds beneath the mountain shifted and rose like a held breath.
appeal:1.cnHint: 一位弟子在院中向师尊____，请求的不是宽恕，而是再次学习的机会。
appeal:1.hook: Master Qingwu's sleeve moved — but her hand never reached the door.
appeal:1.line: 'Your *appeal* is heard — now show me the word again, without fear.'

finally:1.en: For three mornings I had stood at the edge of the sky-bridge and tried to speak the flight word. Each time the sound left my mouth wrong, flat, like a stone dropped in still water. On the fourth morning, just as the sun broke the cloud sea, I breathed slowly and *finally* shaped the word true. My feet left the stone for one full breath.
finally:1.cnHint: 三天失败后，我在第四天清晨____说对了那个飞行字诀，双脚离开了石面。
finally:1.hook: When I landed, there was a second set of footprints already in the frost.
finally:1.line: 'You have *finally* spoken it — and the sky has heard you.'

guess:1.en: Xiaoxing spread five small word-seeds on the flat rock between us and looked at me with calm eyes. 'Do not *guess*,' she said quietly. 'Look at the shape of each one — the curve tells you what it heals and the point tells you where.' I studied them until the difference became clear, and the right word rose in my mind like a warm light.
guess:1.cnHint: 师妹叮嘱我不要____，要仔细看每颗字种的形状，才能辨别它们的效用。
guess:1.hook: One seed had no curve and no point — it had neither shape at all.
guess:1.line: 'If you *guess* instead of reading, the herb will answer the wrong question.'

protection:1.en: A sudden wind crossed the open market ledge of the floating town, scattering herb-papers and word-scrolls across the stone floor. Shen Wujiu moved quickly, drawing a single character in the air with two fingers. A thin shell of light settled over our pile of word-seeds, and the wind passed around it. 'That,' he said, 'is *protection*.'
protection:1.cnHint: 大风吹过浮空集市，师兄在空中画字，为我们的字种提供了____。
protection:1.hook: The wind did not stop — it circled the ledge and came back harder.
protection:1.line: '*Protection* is a word you must know before you leave this mountain.'

resident:1.en: The floating town of Yunbu sat on a wide stone shelf halfway up the tallest peak. Every *resident* there was either a word-trader or a retired disciple who had chosen the high air over the valley below. An old woman at her doorway nodded as I passed. She held a small glowing character in her open palm, turning it slowly like a piece of fruit.
resident:1.cnHint: 浮空小镇云埠的每位____不是字商就是退隐弟子，一位老妇在门口翻转着一个发光的字符。
resident:1.hook: The character in her palm suddenly went dark when she saw my face.
resident:1.line: 'Every *resident* here once stood where you are standing now, young one.'

willing:1.en: At the edge of the cloud-market, Master Qingwu asked each of us in turn whether we were *willing* to carry a word-herb across the open bridge alone, in full wind, with no senior disciple beside us. One by one the others nodded. When my turn came, I felt the wind pull at my sleeves, and I nodded too. She wrote something small in her record-book.
willing:1.cnHint: 师尊逐一询问弟子是否____独自携带字草穿越风中的天桥，轮到我时我点了头。
willing:1.hook: She did not write anything after the disciple who answered last.
willing:1.line: 'Only the *willing* hand can carry a word-herb without waking it too soon.'

admit:1.en: At the base of Verdant Peak, a crowd of young disciples waited in silence. Master Qingwu stood at the gate, studying each face with calm eyes. One by one she turned people away. At last she reached me, paused, and spoke the words that changed everything. She chose to *admit* me into the Cloud Sea Sect.
admit:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在云海宗门口审视每一位求入者，终于____了我。
admit:1.hook: But the gate creaked shut, and something watched from above.
admit:1.line: 'I will *admit* only those whose hearts are still,' she said.

association:1.en: On the outer steps of the sect hall, Shen Wujiu showed me a carved stone tablet listing every inner circle. 'Each group trains apart,' he said. 'But this one is different.' He pointed to a name near the top. Their *association* of cloud-walking disciples had not accepted anyone new for thirty years.
association:1.cnHint: 师兄向我介绍宗内各个____，其中一个云行弟子的团体已三十年未纳新人。
association:1.hook: The carved name on the tablet slowly began to glow.
association:1.line: 'The *association* has watched you since you arrived,' Shen Wujiu said.

brand:1.en: Xiaoxing knelt beside a low flame at the courtyard's edge, pressing a warm seal onto a strip of spirit-bark. 'Every herb we gather must carry this mark,' she told me softly. The *brand* of the Cloud Sea Sect — two mountains above a wave — meant the herb had been blessed and was safe to use.
brand:1.cnHint: 小星用宗门印记给药草打____，以示这些药草已经过祝福可以安全使用。
brand:1.hook: One strip of bark, already marked, began to tremble on its own.
brand:1.line: 'This *brand* tells the world where our power comes from,' Xiaoxing said.

deep:1.en: Master Qingwu led me to the eastern cliff and told me to breathe. Far below the floating mountain, the sea of clouds shifted and rolled. 'Do not fear the height,' she said. 'Fear only a shallow mind.' I looked *deep* into the white silence beneath my feet and felt something ancient stir.
deep:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊带我到东崖，让我凝视脚下____处的云海，感受其中沉睡的力量。
deep:1.hook: A shape moved far below, too large and too slow to be wind.
deep:1.line: 'Look *deep*, and the clouds will show you what you are,' she said.

discover:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small jade slip and told me to walk the outer herb garden alone. 'Say nothing until you find it,' he said. Near the northern wall, half hidden under broad silver leaves, I bent down to *discover* a single violet stalk glowing faintly — a spirit herb no map had ever marked.
discover:1.cnHint: 师兄让我独自漫步药草园，我在北墙边____了一株任何地图上都未曾标注的发光灵草。
discover:1.hook: The violet glow pulsed once, as though it had been waiting.
discover:1.line: 'Those who truly *discover* a herb must also name it,' Shen Wujiu said.

essential:1.en: Before the morning bell, Xiaoxing and I swept the stone path that wound around the peak. She stopped and pointed to a small hollow in the rock face where water collected. 'This pool is *essential*,' she said quietly. 'Without it the oldest spirit tree cannot drink, and without that tree, our sect has no roots.'
essential:1.cnHint: 小星指着岩壁上的一处积水坑，说它是古灵树乃至整个宗门存续的____所在。
essential:1.hook: The pool's surface rippled though the morning air was perfectly still.
essential:1.line: 'Rest is *essential*; a tired hand drops the rarest herb,' Xiaoxing said.

fine:1.en: The path along the outer ridge was narrow but the air was clear. Shen Wujiu walked ahead without looking down. He asked how I felt after my first night on the floating mountain. I told him I was *fine*, though my legs still trembled from the height and my ears still rang with wind.
fine:1.cnHint: 在浮山外脊的小路上，师兄问我第一夜的感受，我说我____，但身体其实还未完全适应。
fine:1.hook: He smiled, then stopped — the path ahead had simply ended.
fine:1.line: 'You say you are *fine*, but your shadow leans toward the edge,' he said.

largely:1.en: At the wide terrace below the main hall, older disciples gathered to trade spirit herbs before noon. Xiaoxing whispered that the daily market was *largely* run by the herb-keeper elders, but the best rare finds always came from young disciples who wandered too far and stumbled onto something they could not name.
largely:1.cnHint: 在宗门主殿下的露台集市上，小星告诉我这里____由掌药长老主导，但最珍稀的药材往往来自误入深处的年轻弟子。
largely:1.hook: One young disciple held out a herb, and every elder went silent.
largely:1.line: 'Our strength is *largely* drawn from what grows where no one looks,' Xiaoxing said.

machine:1.en: The outer courtyard held a strange *machine* — brass rings turning inside larger rings, each carved with a single word. Shen Wujiu explained that the sect used it to measure a disciple's breath against the living formulas. I pressed my palm to the cold metal and felt the rings shudder, then spin faster than wind.
machine:1.cnHint: 外院有一台奇异的____，用来测量弟子与灵文之间的共鸣。
machine:1.hook: One ring kept spinning long after all the others had stopped.
machine:1.line: 'This *machine* has not moved that fast in forty years,' said Shen Wujiu, his voice very quiet.

observe:1.en: On the first morning of the Cloud Sea Sect, we gathered at the cliff edge to *observe* the ancient rite of Mist Greeting. Master Qingwu lit a single word-leaf and let the smoke rise into the sky. Every disciple bowed as the clouds below us turned a deep, slow gold.
observe:1.cnHint: 清晨，全体弟子聚集在悬崖边____古老的迎雾仪式。
observe:1.hook: The gold faded too soon — by half a breath, the elders said nothing, but their eyes were troubled.
observe:1.line: 'We *observe* this rite so the clouds remember we are still here,' Master Qingwu said softly.

fat:1.en: Xiaoxing pointed at the word-herb called Golden Marrow, its leaves thick with stored light. 'It looks almost like *fat*,' she said, laughing. I pressed one leaf between my fingers and felt warmth move up my arm, rich and slow, the way a deep river moves under ice.
fat:1.cnHint: 小星指着一株储满灵光的词草，说它的叶片像____一样厚实。
fat:1.hook: The warmth reached my shoulder and stopped, as if blocked by something I could not see.
fat:1.line: 'A leaf this full of *fat* light can mend a cracked spirit bone,' Xiaoxing said, eyes bright.

helpful:1.en: I had learned three words but could hold none of them steady in the wind. Shen Wujiu knelt beside me on the stone path and showed me how to anchor each word at the base of my breath. It was the most *helpful* lesson I had yet received, and yet when I stood up, my shadow fell the wrong way.
helpful:1.cnHint: 沈无咎教了我一个极____的稳字之法，但站起身后，我的影子朝着错误的方向倒去。
helpful:1.hook: My shadow pointed east — and the morning sun stood firmly in the south.
helpful:1.line: 'The most *helpful* thing I can teach you is to trust the word before you trust your hand,' Shen Wujiu said.

position:1.en: Master Qingwu moved me to a new *position* on the training terrace — three steps closer to the edge, where the wind carried live word-seeds up from the cloud sea below. I could feel each seed brush my skin like a whispered question. The drop beyond my toes was longer than silence.
position:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊将我调至演武台上一个新的____，那里风中漂浮着来自云海的活灵字种。
position:1.hook: A word-seed landed on my lip and, for one breath, I understood a formula I had never been taught.
position:1.line: 'Your *position* here is not a reward — it is a test,' Master Qingwu said, eyes forward.

threat:1.en: A grey fog rolled in from the northern peaks, carrying the smell of burned words — a sign that a rival sect had tried to harvest our cloud-herbs without permission. Shen Wujiu stood at the gate, calm but watchful. 'This is not the first *threat*,' he told me, 'but it feels different today.'
threat:1.cnHint: 北峰飘来一片灰雾，带着焦灼灵文的气息，像是某种____正在逼近。
threat:1.hook: The fog stopped at our gate — then, slowly, it began to spell something.
threat:1.line: 'A *threat* that arrives in silence is harder to answer than one that shouts,' Shen Wujiu said.

trend:1.en: Among the younger disciples, there was a clear *trend*: everyone wanted the flying words, the bright ones that lifted your feet off stone. Xiaoxing shook her head and kept practicing the quiet healing formulas instead. By evening her hands glowed like paper lanterns, and the rest of us looked at our empty palms.
trend:1.cnHint: 年轻弟子中出现了一种____，人人都追捧御风飞行的灵字，唯独小星专心修习治愈术。
trend:1.hook: When the night bell rang, only Xiaoxing's lantern-hands could be seen through the mountain fog.
trend:1.line: 'If everyone follows a *trend*, who will be left to do the quiet work?' Xiaoxing asked, not unkindly.

ultimately:1.en: I spent the afternoon trying every path across the Word Bridge — stone arches inscribed with living formulas that shifted if you mispronounced them. I fell twice, caught myself once, and *ultimately* crossed on a single held breath, speaking the bridge's true name in a voice barely above a whisper.
ultimately:1.cnHint: 我在灵字桥上尝试了每一条路，____以一口屏住的气息和轻声念出的真名走到了对岸。
ultimately:1.hook: The bridge went silent behind me, as though it would never let anyone cross again.
ultimately:1.line: 'You *ultimately* succeed not when the bridge trusts you, but when you trust the word,' Master Qingwu said.

australia:1.en: Master Qingwu spread an old scroll across the stone table outside the Gate of First Clouds. 'Every sect has its own sky,' she said. 'Even the distant land called *Australia* holds words we have never heard — words that could heal wounds our herbs cannot touch.' I traced the strange syllables, feeling heat rise from the page.
australia:1.cnHint: 师尊在山门外展开古卷，提到远方有一片土地，那里藏有我们从未听闻的____灵词。
australia:1.hook: The scroll's edge began to smoke, though no flame was near.
australia:1.line: 'Even *Australia* holds words that our mountain has never tasted.'

authority:1.en: Outside the Hall of Clouds, Shen Wujiu stood before a crowd of new disciples, arms folded. He spoke with quiet *authority*, and every student fell still. 'A word spoken without understanding,' he said, 'is a stone thrown into deep water — it sinks, and you never know what it stirs.' I held my breath.
authority:1.cnHint: 师兄站在殿外，用他的____向新弟子讲述轻率使用灵词的危险。
authority:1.hook: Then a crack split the stone step behind him, clean as a blade.
authority:1.line: 'Speak with *authority*, or the word will turn against you.'

confident:1.en: The morning test was held on the outer terrace, open sky above and cloud sea below. I stepped to the edge, more *confident* than I had any right to be, and released the word for 'rise.' For one breath, my feet left the stone. The other disciples went silent. Xiaoxing smiled from across the terrace.
confident:1.cnHint: 我在露台上参加晨试，____地使出"升"字灵词，双脚短暂地离开了地面。
confident:1.hook: A second later, a cold wind rose from below, carrying a smell of rain and iron.
confident:1.line: 'Be *confident*, but remember — the sky does not forgive a careless word.'

crowd:1.en: On the market path between the outer peaks, a *crowd* of disciples gathered around a senior who was writing words in the air with a burning brush. Each word floated for a moment, then dissolved into light. I pushed to the front, desperate to see. Master Qingwu watched from a high step, saying nothing.
crowd:1.cnHint: 在两峰之间的市道上，弟子们____在一位师长周围，观看他以烈笔书写悬空灵词。
crowd:1.hook: The last word did not dissolve — it turned dark and held its shape.
crowd:1.line: 'Do not let the *crowd* pull you forward before you are ready.'

highly:1.en: Shen Wujiu spoke to me near the low bridge at the edge of the sect grounds, voice unhurried. 'Master Qingwu thinks *highly* of your ear for sound,' he said.
