property:1.cnHint: 师尊告诉弟子们，真正掌握的文字是修炼者唯一无法被夺走的____。
property:1.hook: One of the sealed boxes bore no name at all.
property:1.line: 'Words learned in the bone are the only *property* a cultivator truly keeps.'

conventional:1.en: At the base of Ascension Peak, disciples gathered to receive their first herb pouches. Master Qingwu handed mine over without a word. Inside was nothing *conventional* — no dried roots or pressed leaves, but a single living seed that hummed like a struck bell and cast faint gold light on my palm.
conventional:1.cnHint: 在飞升峰山脚，师尊交给我一个不____的草药包。
conventional:1.hook: The seed pulsed once, then went silent.
conventional:1.line: 'Nothing *conventional* grows on the peak above the clouds,' Master Qingwu said.

disappear:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me through the outer terrace at dawn, pointing out the herbs carved above each gate. Then he stopped walking. I turned, and he had simply ceased to be there — it is common on this mountain, he had warned me, for a person to *disappear* into the mist between one step and the next.
disappear:1.cnHint: 在晨雾中，师兄突然在我眼前____了。
disappear:1.hook: His footprints in the dew ended without reason.
disappear:1.line: 'On foggy mornings, even your own shadow can *disappear*,' Shen Wujiu warned.

district:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a map of the mountain range across a flat stone. Each floating peak belonged to a different *district* of the Cloud Sea Sect, she explained — one for healing, one for combat, one for flight. I had been assigned to the smallest, the one whose name no elder spoke aloud.
district:1.cnHint: 师尊展开地图，向我介绍宗门各个____的用途。
district:1.hook: The smallest district had no label at all.
district:1.line: 'Every *district* carries its own law, and its own silence,' said Master Qingwu.

greatly:1.en: I attempted the Rising Breath formula for the third time at the cliff edge. The air around me shifted, and I rose — only a hand's width, but Xiaoxing clapped once from the path. She said the light in the formula had *greatly* improved, brighter and steadier than yesterday, like a lantern finally given oil.
greatly:1.cnHint: 小星告诉我，今天我施展法诀的灵光____比昨日进步了。
greatly:1.hook: Below the cliff, the sea of clouds began to stir.
greatly:1.line: 'Your breath has *greatly* changed since last week,' Xiaoxing said softly.

imitate:1.en: Xiaoxing pressed her hands together and shaped a small cloud above her fingers. She smiled and told me not to *imitate* the shape — the form was only a shell, she said, and the real work was in the breath behind it. I closed my eyes and tried to feel rather than copy.
imitate:1.cnHint: 小星叮嘱我不要____她的手势，而要感受气息本身。
imitate:1.hook: When I opened my eyes, my cloud had a different, stranger shape.
imitate:1.line: 'Do not *imitate* the gesture alone — breathe the meaning into it,' Xiaoxing said.

implement:1.en: Shen Wujiu carried a worn leather roll tied with a blue cord. He opened it on the stone railing, and inside lay each *implement* of the first trial — a bone needle, a small blade of pressed cloud-iron, and a hollow reed no longer than my thumb. Each one, he said, corresponded to a word.
implement:1.cnHint: 师兄向我展示初试所用的每一件____，并说明它们各自对应一个字诀。
implement:1.hook: One implement was wrapped separately, and he did not name it.
implement:1.line: 'Each *implement* in this roll has ended at least one trial early,' Shen Wujiu said.

mood:1.en: The outer terrace was quiet at noon, the mist low and silver. I sat with my herb scroll but could not read. Master Qingwu passed behind me and paused. She said the mountain reads a disciple's *mood* the way water reads wind — it ripples before the gust even arrives, and it remembers long after.
mood:1.cnHint: 师尊说，这座山能感应弟子的____，就像水感应风一样。
mood:1.hook: A tremor moved through the stone beneath me, slow and deliberate.
mood:1.line: 'The mountain mirrors your *mood* — do not let it learn fear,' said Master Qingwu.

motivation:1.en: Shen Wujiu asked me why I had climbed to the sect on foot instead of taking the cloud-ferry like the others. I told him I had no good reason. He shook his head and said that was exactly the right answer — that pure *motivation*, without weight or want, is the only kind the peak will accept.
motivation:1.cnHint: 师兄问我徒步上山的____是什么，说只有纯粹的动机才能被山峰接受。
motivation:1.hook: Above us, the gate at the summit opened one finger's width.
motivation:1.line: 'Tell me your *motivation*, and the peak will already know if you lied,' said Shen Wujiu.

attribute:1.en: At the stone gate of the outer court, Master Qingwu held up a pale seed — a word-herb so rare that even senior disciples had never seen one. 'Every healer must learn to *attribute* a patient's weakness to the right cause,' she said, 'or the cure becomes the poison.' I wrote the lesson on my palm with trembling fingers. Above the gate, a crack split the stone in perfect silence.
attribute:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在石门前告诫弟子，治愈者必须懂得将病人的虚弱____于正确的根源。
attribute:1.hook: The crack in the gate widened one breath later, then stopped.
attribute:1.line: 'You must *attribute* every symptom to its true root, or your formula will fail.'

badly:1.en: The market bridge was packed with outer disciples trading word-seeds in the open air. I had spent all morning searching for a single herb that could steady a shaking voice. I *badly* needed it before the afternoon trial, where Master Qingwu would test us on spoken formulas. Shen Wujiu pressed a small pouch into my hand without a word. At sunset, every lantern on the bridge went dark at once.
badly:1.cnHint: 我____需要一株能稳定声音的草药，才能通过今天下午的考验。
badly:1.hook: Every lantern on the bridge went dark at once.
badly:1.line: 'I *badly* need that herb — the trial begins in one hour.'

bridge:1.en: The sect's oldest *bridge* stretched between two floating peaks, its stones carved with ten thousand words too faded to read. Each morning, disciples crossed it in silence, breathing in whatever meaning drifted up from the clouds below. Today I stopped at the center and listened. A low hum rose from the carvings, as if one forgotten word was trying to wake up again. The hum did not stop when I walked away.
bridge:1.cnHint: 宗门最古老的____连接着两座浮峰，石面上刻满了万千模糊的文字。
bridge:1.hook: The hum followed me all the way to the inner court.
bridge:1.line: 'Never stop on this *bridge* at night — some words here still have teeth.'

casual:1.en: Outside the herb pavilion, Xiaoxing sat on a low wall with a *casual* ease that made the elder disciples nervous. She was sorting word-seeds by color, humming to herself, as if the coming storm trial meant nothing at all. I asked how she could be so calm. She smiled and held up a seed that glowed faint gold. The sky above her head turned the same shade of gold, then faded.
casual:1.cnHint: 小星以一种____的从容坐在矮墙上，整理着她的文字种子，仿佛即将到来的风暴考验毫不在意。
casual:1.hook: The sky above her head turned gold, then faded fast.
casual:1.line: 'My *casual* look is itself a formula — it keeps rivals from guessing my strength.'

closely:1.en: In the open square before the inner hall, I watched Master Qingwu write a healing word in the air with one finger. The strokes vanished, but their warmth stayed. She told us to study the shape *closely*, because the curve of each line held the meaning the way a valley holds rain. I copied the motion three times. On the third try, the air smelled briefly of pine and distant rain.
closely:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊要求我们____观察她在空中写下的治愈文字，每一笔的弧度都承载着意义。
closely:1.hook: On the third copy, the air smelled of pine and rain.
closely:1.line: 'Watch *closely* — the curve of this stroke is where the healing lives.'

commit:1.en: At the edge of the practice yard, Shen Wujiu told me that mastering a word-formula was not about memory. 'You have to *commit* fully,' he said, 'half belief breaks the spell.' He demonstrated with a wind-word, and the dust rose in a perfect spiral before settling back in exactly the same pattern. I tried to do the same. The dust rose, then stopped, frozen mid-spiral, waiting for something.
commit:1.cnHint: 沈无咎告诉我，要掌握文字法诀，就必须____全力以赴，半信半疑会破坏咒文。
commit:1.hook: The dust froze mid-spiral and would not fall.
commit:1.line: 'You must *commit* with your whole will, or the word will refuse you.'

concentrate:1.en: The trial ground was a wide stone terrace open to the sky. Wind came from all four directions, carrying distracting sounds and scents of strange herbs. Master Qingwu told us to *concentrate* on a single word-seed and feel its meaning expand inside the mind. I closed my eyes. For a moment the noise vanished and I heard only one clear tone. When I opened my eyes, the other disciples were staring at my hands.
concentrate:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊让我们在嘈杂的试炼台上____于单一的文字种子，感受它的意义在心中扩展。
concentrate:1.hook: Every disciple was staring at my hands when I opened my eyes.
concentrate:1.line: '*Concentrate* on one word only — scatter your mind and the seed will scatter too.'

conscious:1.en: After the morning trial, I sat by the outer gate and tried to recall every step I had taken. Shen Wujiu said that a true disciple must be *conscious* of each breath during a formula, aware of the moment meaning passes from mind to air. I had not been aware at all — I had simply acted. Yet the word-seed had bloomed. A single white petal drifted up from the sea of clouds below and landed on my knee.
conscious:1.cnHint: 沈无咎说，真正的弟子在施展法诀时必须对每一次呼吸保持____，清醒地感受意义从心中流向空气。
conscious:1.hook: A white petal rose from the clouds and landed on my knee.
conscious:1.line: 'Be *conscious* of each breath — that awareness is half the formula.'

obvious:1.en: The trial ground stretched across the open sky-bridge between two peaks. Every disciple stood still, reading the stone tablets carved with spirit words. To me, the correct path was *obvious* — the word for wind glowed faintly at the base, pointing left. I stepped forward. No one else moved.
obvious:1.cnHint: 在天桥试炼中，石碑上的答案对我来说____，我率先迈步。
obvious:1.hook: Behind me, the bridge began to crack.
obvious:1.line: 'The answer is *obvious* — look at where the light falls.'

ordinary:1.en: The sky-market on the eastern ledge sold spirit words pressed into paper strips. Most stalls offered *ordinary* words — light, stone, wind — things any first-year disciple already knew. But one old seller at the far corner held a strip that shimmered with a color I had never seen.
ordinary:1.cnHint: 东崖集市上大多数摊位只售卖____的灵字，唯有角落一位老人手中的字条与众不同。
ordinary:1.hook: The old seller looked at me and quietly folded the strip away.
ordinary:1.line: 'These are just *ordinary* words — nothing here will surprise a careful student.'

pace:1.en: Before the morning bell, I watched Shen Wujiu *pace* along the outer ledge, his lips moving in silence. He was rehearsing the flight formula — each step matched a syllable, each turn a breath. The clouds below swirled as if listening. I counted twelve full rounds before he stopped.
pace:1.cnHint: 清晨，我看见师兄在崖边____，默默演练飞升咒文。
pace:1.hook: On the thirteenth step, his feet left the stone entirely.
pace:1.line: 'I *pace* like this every dawn — the words only settle when the body moves.'

participate:1.en: Master Qingwu announced that any disciple who wished to *participate* in the Sky Ascent rite must first carve their chosen word into the summit stone before sunrise. I had spent three nights deciding. Xiaoxing had already chosen hers. I pressed my blade to the cold rock and began.
participate:1.cnHint: 师尊宣布，想要____飞升仪式的弟子必须在日出前将灵字刻入顶石。
participate:1.hook: My blade slipped, and the stone lit up with a color no one had chosen before.
participate:1.line: 'Only those who *participate* with a whole heart will feel the mountain respond.'

pilot:1.en: High above the outer ring, a lone figure glided on a narrow cloud-board without any visible word-seal beneath their feet. Shen Wujiu leaned close and said that the elder was the sect's oldest *pilot*, someone who had long since merged the flight word into his very breath. I watched until the figure vanished into white.
pilot:1.cnHint: 一位老者无需字印便能驾云而行，师兄告诉我他是门派最资深的____。
pilot:1.hook: Then the elder reappeared — directly behind me.
pilot:1.line: 'A true *pilot* does not read the word — they become it.'

primary:1.en: Xiaoxing spread her study notes across the flat rock near the cliff edge. She tapped the first page and said the *primary* rule of spirit-word craft was breath control — without steady breath, even the simplest healing word would scatter like smoke. I copied the rule down three times as a cold wind crossed the ledge.
primary:1.cnHint: 师妹说，掌握灵字的____原则是调息，我在笔记上一连抄写了三遍。
primary:1.hook: The cold wind carried a sound — someone else's breath, close and unsteady.
primary:1.line: 'Our *primary* task this season is to hold the word long enough to feel it pull.'

priority:1.en: The morning roster listed twelve tasks for the outer disciples. Shen Wujiu crossed out ten with a single stroke. He said the sky-trial was two days away, and our only *priority* was the ascent word — everything else could wait. Master Qingwu passed by without a word, but she nodded once.
priority:1.cnHint: 师兄划去了名册上的大多数任务，说飞升试炼在即，我们唯一的____是掌握升天灵字。
priority:1.hook: That night, the ascent word appeared on the wall of my room — unwritten, in pale light.
priority:1.line: 'Let the chores wait — your *priority* is the one word that opens the sky.'

throughout:1.en: *Throughout* the long afternoon, the outer disciples practiced on the wind-terrace, calling words into the open air. Some words rose cleanly; others broke apart and drifted down into the clouds. I kept my stance low and my voice even, as Xiaoxing had shown me. By dusk, my word held for three full breaths.
throughout:1.cnHint: 整个下午，弟子们在风台____练习，我的灵字到黄昏时终于能维持三息。
throughout:1.hook: At the final bell, the clouds below the terrace turned a deep, unnatural red.
throughout:1.line: '*Throughout* every trial I have seen, it is patience that carries the word farthest.'

dinner:1.en: On the broad stone terrace where the sect gathers before flight trials, Master Qingwu has prepared a *dinner* of rare cloud-herb broth and river-grain cakes. Every disciple sits cross-legged on woven mats. Shen Wujiu passes me a warm bowl, and the whole mountain breathes in slow, golden silence.
dinner:1.cnHint: 飞升考验前夕，师尊在露台上为弟子们摆下____，饭香随云气飘散。
dinner:1.hook: One empty mat at the table belongs to no living disciple.
dinner:1.line: 'This *dinner* is not a reward — it is a farewell offering to the sky.'

embrace:1.en: On the wide landing path carved into the cliff face, Xiaoxing spreads her arms wide as the morning wind rushes up from the sea of clouds below. She says the wind is teaching her to *embrace* everything she fears — the height, the cold, the long fall. I watch and feel my own heart open a little.
embrace:1.cnHint: 在悬崖栈道上，小星张开双臂，学着用____来面对心中的恐惧。
embrace:1.hook: Then the wind stopped, and the silence was louder than any storm.
embrace:1.line: 'To *embrace* the cold air is the first step toward flying through it.'

explanation:1.en: Beneath the great signal bell hung between two floating peaks, I find Shen Wujiu standing alone, staring at a crack running through the ancient stone pillar. He offers no *explanation* for why he is here before dawn, only presses one finger against the crack and whispers a word-formula I do not recognise.
explanation:1.cnHint: 清晨，我在信号钟下发现师兄独自凝视裂柱，他没有给出任何____。
explanation:1.hook: The crack in the pillar spread another inch as he walked away.
explanation:1.line: 'I owe no *explanation* to anyone — only to the stone itself.'

intend:1.en: At the foot of the ascending stone steps that spiral up toward the trial gate, Master Qingwu pauses and turns to face us. Her voice is steady as still water. She says she does not *intend* to watch any disciple fall today — but the sky, she warns, has its own will and listens to no one.
intend:1.cnHint: 在通往考验之门的石阶下，师尊说她并不____让任何弟子今日坠落。
intend:1.hook: A single white feather drifted down the steps toward us.
intend:1.line: 'I *intend* to stand at this gate until every one of you has passed through.'

leadership:1.en: On the wide observation terrace overlooking the trial course, the elder disciples gather in a loose circle. Shen Wujiu stands at the centre without asking to. His *leadership* needs no announcement — when he points to the safest updraft line, every head turns and every foot follows without a word spoken.
leadership:1.cnHint: 在观测台上，师兄不言而喻的____让所有弟子自然地聚拢在他身旁。
leadership:1.hook: He alone kept staring at the one cloud that was not moving.
leadership:1.line: '*Leadership* here means being the first to step off the edge.'

locate:1.en: Along the outer ridge path where trial markers glow faint blue, I am given a small resonance stone and told to *locate* the hidden herb cache before the mist thickens. I hold the stone flat on my palm and walk slowly. The warmth it gives off grows stronger as the path curves toward a split rock.
locate:1.cnHint: 在山脊小径上，我手持共鸣石，试图在浓雾弥漫前____藏草密处。
locate:1.hook: The stone went cold the moment I reached the split rock.
locate:1.line: 'You must *locate* the source of the hum, not just follow the light.'

original:1.en: In the open courtyard at the mountain's shoulder, where flight scrolls are displayed on tall wooden frames, Xiaoxing points to a faded sheet in the corner. She says this is the *original* record of the sect's first ascent, written in a hand so sure and light that the brush strokes seem to still be moving.
original:1.cnHint: 在庭院展示的飞升卷轴中，小星指向角落里那份____记录，笔迹仿佛仍在流动。
original:1.hook: One line of that ancient record had been crossed out very recently.
original:1.line: 'The *original* path to the sky was shorter — and far more dangerous.'

overcome:1.en: On the narrow sky-bridge stretched between the two outermost peaks, the wind hits like a wall of cold iron. I stop mid-span, legs locked. Xiaoxing, already across, calls back that the only way forward is to *overcome* the feeling in your chest — not push it away, but breathe through it and let your feet remember.
overcome:1.cnHint: 在连接两座山峰的天桥上，我被恐惧定住，小星喊道必须____心中那股寒意。
overcome:1.hook: Halfway across, I looked down — and saw my own shadow flying.
overcome:1.line: 'Once you *overcome* that first step, the bridge carries you the rest of the way.'

worldwide:1.en: On the outer courtyard steps, Master Qingwu unrolled a map of spirit-herb trade routes. 'These paths,' she said quietly, 'carry *worldwide* knowledge — healers from every distant mountain send their rarest words here.' I traced one line with my finger and felt a faint pulse, as if the map itself were alive.
worldwide:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊展开一张灵草贸易图，说这条路汇聚了____的智慧，我触碰地图时感到一阵异动。
worldwide:1.hook: The line beneath my finger began to glow on its own.
worldwide:1.line: 'These routes carry *worldwide* knowledge — study them before dawn.'

accomplish:1.en: In the open training yard, Shen Wujiu set three stone tablets before me, each carved with a different word-formula. 'A disciple must *accomplish* all three before the evening bell,' he said, arms folded. I read the first tablet aloud, and the air split like torn silk.
accomplish:1.cnHint: 申无咎师兄在训练场立下三块石碑，要我在晚钟前____所有考验，我念出第一个咒文后，空气骤然裂开。
accomplish:1.hook: The second tablet cracked before I even touched it.
accomplish:1.line: 'You must *accomplish* all three tasks before the bell rings.'

address:1.en: The morning roll-call was held on the cloud-rimmed plaza. Master Qingwu stepped forward to *address* the new disciples, her voice carrying over the wind like a struck bell. Every word she spoke left a faint silver trace in the air — I alone seemed able to see them.
address:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在广场上____新弟子，她的话语在空中留下银色痕迹，而只有我能看见。
address:1.hook: One silver trace curled toward me and would not fade.
address:1.line: 'I will now *address* all new disciples — listen with your spirit, not your ears.'

barely:1.en: Xiaoxing had warned me the Bridge of First Words was narrow, but I had not believed her. I stepped out above the cloud sea and *barely* kept my balance, arms wide, the wind pulling hard at my robe. Far below, something large moved through the white mist.
barely:1.cnHint: 小星师妹提醒我第一语桥很窄，我踏上去后____没有失去平衡，而云海深处有什么东西在移动。
barely:1.hook: The thing in the mist rose slowly toward the bridge.
barely:1.line: 'I *barely* crossed it my first time — breathe and do not look down.'

blame:1.en: A jar of stored voice-essence shattered on the courtyard stones. Three of us stood near it. Shen Wujiu looked at me steadily and said, 'Do not take all the *blame* — the seal was already cracked.' His calm surprised me more than the breaking had. A cold breeze swept the shards away.
blame:1.cnHint: 一罐存储的声音精华在院中碎裂，申无咎师兄说不要我一人承担____，破损早已存在，一阵冷风随即吹过。
blame:1.hook: The cold breeze carried a faint whisper none of us had spoken.
blame:1.line: 'Do not carry all the *blame* — the fault was in the jar, not in you.'

chat:1.en: Between lessons, Xiaoxing and I sat on the warm edge stones of the upper terrace to *chat* about which word-formulas felt like summer and which felt like deep water. She said 'endure' tasted of salt. Below us the cloud sea turned a deep and warning red.
chat:1.cnHint: 我和小星师妹坐在露台边____，谈论各种咒文的感觉，这时脚下的云海突然变成了深红色。
chat:1.hook: Neither of us had ever seen the clouds that colour before.
chat:1.line: 'Let us *chat* a moment — tell me which word felt strangest to you.'

combat:1.en: The sect's outer wall was carved with scenes of ancient word-*combat*: disciples hurling bright syllables like spears, clouds splitting under the force of a single well-spoken name. Master Qingwu stopped beside the oldest panel and pressed one hand flat against it. Stone dust fell like snow.
combat:1.cnHint: 宗门外墙刻着古代咒文____的画面，青雾师尊按住最古老的那块石板后，石粉如雪飘落。
combat:1.hook: The carved figures in the panel shifted — just once.
combat:1.line: 'Ancient *combat* with words left these scars on the stone — never forget that.'

danger:1.en: I found the notice pinned to the gate of the herb garden: one of the rarer word-seeds had split open and was releasing raw sound. 'Real *danger*,' Shen Wujiu said, arriving behind me, his voice low. We could already hear it — a thin, rising hum that made the teeth ache.
danger:1.cnHint: 灵草园门口贴着告示，一颗稀有字种已经裂开，申无咎师兄低声说这是真正的____，我们听到了令牙关发酸的嗡鸣。
danger:1.hook: The hum grew a full tone higher as we stood there.
danger:1.line: 'This is real *danger* — step back and wait for Master Qingwu.'

threaten:1.en: On the outer terrace where wind cuts sharply between peaks, a dark cloud shaped like a claw drifts toward the training ground. Master Qingwu steps in front of us without hesitation. 'Storm clouds do not simply pass,' she says. 'They *threaten* what is below.' Her sleeve rises, and three silver herbs glow in her palm.
threaten:1.cnHint: 乌云逼近练功台，师尊举起灵草，____着要将它驱散。
threaten:1.hook: The claw-cloud tightens, and one herb flickers out.
threaten:1.line: 'These clouds *threaten* the young roots we planted at dawn.'

throw:1.en: At the base of the stone steps leading to the outer gate, Shen Wujiu draws back his arm and releases a seed-formula across the courtyard. Every disciple watches in silence. A single *throw* like this, aimed poorly, could scatter the energy of a whole season's study into the open sky.
throw:1.cnHint: 师兄在山门石阶前将种子灵符掷出，这一____关系着整季的修行。
throw:1.hook: The seed rises, then hangs still — it should have fallen by now.
throw:1.line: 'One good *throw* is worth a hundred careful steps,' Shen Wujiu says quietly.

unlike:1.en: Xiaoxing and I stand side by side on the cloud-path between two floating peaks. My steps are heavy and slow. She moves as if the air holds her up. She is *unlike* any disciple I have met before — her breath does not change, her eyes stay level even when the path narrows to a single stone's width.
unlike:1.cnHint: 小星在云路上行走的姿态____其他弟子，令我暗暗惊叹。
unlike:1.hook: At the path's edge, her foot finds no stone at all.
unlike:1.line: 'You are *unlike* the others — the wind leans toward you,' Master Qingwu observes.

vast:1.en: Outside the sect's lower gate, the sea of clouds stretches in every direction without end. Standing here for the first time, I feel my chest open wider than it ever has. The sky is *vast*, and somewhere inside that white silence float hundreds of peaks I have not yet named, each one holding a herb I have not yet learned.
vast:1.cnHint: 山门之外，云海____无边，我第一次感受到修炼之路的深远。
vast:1.hook: One distant peak catches light — and slowly begins to sink.
vast:1.line: 'The sky is *vast*, and your knowledge is still a single seed,' says Master Qingwu.

absolutely:1.en: On the terrace at first light, Master Qingwu lays five formulas on the stone rail and asks which one is false. I point without hesitation. She studies me for a long moment. 'You are *absolutely* correct,' she says at last, 'but tell me why before the morning wind erases the characters.'
absolutely:1.cnHint: 清晨露台上，师尊考验我辨别真假灵符，说我____答对了，但要我说明原因。
absolutely:1.hook: The wind rises early, and the characters are already fading.
absolutely:1.line: 'You are *absolutely* right — now prove it before the mist arrives.'

accumulate:1.en: Along the winding outer path where disciples walk each morning, I stop to count the small spirit-stones I have gathered since arriving at the sect. One by one they fill my palm. Master Qingwu once said that power does not arrive in a single rain — you must *accumulate* it drop by drop, the way moss gathers dew on cold rock.
accumulate:1.cnHint: 在晨行小道上，我数着灵石，牢记师尊的教诲：力量需要一点一点地____。
accumulate:1.hook: The last stone glows faintly — a colour I have never seen before.
accumulate:1.line: '*Accumulate* each small gain faithfully, and the mountain will move for you,' Master Qingwu says.

breakfast:1.en: At the long stone table set outside the hall where the morning mist still clings, the three of us *breakfast* together in comfortable quiet. Shen Wujiu sets a warm herb-broth at my place without being asked. Small gestures like this, I am learning, are how the sect holds itself together when the harder days come.
breakfast:1.cnHint: 在晨雾中的石桌旁，我们三人一起____，师兄默默为我盛了一碗药汤。
breakfast:1.hook: Between sips, Xiaoxing's bowl cracks clean down the middle.
breakfast:1.line: 'Let us *breakfast* early — Master Qingwu said the sky will close by noon,' Xiaoxing warns.

capacity:1.en: On the open ledge above the cloud-line, where the air thins and the light turns white, Shen Wujiu asks me to hold a full-charge formula in my mind without releasing it. My head aches after ten breaths. He nods slowly. 'Everyone starts here,' he says. 'The *capacity* to hold power grows only by pushing past the point where it hurts.'
capacity:1.cnHint: 在云上岩台，师兄让我强忍灵符的力量，说____需要在极限处才能增长。
capacity:1.hook: On the eleventh breath, something behind my eyes turns cold.
capacity:1.line: 'Your *capacity* is small now, but I have seen worse become great,' Shen Wujiu says.

partly:1.en: The mountain path wound through pale morning mist, *partly* hidden beneath a carpet of silver moss. I carried three seed-words in my satchel, each one glowing faintly. Shen Wujiu walked ahead, his steps certain. 'The path knows you,' he said. Above us, a stone bridge groaned, and one moss-covered edge crumbled silently into the clouds below.
partly:1.cnHint: 清晨山路____被银苔遮掩，师兄带我前行，石桥却悄然碎落。
partly:1.hook: The falling stone made no sound reaching the clouds below.
partly:1.line: The road is *partly* clear — watch where the moss grows thick.

practical:1.en: At the outer gate market, herb-traders spread word-scrolls across flat stones. I asked Xiaoxing which scroll to buy first. She picked up a slim one without pause. 'This one,' she said. 'It is *practical* — three healing words, nothing wasted.' I paid with a spirit coin. On my walk home, the coin purse felt oddly warm, as though something inside still breathed.
practical:1.cnHint: 小星在集市上选了一卷____的词草卷轴，我付钱后，钱袋却变得异常温热。
practical:1.hook: The empty coin purse pulsed once, then went still.
practical:1.line: Choose the *practical* scroll — three words that can save a life.

profit:1.en: Shen Wujiu traded surplus word-seeds at the cloud-market stall each new moon. He kept careful records in a worn notebook. 'There is little *profit* in rare words,' he told me, eyes steady. 'Their value lies elsewhere.' I watched him close the notebook. A single page slipped free, floated upward, and dissolved into pale light before I could read what was written.
profit:1.cnHint: 师兄在云集上售卖词种，告诉我稀有词草的____微薄，一页笔记却在空中化为光。
profit:1.hook: The dissolved page left one luminous character hanging in the air.
profit:1.line: The real *profit* from rare words cannot be counted in coins.

promise:1.en: Master Qingwu met us at the sect's lower courtyard just before dawn. She handed me a small seed wrapped in silk. 'Plant this word when you are ready,' she said. 'It holds a *promise* — speak it only with a steady heart.' The seed was warm as a coal. I bowed and turned to go. Behind me, a wind chime rang three times though the air was perfectly still.
promise:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在庭院赐我一粒词种，说它承载着一个____，身后风铃无风自鸣。
promise:1.hook: Three clear chime-rings echoed where no wind had passed.
promise:1.line: This seed holds a *promise* — do not speak it lightly.

rarely:1.en: The open-air word-garden on the sect's eastern terrace bloomed in every season except deep winter. Xiaoxing knelt beside a silver-leafed plant. 'This one *rarely* flowers,' she said softly, 'and when it does, the scent can last a year.' We both leaned close. One bud cracked open between her fingers, releasing a breath of cold fragrance — and far below, the sea of clouds parted for just a moment.
rarely:1.cnHint: 小星说东台药圃的银叶草____开花，花苞乍开时，云海竟短暂分开。
rarely:1.hook: Through the parted clouds, something vast and dark briefly stirred.
rarely:1.line: It *rarely* blooms — stay close and do not miss the moment.

severe:1.en: A *severe* frost struck the word-herb terrace overnight, turning a week's growth to brittle grey. Master Qingwu stood before the ruined beds without anger, only stillness. 'Cold tests what is rooted,' she said. I noted every damaged plant with care. By noon, three small green shoots had pushed back through the frost — but one was a colour I had never seen in any herb before.
severe:1.cnHint: 严重的霜冻摧毁了词草台，青雾师尊平静以对，却有一株颜色奇异的嫩芽破冰而出。
severe:1.hook: The strange green shoot bore a word no scroll had ever recorded.
severe:1.line: The damage is *severe*, yet see — three shoots still push through.

smell:1.en: The sect's herb lane ran between rows of word-plants that bloomed at different hours. I walked slowly, trying to match each *smell* to its entry in my handbook. One fragrance stopped me — sharp, faintly electric, unlike any page I had studied. Shen Wujiu appeared at my shoulder. 'You found it,' he said quietly. The plant had no label, and its pot cast no shadow at all.
smell:1.cnHint: 我在词草巷辨别各种____，一株无名草的气味让师兄若有所思，花盆却没有影子。
smell:1.hook: A plant with no shadow and no name should not exist here.
smell:1.line: That *smell* — sharp and bright — is the word for lightning.

socialize:1.en: After the evening lesson, disciples gathered on the wide stone steps to *socialize*, trading small word-cuttings and practicing new phrases in the open air. I sat at the edge, still unsure of my footing. Xiaoxing brought me a warm cup and sat beside me. 'Words grow faster when shared,' she said. Above the steps, a line of lanterns flickered once in perfect unison, for no clear reason.
socialize:1.cnHint: 晚课后弟子们在石阶____交流词草，小星来陪我，头顶灯笼无故齐闪。
socialize:1.hook: Every lantern dimmed at once, then blazed back twice as bright.
socialize:1.line: Come and *socialize* — a word shared between two roots deeper.

modern:1.en: At the edge of the outer peak, Shen Wujiu pointed to a newly built stone bridge linking two floating mountains. 'Cloud Sea Sect used to rely on rope ladders,' he said. The bridge felt out of place — too *modern*, too sharp-edged against the ancient mossy cliffs. Master Qingwu watched from above, silent.
modern:1.cnHint: 沈无咎带我参观新建的石桥，它的____风格与古老山壁格格不入。
modern:1.hook: Something in Master Qingwu's silence made the bridge feel like a warning.
modern:1.line: 'This bridge is too *modern* — it does not breathe with the mountain.'

officer:1.en: A cloud-carriage landed on the outer courtyard. From it stepped a tall man in grey robes bearing a silver seal — an *officer* of the Sky Court, the body that ruled all sects from above the highest peak. Xiaoxing gripped my sleeve. Even Shen Wujiu straightened his back without being asked.
officer:1.cnHint: 一位天庭的____降临外院，所有弟子都不由自主地挺直了腰背。
officer:1.hook: The silver seal caught the light, and the clouds beneath us went very still.
officer:1.line: 'An *officer* of the Sky Court answers to no single sect, child.'

convince:1.en: Xiaoxing had found a rare frost-petal herb on the lower cliff, but the path was closed by sect rule. She came to Shen Wujiu with careful words and steady eyes, trying to *convince* him to speak on her behalf to Master Qingwu. He listened, then looked at the clouds for a long moment.
convince:1.cnHint: 小星想让沈无咎帮她向师尊说情，努力____他相信那株草药值得冒险。
convince:1.hook: Shen Wujiu's long silence was not the same as agreement.
convince:1.line: 'You cannot *convince* me with words alone — show me the herb first.'

directly:1.en: The morning trial required each disciple to send a spirit-word *directly* into the flame above the altar without using hand signs. Most of us formed our fingers out of habit. I steadied my breath, opened my palm flat, and pushed the word forward with will alone. The flame bent — toward me.
directly:1.cnHint: 晨间考验要求弟子____将灵字送入祭坛火焰，不借助任何手印。
directly:1.hook: When the flame bent toward me, every other disciple took one step back.
directly:1.line: 'Send the word *directly* — let nothing stand between your will and the flame.'

extend:1.en: Master Qingwu walked the length of the sky-bridge and paused at the far railing. She raised one hand, and the pale planks of cloud-wood began to *extend* outward, growing past the edge of the floating mountain until they hung above open air and distant white nothing. Then she turned and beckoned.
extend:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊施法让云桥向虚空____延伸，随后转身向我招手。
extend:1.hook: Beyond the new planks, there was no mountain — only sky, all the way down.
extend:1.line: 'I will *extend* the bridge, but only you may choose whether to walk it.'

rat:1.en: Near the herb storehouse, a small *rat* sat upright on a bundle of dried star-root, perfectly still, watching me with eyes that held no fear. Shen Wujiu crouched beside me and said such creatures sometimes carried unspent spiritual energy in their bones. Master Qingwu had written a formula about them once.
rat:1.cnHint: 药仓附近，一只____端坐在星根草上，沈无咎说它体内可能藏着灵气。
rat:1.hook: When I blinked, the rat was gone — and so was the bundle of star-root.
rat:1.line: 'A *rat* that does not flee a disciple has already chosen its own path.'

saturday:1.en: In the Cloud Sea Sect, the sixth rest-day of the week was called still-water morning, but Xiaoxing had learned the outer-world name — *Saturday* — from a travelling merchant's almanac. She whispered it like a small secret on the windy courtyard steps, and the word felt oddly light in the mountain air.
saturday:1.cnHint: 小星从一本外界历书中学到了____这个词，在廊阶上悄悄告诉了我。
saturday:1.hook: On the steps below us, a single white feather rose slowly against the wind.
saturday:1.line: 'They call it *Saturday* beyond the peaks — a day the clouds are said to rest.'

april:1.en: *April* arrived on the floating peaks as a slow brightening — the clouds turned from grey to pale gold each morning, and the herb plots on the south terrace broke open with green. Shen Wujiu marked the first day of the month on the stone calendar outside the hall with a thin line of ash.
april:1.cnHint: ____来临时，南台的草药圃一夜之间冒出了新绿，沈无咎在石历上划下了细细的灰线。
april:1.hook: Master Qingwu said nothing, but she watered the ash-mark before she watered the herbs.
april:1.line: 'Every *April* the mountain remembers something we are not yet old enough to know.'

register:1.en: At the Gate of Names, every new disciple must *register* their chosen word-herb before the stone tablet. I pressed my palm to the cold surface and spoke my word aloud. The tablet hummed, then fell silent. Master Qingwu watched from the steps, her expression unreadable.
register:1.cnHint: 在名字之门，弟子需要将自己的词草____在石碑上。
register:1.hook: The tablet's silence meant either great fortune or deep trouble.
register:1.line: 'You must *register* your word before the cloud closes,' said Master Qingwu.

skin:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a leaf of the Silver Dew Herb. 'Hold it against your *skin*,' he said, 'and the word written on it enters your blood directly.' I pressed the cool leaf to my wrist. A faint blue light spread along my arm and faded into silence.
skin:1.cnHint: 师兄让我将草药贴在____上，让词语直接进入血液。
skin:1.hook: The light faded, but the warmth it left behind did not.
skin:1.line: 'Press it to your *skin*, and the word will find your pulse,' said Shen Wujiu.

spirit:1.en: Before the Dawn Bell, Master Qingwu led us onto the open terrace above the clouds. 'A word-herb fed to the body heals flesh,' she said quietly, 'but a word held in the *spirit* heals what no medicine can reach.' I stood in the cold wind and tried to understand.
spirit:1.cnHint: 师尊说，存在于____中的词语，能治愈任何药物都无法触及的东西。
spirit:1.hook: Somewhere below the clouds, the Bell rang one note too many.
spirit:1.line: 'A word carried in the *spirit* outlasts any herb,' said Master Qingwu.

spread:1.en: Xiaoxing unrolled her practice scroll on the flat stone beside the path. The ink characters seemed to breathe; their meaning *spread* outward like ripples on still water, touching the air around us until even the nearest pine needles trembled. She looked up, surprised by her own strength.
spread:1.cnHint: 小星的字卷打开后，词语的力量像涟漪一样向四周____开来。
spread:1.hook: The trembling pine needles each bore a single glowing character.
spread:1.line: 'Watch how the meaning *spreads* before you try to hold it,' Xiaoxing said.

totally:1.en: I attempted the Rising Step formula alone on the outer ledge. My feet left the stone for one heartbeat, then I dropped back hard. Shen Wujiu crossed his arms. 'You are *totally* ignoring the breath count,' he said. 'The word needs air moving through it, not held still.'
totally:1.cnHint: 师兄指出我____忽视了口诀中的呼吸节奏。
totally:1.hook: Below the ledge, the sea of clouds waited with perfect patience.
totally:1.line: 'You are *totally* skipping the breath that carries the word,' said Shen Wujiu.

tree:1.en: At the edge of the sect's highest terrace stood one ancient *tree*, its roots gripping bare rock above the clouds. Master Qingwu said it had grown from a single spoken word left by the sect's founder long ago. Every leaf carried a faint hum that newcomers could feel but not yet read.
tree:1.cnHint: 高台边缘有一棵古老的____，据说由开派祖师的一个词语生长而成。
tree:1.hook: Tonight, for the first time, one leaf had gone completely silent.
tree:1.line: 'Touch the *tree* only when your chosen word is steady in your chest,' said Master Qingwu.

weigh:1.en: Before the Trial of Roots, Xiaoxing sat cross-legged on the stone path, eyes closed. 'I need to *weigh* each word-herb I carry,' she murmured, 'or I will bring too many and none will answer.' She set three leaves on her palm and held them until one rose, just slightly, on its own.
weigh:1.cnHint: 小星在试炼前仔细____自己携带的每一株词草，以免它们相互干扰。
weigh:1.hook: The leaf that rose was the one she had almost left behind.
weigh:1.line: '*Weigh* what you carry, or the words will argue with each other,' Xiaoxing said.

alive:1.en: After the storm of sound that the elder's demonstration sent across the terrace, everything felt sharper — the cold air, the smell of pine, the hum of the ancient tree. Shen Wujiu pressed a hand to the bark and smiled. 'The whole mountain is *alive* with it,' he said, almost to himself.
alive:1.cnHint: 前辈的演示结束后，师兄感受到整座山都因词语的力量而____起来。
alive:1.hook: Deep in the rock beneath our feet, something slowly answered back.
alive:1.line: 'Every stone here is *alive* with the words that were spoken into it,' said Shen Wujiu.

lift:1.en: The Grand Stairway of Cloud Peak had ten thousand steps. Shen Wujiu said there was no *lift* here — only your own legs and will could carry you upward. I set my foot on the first cold stone and breathed slowly, feeling the wind push against me like a warning.
lift:1.cnHint: 云巅大阶没有____，只能靠自己攀登。
lift:1.hook: At the thousandth step, the stone beneath me cracked.
lift:1.line: 'There is no *lift* here — only the strength you carry inside.'

mainly:1.en: Master Qingwu taught that the Outer Courtyard trained *mainly* the body, while the Inner Courtyard trained the spirit. I stood in the open yard at dawn, watching older disciples flow through their stances like water. I was still learning to stand without swaying in the high mountain wind.
mainly:1.cnHint: 外院____训练身体，师尊这样教导我们。
mainly:1.hook: Then the wind stopped — every leaf, utterly still.
mainly:1.line: 'We train *mainly* the body here, but the spirit listens.'

moral:1.en: Shen Wujiu carved old sayings into the bark of the great cypress near the gate. 'Each one holds a *moral*,' he told me, tracing the characters with one finger. I read them slowly as the clouds below the mountain shifted, as if the sky itself were turning a page.
moral:1.cnHint: 师兄说那棵柏树上的每句话都有一个____。
moral:1.hook: One saying had no words — only a single burned mark.
moral:1.line: 'Every lesson on this tree carries a *moral*, if you are still enough to hear it.'

nor:1.en: I had walked the outer ridge path a hundred times, yet that morning neither the birds *nor* the wind came. The silence sat on my shoulders like a stone. Xiaoxing appeared at my side without a sound and looked at the sky with eyes too steady for someone so young.
nor:1.cnHint: 那天清晨，鸟儿____风都没有出现。
nor:1.line: 'Neither the birds *nor* the wind will speak to you today.'

pick:1.en: Before the Dawn Ceremony, disciples gathered in the herb garden to *pick* the seven morning blooms needed for the opening rite. I reached for the pale silver flower at the centre, but Xiaoxing caught my wrist gently and shook her head, nodding toward a darker bloom beside it.
pick:1.cnHint: 清晨仪式前，弟子们到药园____七朵晨花。
pick:1.hook: The silver flower folded shut the moment I pulled back.
pick:1.line: 'You must *pick* the shadow bloom first — the silver one is a test.'

pollution:1.en: A grey haze drifted up from the valleys below the floating mountain, and Master Qingwu called it spiritual *pollution* — the residue of words spoken without care or understanding. She swept her sleeve across the air as though clearing smoke. We stood at the cliff edge and watched it rise slowly toward us.
pollution:1.cnHint: 山谷升起的灰雾被称为精神____。
pollution:1.hook: One wisp touched the first disciple's lantern, and the flame turned black.
pollution:1.line: 'This *pollution* rises from words broken before they were understood.'

quit:1.en: Shen Wujiu told me that three disciples had *quit* the ascent trial at the red flag marker — not from weakness, he said, but from hearing something in the wind that changed their minds. He looked at the marker for a long moment before walking on. I followed, ears open and half afraid.
quit:1.cnHint: 有三名弟子在红旗处____了攀升试炼。
quit:1.hook: As I passed the marker, I heard my own name, softly called.
quit:1.line: 'They did not fail — they *quit* only after the mountain spoke to them.'

recall:1.en: Halfway up the Ascending Path, I stopped to *recall* the breathing pattern Master Qingwu had shown us at the base of the mountain. The steps blurred together in my mind. Shen Wujiu paused above me and looked back, not with impatience, but with the quiet look of someone remembering the same struggle.
recall:1.cnHint: 爬到一半，我努力____师尊教过的呼吸方法。
recall:1.hook: The pattern came back — but one breath was missing.
recall:1.line: 'Stop, close your eyes, and *recall* exactly what she showed you at the base.'

anyway:1.en: The wind above the Cloud Sea Sect carried a strange warmth that morning. Xiaoxing had forgotten her herb pouch at the lower gate, but she climbed the stone steps to the open courtyard *anyway*, trusting that the day's lesson was more urgent than any missing tool.
anyway:1.cnHint: 小星忘带药囊，却____走上了石阶，来到院中准备上课。
anyway:1.hook: A shadow crossed the sun, and the courtyard fell silent.
anyway:1.line: '*Anyway*, I would rather face Master Qingwu empty-handed than arrive late.'

arise:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the edge of the outer cliff, watching morning mist roll across the floating peaks. He had learned that trouble could *arise* from stillness as easily as from storm — a lesson carved into him the day a silent crack split his practice stone without warning.
arise:1.cnHint: 沈无咎站在崖边，明白麻烦往往会在平静中____。
arise:1.hook: Below the mist, something vast and dark began to move.
arise:1.line: 'When doubts *arise*, do not push them away — read them like a rare herb.'

besides:1.en: Master Qingwu set three glowing word-herbs on the flat stone before her disciples. She said the first herb would sharpen memory, the second would steady breath, and the third held a secret she had not yet named. *Besides*, she added quietly, none of the three would work without honest effort.
besides:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊摆下三株字草，说明其用途，还____补充了一句告诫。
besides:1.hook: The third herb pulsed once, then dimmed.
besides:1.line: '*Besides* courage, you will need patience — the sky does not open for the hasty.'

certainly:1.en: Xiaoxing pressed her palm to the cold gate stone and felt a faint hum rise through her fingers. She had heard older disciples say the gate answered only to those whose will was clear. It would *certainly* not open for doubt, so she steadied her breath and thought of nothing but the peak above.
certainly:1.cnHint: 小星按住冷石门，心知意志不坚定的人____无法让它开启。
certainly:1.hook: The hum grew — then stopped, leaving only her heartbeat.
certainly:1.line: '*Certainly*, Master Qingwu — I will carry the herbs to the summit before dusk.'

challenging:1.en: The path of spiraling stone that led to the Sky-Word Hall was *challenging* even for senior disciples; every step demanded that the climber hold a spoken formula in mind without breaking its rhythm. Shen Wujiu had walked it a hundred times, yet today the words kept slipping from his tongue like water off cloud-moss.
challenging:1.cnHint: 通往天字堂的石径对弟子来说____极大，沈无咎今日却屡屡失口。
challenging:1.hook: At the halfway stone, his formula cracked — and the path shook.
challenging:1.line: 'This trial is *challenging*, but I have not come this far to turn back.'

circumstance:1.en: Master Qingwu gathered her disciples at the open pavilion where four wind-roads met. She told them that a word-herb's power changes with every *circumstance* — the same herb that heals in morning mist may burn in noon light. They would learn, she said, to read the sky before reaching for any remedy.
circumstance:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊在风亭讲授：字草的效用因____不同而改变。
circumstance:1.hook: As she spoke, the noon light turned an unnatural shade of green.
circumstance:1.line: 'In every *circumstance*, observe first — a rushed hand picks the wrong herb.'

comfort:1.en: After the long assessment on the outer ridge, Xiaoxing sat on a flat stone and watched the sea of clouds drift far below. The cool air and the soft sound of the wind offered her small but real *comfort*; she had not mastered every formula, but she had not given up, and that felt like enough.
comfort:1.cnHint: 考核结束后，小星独坐崖石，从清风与云海中得到了一丝____。
comfort:1.hook: Then a single red leaf fell upward, against all wind and reason.
comfort:1.line: '*Comfort* is not weakness, Xiaoxing — rest is part of the path.'

enrich:1.en: Shen Wujiu read aloud from the old stone tablet at the sect's eastern gate, his voice steady in the morning air. Master Qingwu had told her disciples that speaking ancient formulas aloud would *enrich* the spirit the way sunlight enriches the soil — slowly, and without fanfare, but with lasting effect.
enrich:1.cnHint: 沈无咎在东门石碑前诵读古诀，师尊说此举能____修士的心神。
enrich:1.hook: The last word left his lips, and the stone tablet began to glow.
enrich:1.line: 'Let these old words *enrich* you — carry them, and you will not walk empty.'

consideration:1.en: Master Qingwu laid seven herb-words along the stone path, each one glowing faintly in the morning mist. 'Before you choose,' she said, 'give every word proper *consideration*.' I studied each glow, each shape, each faint scent. At last I chose the word for wind. It lifted me one full step off the ground.
consideration:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊让我在选择草药字诀前仔细____，我最终选了风字，身体轻轻离地。
consideration:1.hook: Behind me, the word I did not choose began to pulse with a dark light.
consideration:1.line: 'Give every word proper *consideration* before you bind it to your breath.'

disaster:1.en: The outer path of Cloud Sea Sect wound between two peaks, open to the sky. Shen Wujiu pointed at a blackened scar on the cliff face. 'A disciple once spoke three words together without training,' he said. 'The result was *disaster*.' I touched the stone. It crumbled under my finger like cold ash.
disaster:1.cnHint: 师兄指着峭壁上的焦痕，讲述一位弟子因同时念出三个字诀而造成____的往事。
disaster:1.hook: Somewhere below the clouds, the same three words were drifting upward again.
disaster:1.line: 'Speaking them together without training brought total *disaster* to this peak.'

emergency:1.en: A bell rang once from the high tower — the tone that meant the word-garden was in danger. Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve. 'That ring is an *emergency* signal,' she said, already moving. We ran along the outer bridge, wind cutting our faces. The garden gate stood open when it should have been sealed.
emergency:1.cnHint: 高塔的钟声响起，小星告诉我这是____信号，我们冲向字诀园，发现园门大开。
emergency:1.hook: Inside, every herb-word had gone perfectly, completely silent.
emergency:1.line: 'One bell means *emergency* — we never walk when we hear it.'

familiar:1.en: I had walked the Cloud Road three times now, and its turns were becoming *familiar* to me — the sharp bend above the white falls, the flat stone where the echo lived. Shen Wujiu said that was when true learning began: not when a path was new, but when you knew it well enough to notice what had changed.
familiar:1.cnHint: 我走过云路三次后，路上的每个转弯开始变得____，师兄说这时才是真正学习的开始。
familiar:1.hook: This morning the flat stone where the echo lived was silent.
familiar:1.line: 'When the road feels *familiar*, that is when you must look harder at it.'

furthermore:1.en: Master Qingwu set the word for stone before me and asked what I felt. I said it was heavy and still. She nodded. '*Furthermore*,' she added, 'it is patient — it holds weight without complaint, and it does not ask to be thanked.' I pressed my palm against the glowing character. I felt something old and calm move through my bones.
furthermore:1.cnHint: 青雾师尊让我感受石字的重与静，____还告诉我它有耐性，我将手掌贴上字诀，感到古老的力量流过骨骼。
furthermore:1.hook: The word for stone then cracked down its centre, perfectly in two.
furthermore:1.line: 'It is heavy and still — *furthermore*, it is more patient than any disciple I have known.'

hardly:1.en: I had practiced the wind-word for six mornings, but I could *hardly* lift a single leaf with it. The leaf lay on the stone table, unmoving, almost mocking. Xiaoxing watched from the doorway, saying nothing. On the seventh morning, without trying any harder, the leaf rose, turned once, and settled on my open hand.
hardly:1.cnHint: 练习了六个清晨的风字诀，我____能吹动一片叶子，第七天清晨叶子却自己飘到了我手心。
hardly:1.hook: On the far mountain, ten thousand leaves rose all at once.
hardly:1.line: 'I could *hardly* move a single leaf, and then the mountain answered me.'

hinder:1.en: The mist between the peaks was thick by midday, but Shen Wujiu walked without slowing. 'Does the cloud not *hinder* you?' I asked, half-blind beside him. 'It would,' he said, 'if I fought it. I breathe the word for open, and the mist steps aside.' I tried it. The cloud parted around me, soft as a curtain.
hinder:1.cnHint: 云雾弥漫却没有____师兄前行，他教我念开字诀，云雾便温柔地让出了路。
hinder:1.hook: Then a mist we had never seen before rose from directly below our feet.
hinder:1.line: 'Let the mist *hinder* you once, and you will learn to speak before you walk.'

injury:1.en: Near the eastern ledge, a young disciple sat with one hand wrapped in white cloth. Xiaoxing knelt beside them and placed the herb-word for heal against the bandage. 'An *injury* from a word spoken backward,' she told me quietly afterward. The cloth fell away clean. But the disciple's shadow, I noticed, still bent the wrong way.
injury:1.cnHint: 小星用愈字诀为一名因倒念字诀而受____的弟子疗伤，伤口愈合了，影子却还是反的。
injury:1.hook: That evening, my own shadow paused a half-step behind me on the path.
injury:1.line: 'An *injury* from a backward word heals slowly — the sound remembers the mistake.'

egg:1.en: On the outer terrace of the sect gate, a stone *egg* rested in a crack between two ancient tiles. Master Qingwu knelt beside it, her fingers tracing faint golden lines across its shell. 'A sky-phoenix embryo,' she said softly. 'It has been waiting here longer than our sect has stood.'
egg:1.cnHint: 宗门石阶的缝隙中，师尊发现了一枚散发金光的____，令众弟子屏息。
egg:1.hook: The egg trembled once, then went still — but warmer.
egg:1.line: 'This *egg* must not be moved until the next full moon.'

hire:1.en: At the base of the mountain path, a crowd of waiting disciples argued near a wooden board of posted tasks. Shen Wujiu read aloud the topmost notice: the Sect Elder wished to *hire* a guide who knew the cloud-paths beyond the third peak. No one raised a hand. I raised mine.
hire:1.cnHint: 宗门在山道入口张贴告示，要____一位熟悉云路的向导，众师兄都沉默了。
hire:1.hook: The elder's brush paused above my name, then descended.
hire:1.line: 'They want to *hire* someone brave — or someone foolish.'

aid:1.en: A young messenger bird fell from the sky and landed hard on the plaza stones near the water gate. Xiaoxing rushed forward and cupped the trembling creature in both hands. She looked up at me, eyes wide. 'It carries a seal-letter from the northern outpost. They are asking for *aid*.'
aid:1.cnHint: 信使鸟坠落在广场上，带来了北方哨所请求____的急信。
aid:1.hook: The seal on the letter was already cracked open from the inside.
aid:1.line: 'Send word back — our *aid* will arrive before dawn.'

bill:1.en: Outside the medicine hall, a long paper *bill* was pinned to the door for all to read. It listed every rare herb the Sect had consumed that season. Shen Wujiu whistled low at the final sum. Master Qingwu arrived behind us, folded the bill once, and placed it in her sleeve without a word.
bill:1.cnHint: 药堂门外贴着这一季所有珍稀草药消耗的____，数目让人咋舌。
bill:1.hook: One line on the bill named a herb that no longer existed.
bill:1.line: 'This *bill* tells me someone has been taking more than their share.'

paint:1.en: On the great outer wall facing the cloud sea, an unknown hand had begun to *paint* a map of the sky-paths in vivid blue and white. By morning the image stretched twenty paces wide. Neither brush nor bucket was found nearby. Xiaoxing pressed her palm flat against one still-wet line and pulled it back, stained.
paint:1.cnHint: 宗门外墙上，有人趁夜____出了一幅巨大的天路图，无人知晓作者是谁。
paint:1.hook: The map showed a mountain our charts had never recorded.
paint:1.line: 'Whoever chose to *paint* this knew exactly where they were going.'

bean:1.en: The morning market below the gate arch smelled of roasting grain. An old vendor offered Xiaoxing a cloth bag of dried spirit-*bean*, each one carved with a tiny word-seal. She shook one into her palm and the word glowed faint green before fading. 'Plant it,' the vendor said, 'and something will answer.'
bean:1.cnHint: 山门集市上，一位老摊贩向小星兜售刻有文字印记的灵____，声称种下去自有回应。
bean:1.hook: The vendor was gone before Xiaoxing looked up again.
bean:1.line: 'Each *bean* holds one word — choose the wrong one and it roots in you.'

birthday:1.en: At dawn, paper lanterns lined the stone bridge outside the sect hall — someone had remembered. Shen Wujiu leaned on the railing and said nothing for a long moment. It was his *birthday*, the first one spent above the clouds rather than at home in the valley. A single crane circled overhead and cried once.
birthday:1.cnHint: 石桥上挂满灯笼，今天是师兄第一次在云端上方度过的____。
birthday:1.hook: The crane's cry sounded less like greeting and more like warning.
birthday:1.line: 'A *birthday* above the clouds means heaven has noticed you now.'

flight:1.en: We gathered at the launching terrace as the morning mist thinned. Master Qingwu stepped onto the wind-board and checked the iron fittings once. This was no practice run. 'Our *flight* to the upper peaks begins the moment the bell sounds,' she said. Below us, the cloud sea swelled as if it too was holding its breath.
flight:1.cnHint: 师尊站上风板，宣布前往更高山峰的____即将在钟声响起时开始。
flight:1.hook: The bell rang — but from below, not above.
flight:1.line: 'This *flight* will take us past the point of easy return.'

facilitate:1.en: At dawn, Master Qingwu traced a silver path of wind across the outer courtyard stones. 'These carved channels,' she said, touching the grooves, 'will *facilitate* the flow of cloud-qi from the mountain roots up to our training ground.' Shen Wujiu and I watched the mist rise along the lines like obedient water.
facilitate:1.cnHint: 清晨，师尊在庭院地面刻下风道，____弟子们修炼时云气的流动。
facilitate:1.hook: But one groove ended where no stone should end.
facilitate:1.line: 'These channels *facilitate* the qi; do not let your feet break them.'

insight:1.en: Xiaoxing sat alone on the outer ledge, eyes closed, facing the sea of clouds below the mountain. When she opened them she said nothing, only smiled. Master Qingwu called that look a true *insight* — the kind that arrives not from study but from stillness, and costs the student something they cannot name.
insight:1.cnHint: 小星静坐云崖边，闭目凝神后展现出一种难得的____，令师尊感到欣慰。
insight:1.hook: Then the clouds beneath her feet began to thin.
insight:1.line: 'Real *insight* does not shout; it arrives like morning light.'

preparation:1.en: The trial gate would open at noon. Shen Wujiu spread dried spirit-herbs across a flat rock, sorting them by colour and weight. Every careful step he took was part of his *preparation* for the ascent trial. I counted twelve bundles; the gate, I had heard, demanded thirteen.
preparation:1.cnHint: 沈无咎在试炼门开启前，于山间岩石上细心完成____工作，却似乎少算了一样东西。
preparation:1.hook: The gate opened one breath before noon.
preparation:1.line: 'Good *preparation* is the first half of any victory,' Shen Wujiu said.

separate:1.en: A line of white mist cut through the outer yard, splitting the earth into two colours: warm amber near the hall and cold silver near the cliff. Master Qingwu said the mist would *separate* disciples who were ready from those who only believed they were ready. I stood exactly on the line.
separate:1.cnHint: 一道白雾将庭院____为两个区域，师尊说这是对弟子真实状态的考验。
separate:1.hook: The mist moved, and the line moved with it.
separate:1.line: 'The trial will *separate* the certain from the merely hopeful.'

tie:1.en: Before the ascent, each disciple received a length of cloud-silk. Xiaoxing showed me how to *tie* it around the left wrist in three careful knots, each one a promise: to climb, to return, to remember. Shen Wujiu watched, silent, his own silk already knotted tight and perfectly even.
tie:1.cnHint: 升天试炼前，小星教我用云丝____在手腕上，三个结各有深意。
tie:1.hook: My third knot slipped loose the moment I stood.
tie:1.line: '*Tie* it with intention, or the wind will read your doubt.'

jam:1.en: Halfway up the stone path to the trial gate, all twelve disciples stopped. The narrow pass was a *jam* of nervous bodies and heavy supply sacks, no one willing to step forward first. The clouds below swirled impatiently. Somewhere ahead, a low bell struck once and did not strike again.
jam:1.cnHint: 通往试炼门的石径上，弟子们因拥挤____而止步不前，谁也不敢率先踏出一步。
jam:1.hook: The bell's echo faded before it should have.
jam:1.line: 'This *jam* of feet and fear will cost us the first light.'

supermarket:1.en: A visiting merchant had built a row of open stalls along the base-mountain road, selling spirit-roots and rare soils. Xiaoxing laughed and called it a *supermarket* of the sky, everything labelled and priced and stacked in neat rows. Master Qingwu did not laugh, and the merchant did not meet her eyes.
supermarket:1.cnHint: 山脚下商贩摆开的货摊被小星戏称为天上的____，但师尊的神色却十分凝重。
supermarket:1.hook: One labelled jar held something that moved.
supermarket:1.line: 'Even a *supermarket* of rare herbs means nothing without a pure heart.'

debate:1.en: At the cloud-ferry landing, Shen Wujiu and Xiaoxing stood on opposite sides of a carved post, voices low and steady. They were deep in *debate* about whether the eastern path or the western ridge would carry us closer to the gate before the trial fog rose. I looked up and saw the fog was already rising.
debate:1.cnHint: 在云渡口，沈无咎与小星就路线选择展开____，而他们争论的那团雾已悄然升起。
debate:1.hook: The fog chose the path for them.
debate:1.line: 'We can *debate* the route, but the mountain will not wait for us.'

housing:1.en: At the base of the Ascending Path, rows of small stone rooms clung to the cliff face like swallows' nests. Shen Wujiu swept his arm wide. 'New disciples share *housing* here until their first word-herb blooms,' he said. Each door bore a carved character that glowed faintly at dusk, as though the mountain itself was reading us.
housing:1.cnHint: 云海宗山壁上的石屋是新弟子的____，每扇门上的字符在黄昏时微微发光。
housing:1.hook: Behind the last door, one character had already turned black.
housing:1.line: 'New disciples share *housing* here until their first word-herb blooms.'

behaviour:1.en: Master Qingwu circled us slowly on the open terrace above the clouds. 'Every word you speak becomes a seed,' she said. 'The sect judges not your talent but your *behaviour* — how you carry each formula, how you set it down.' I straightened my back and held my breath, feeling the mist taste my intentions.
behaviour:1.cnHint: 师尊在云端平台上告诫弟子们，修炼的关键在于____，而非天赋。
behaviour:1.hook: A seed of light drifted from her sleeve and settled on the one who had lied.
behaviour:1.line: 'The sect judges not your talent but your *behaviour*.'

husband:1.en: An old woman sat outside the market gate selling dried cloud-moss. She pressed a small bundle into my hands and refused payment. 'My *husband* once learned the healing word here,' she said softly, eyes distant. 'He is gone now, but the word still grows in our garden.' The moss smelled of pine and old sorrow.
husband:1.cnHint: 集市门口一位老妇人提起她的____曾在此学过治愈之词，令人动容。
husband:1.hook: When I looked back, the woman and her basket had both vanished.
husband:1.line: 'My *husband* once learned the healing word here.'

tourist:1.en: A visitor in bright robes drifted through the outer market, pausing at every herb-stall with wide, delighted eyes. 'Even a *tourist* can feel the words humming,' Xiaoxing murmured beside me, watching him lift a jar of sky-salt and frown at the price. Then the humming stopped, and every herb on the nearest stall wilted at once.
tourist:1.cnHint: 一位____在外市闲逛，感受到字词的震动——直到所有草药突然枯萎。
tourist:1.hook: The visitor's bright robe had no sect mark anywhere on it.
tourist:1.line: 'Even a *tourist* can feel the words humming in this place.'

agent:1.en: Shen Wujiu pulled me aside near the cloud-dye stalls. 'That man in grey is an *agent* for the lowland merchants,' he said quietly. 'He trades silver for stolen word-seeds.' I watched the man pass a folded paper beneath a bolt of blue cloth. Above us, a patrol crane circled lower and lower without landing.
agent:1.cnHint: 师兄警告我，那个灰衣人是低地商人的____，专门收购被盗的字词种子。
agent:1.hook: The folded paper began to smoke at the edges in the cold air.
agent:1.line: 'That man in grey is an *agent* for the lowland merchants.'

cash:1.en: The seed-market opened at first light, and every stall demanded immediate payment. 'No credit above the clouds,' the elder vendor said flatly. 'Only *cash* — copper rounds or sky-glass chips.' I counted my last three chips into her palm. She held each one up to the sun, and the third one cast a shadow shaped like a warning sign.
cash:1.cnHint: 云端集市只收____，我数出最后三枚天玻璃币，第三枚投下了奇怪的影子。
cash:1.hook: The shadow-shape matched the seal on Master Qingwu's forbidden scroll.
cash:1.line: 'Only *cash* — copper rounds or sky-glass chips, nothing else.'

competition:1.en: Once a season the outer disciples gathered at the Sky-Split Bridge for the Word-Sprint — a *competition* to see who could light the bridge stones fastest by speaking the fire formula aloud. I placed third. But Xiaoxing, who placed last, whispered her word so gently that the final stone glowed warmest of all, long after the others had cooled.
competition:1.cnHint: 每季一次的字词____中，小星得了最后一名，她的石头却燃得最久。
competition:1.hook: A crack split the bridge's oldest stone the moment the scores were read.
competition:1.line: 'This *competition* reveals more than speed — it reveals your heart.'

farmer:1.en: On the lower terrace where herbs were grown in rows of cloud-soil, an old man knelt pressing seeds into the earth one by one. Shen Wujiu bowed low. 'He was a *farmer* before he joined the sect,' he told me. 'Master Qingwu says his hands know patience better than any formula.' The old man did not look up, but the seeds began to glow.
farmer:1.cnHint: 低台菜地里，曾是____的老人一粒一粒播种，他的双手比任何咒语都更懂得耐心。
farmer:1.hook: Every seed he had just planted spelled out a single, unreadable word.
farmer:1.line: 'He was a *farmer* before he ever touched a single word-herb.'

collection:1.en: At the foot of the Sky-Root Cliff, Master Qingwu spread her *collection* of dried spirit-herbs across a wide stone table. Each root and petal had been gathered from a different floating peak. I knelt beside her, studying their colours, trying to learn which could cure and which could kill.
collection:1.cnHint: 师尊在悬崖石桌上展示她多年积累的____，我跪在一旁细心学习。
collection:1.hook: One herb, I noticed, had begun to glow.
collection:1.line: 'This *collection* took thirty years and three lives to complete,' said Master Qingwu.

depression:1.en: Shen Wujiu found me sitting alone in a shallow *depression* in the mountain path, head low, eyes fixed on the clouds below. I had failed the morning recitation for the third time. He sat beside me without a word, and handed me a warm cup of pine-needle tea.
depression:1.cnHint: 师兄在山路的____处发现了垂头丧气的我，默默递来一杯热茶。
depression:1.hook: The tea tasted of something I could not yet name.
depression:1.line: 'A *depression* in stone still holds rainwater,' said Shen Wujiu softly.

foot:1.en: I stood at the *foot* of the Grand Stair, five hundred steps of white stone rising into low cloud. Every new disciple climbs it on the first dawn. Master Qingwu watched from above, still as a heron. I took one breath, lifted my heel, and began.
foot:1.cnHint: 我站在大台阶的____，准备踏上每位新弟子都必须攀登的五百级石阶。
foot:1.hook: At the hundredth step, the stone beneath me hummed.
foot:1.line: 'At the *foot* of this stair, many have already turned back,' said Master Qingwu.

graduate:1.en: Xiaoxing showed me the honour board near the outer gate, where the name of every *graduate* of the Cloud Sea Sect was carved in pale jade. She traced one name with her finger and smiled. 'My elder sister,' she said. The carving caught the morning light and shone briefly gold.
graduate:1.cnHint: 小星在荣誉碑上指给我看，每一位____的名字都刻在淡玉之上。
graduate:1.hook: One name near the top was still warm to the touch.
graduate:1.line: 'Every *graduate* carved here once stood exactly where you stand,' said Xiaoxing.

intake:1.en: Master Qingwu watched my breathing during the dawn exercise and shook her head. 'Your *intake* is too sharp,' she said. 'You pull the cloud-qi in like a fist, not like an open hand.' Around us the morning mist moved gently between the pine trees, waiting to be invited, not seized.
intake:1.cnHint: 晨练时，师尊指出我气息的____方式过于急促，需要柔和如掌而非紧握如拳。
intake:1.hook: When I breathed correctly at last, the mist leaned toward me.
intake:1.line: 'Slow your *intake*, or the cloud-qi will scatter,' said Master Qingwu.

screen:1.en: A bamboo *screen* stood at the entrance to the outer courtyard, painted with cranes and mist. Shen Wujiu told me it was not decoration. Words of warding were hidden inside the brushstrokes. Any disciple who could read them all was permitted to pass beyond it without an elder's company.
screen:1.cnHint: 外院入口处立着一扇竹制____，其笔画中藏着只有能读懂的弟子才能独自通过的护符文字。
screen:1.hook: I could almost read the third stroke — almost.
screen:1.line: 'The *screen* has turned away stronger disciples than you,' said Shen Wujiu, not unkindly.

chair:1.en: An empty *chair* sat at the centre of the debating ground, carved from cloud-iron wood and worn smooth by generations of use. Xiaoxing whispered that only the sect's chosen speaker may sit there during the great sky-forum. Today it was empty. Tomorrow, one disciple's name would be called.
chair:1.cnHint: 辩论场中央摆着一把____，小星悄声告诉我明天将有一名弟子被选中坐上它。
chair:1.hook: A single white feather rested on the seat.
chair:1.line: 'Whoever earns that *chair* speaks for all of us,' whispered Xiaoxing.

court:1.en: We crossed the stone *court* behind the Hall of First Words just as evening light turned the paving orange. Master Qingwu paused and looked up. A second moon, faint and bluish, hung beside the real one. She said nothing, but her sleeve tightened around her wrist as she walked on.
court:1.cnHint: 我们穿过初言堂后的石____时，师尊抬头看见了天上异常的第二轮月影。
court:1.hook: No record in the sect's history mentioned two moons.
court:1.line: 'Do not linger in this *court* after dark,' said Master Qingwu.

female:1.en: On the stone path below the Outer Gate, a small *female* crane stood apart from the flock, her feathers pale as morning cloud. Master Qingwu watched her without a word. Shen Wujiu leaned close and whispered that such birds only appeared before a great ascension. The crane turned one bright eye toward me.
female:1.cnHint: 外门石道上，师尊凝视着一只落单的____仙鹤，同门师兄低声说这预示着飞升将至。
female:1.hook: The crane opened her beak, and no sound came out.
female:1.line: 'That *female* crane has not moved since dawn,' said Master Qingwu.

holiday:1.en: The Lantern Cloud *holiday* filled every terrace of the sect with soft gold light. Disciples hung herb-bundles from the rail posts and sang old formulas like folk songs. Xiaoxing pressed a small warm lantern into my hands, her eyes bright. Somewhere above us, a bell rang once, out of turn.
holiday:1.cnHint: 云灯____节，小星将一盏灯递给我，节日气氛中一声错时的钟声骤然响起。
holiday:1.hook: One lantern rose higher than all the rest, then vanished.
holiday:1.line: 'On this *holiday*, even the sky listens more closely,' Xiaoxing said.

pain:1.en: I knelt on the cold summit terrace and pressed my palm to the cracked spirit-stone. The *pain* climbed my arm like a slow fire, yet Master Qingwu had said to hold on until the stone accepted me. Shen Wujiu stood at the edge, counting my breaths aloud to keep me steady.
pain:1.cnHint: 我跪在寒冷的山顶石台上，忍着____将手掌压在破裂的灵石上，师兄为我数着呼吸。
pain:1.hook: At the ninth breath, the crack in the stone began to glow.
pain:1.line: 'Bear the *pain* a little longer; the stone is almost warm,' Shen Wujiu said.

player:1.en: Near the sect's lower market, a traveling *player* tossed painted tiles into the air and caught them in patterns said to mirror the sixty-four cloud formations. A crowd gathered. Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve and pointed: one tile hung in the air a breath too long before it fell.
player:1.cnHint: 在宗门下市，一位卖艺____将彩砖抛入空中，小星拉住我，指着那枚在空中多停了一息的砖。
player:1.hook: The tile landed face-down, and the crowd went silent.
player:1.line: 'That *player* knows more than he shows,' Xiaoxing whispered.

production:1.en: The sect's outer courtyard was busy with the morning *production* of cloud-ink, a thick silver liquid used to write ascension formulas on silk. Workers poured, stirred, and sealed clay jars in careful order. Shen Wujiu told me one dropped jar could erase a disciple's name from the sect record entirely.
production:1.cnHint: 宗门外院正忙着云墨的____，师兄告诉我，一罐云墨打碎便可抹去一名弟子的所有记录。
production:1.hook: One jar near the edge rocked, then stilled, then rocked again.
production:1.line: 'The *production* of cloud-ink must never be rushed,' Shen Wujiu said.

secure:1.en: Before the trial path opened, Master Qingwu walked the rope bridge herself and checked every knot. Only when she nodded did she call it *secure*. The bridge crossed nothing but open air and white cloud far below. I counted the knots as I stepped onto the first plank and lost count at seven.
secure:1.cnHint: 师尊亲自检查绳桥每个结，确认____后才示意我踏上去，桥下是无边的云海。
secure:1.hook: Halfway across, the bridge gave one long, slow shiver.
secure:1.line: 'The bridge is *secure*; walk without fear,' Master Qingwu said.

audience:1.en: At dawn, Master Qingwu granted a formal *audience* on the outer cliff terrace, where the wind carried words away before they could be written down. I stood before her as mist moved between us. She asked only one question, and the answer I gave made her look past me, toward the rising sun.
audience:1.cnHint: 黎明时分，师尊在崖台上正式____我，她只问了一个问题，我的回答令她望向了初升的太阳。
audience:1.hook: She did not tell me whether my answer was right.
audience:1.line: 'This *audience* will shape your path more than any test,' Master Qingwu said.

borrow:1.en: Xiaoxing caught me at the herb steps and asked if she could *borrow* my wind-formula tablet for the afternoon trial. She said her own had cracked in the frost. I handed it over without thinking, and only later noticed she had left her own cracked tablet in my bag as quiet thanks.
borrow:1.cnHint: 小星在药草台阶拦住我，请求____我的风诀玉简，还给我时我才发现她悄悄留下了她自己的碎玉简。
borrow:1.hook: The cracked tablet in my bag began to hum softly.
borrow:1.line: 'May I *borrow* your tablet, just until sunset?' Xiaoxing asked.

mile:1.en: The trial path wound across the open sky-platform, stretching a full *mile* between the starting stone and the Gate of Ascension. Master Qingwu stood at the far end, still as cloud. Each step I took felt heavier than the last, as though the air itself was testing my will to rise.
mile:1.cnHint: 弟子在天台上走完漫长的____，才能抵达飞升之门。
mile:1.hook: At the halfway mark, the Gate began to close.
mile:1.line: 'One *mile* of sky — walk it without fear, and the Gate will know you.'

movement:1.en: Before dawn, Master Qingwu gathered us on the outer terrace. 'Watch,' she said, and drew one slow arc with her sleeve. Every *movement* she made left a faint silver trail in the cold air, each trail a word of the Ascension Formula. I tried to copy her, but my trails faded before they could form.
movement:1.cnHint: 师尊在露台上演示飞升法诀，每一个____都在空中留下银色痕迹。
movement:1.hook: Mine faded — then one trace, at last, held.
movement:1.line: 'Each *movement* of your hand must carry intent, not just shape.'

party:1.en: A *party* of outer disciples arrived at the Cloud Gate just as the morning bell rang. Shen Wujiu counted them quietly — seven, all carrying sealed herb-cases. Master Qingwu frowned. 'They come from the South Peak,' she murmured. 'That sect does not share its formulas freely. Something has changed.'
party:1.cnHint: 一____弟子带着封印的药匣抵达云门，师尊神色凝重。
party:1.hook: Their herb-cases all bore the same broken seal.
party:1.line: 'The *party* from South Peak never travels without a reason — watch them.'

rescue:1.en: High above the lower terraces, Xiaoxing had climbed too far chasing a rare wind-herb and now clung to a narrow ledge. Shen Wujiu leapt without a word. His sleeve caught her wrist at the last breath of a moment. The *rescue* was over in seconds, but my heart did not slow for a long time.
rescue:1.cnHint: 小星攀高台时险些坠落，师兄及时____了她。
rescue:1.hook: The wind-herb, freed, drifted upward — still unclaimed.
rescue:1.line: 'A *rescue* means nothing if you climb reckless again, little sister.'

writing:1.en: Carved into the base of the Ascension Pillar was ancient *writing* I had never seen in any scroll. The characters curved like rising smoke. Master Qingwu knelt and touched one line gently. 'These are the original words of our founders,' she said. 'They still hold power. Read carefully — some lines are warnings.'
writing:1.cnHint: 飞升柱底部刻有上古____，师尊说其中藏有警示。
writing:1.hook: One carved line glowed faint red under her fingers.
writing:1.line: 'The *writing* on this pillar has not changed in three hundred years — until today.'

bite:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small cloud-plum before the final trial. 'Eat,' he said simply. I took one *bite* and felt warmth spread from my chest to my fingertips. The sour-sweet taste sharpened my focus like a clear bell. Xiaoxing watched with wide eyes. Even a small thing, I realised, could shift one's whole bearing.
bite:1.cnHint: 师兄递来云梅，弟子____了一口，感到精神一振。
bite:1.hook: The warmth reached my palms just as the trial bell rang.
bite:1.line: 'One *bite* before a trial — it is a small kindness, but it counts.'

capture:1.en: Master Qingwu set a sphere of pure wind-light spinning above the platform. 'Your task,' she said, 'is to *capture* it with a single formula word before it rises beyond reach.' Shen Wujiu had done it in one breath. I raised my hand, shaped the word, and released — the sphere stilled for one perfect moment.
capture:1.cnHint: 师尊命弟子用法诀____旋转的风光球。
capture:1.hook: Then it shattered — and left a map in the air.
capture:1.line: 'To *capture* the light, you must first be as still as the light itself.'

cope:1.en: The ascension winds hit without warning, spinning the outer walkway until I could not tell sky from cloud. Xiaoxing pressed her back against the pillar, eyes shut. I reached for her hand. Neither of us spoke. We had to *cope* with the storm together, step by careful step, until Master Qingwu's lamp appeared ahead.
cope:1.cnHint: 飞升风暴突然袭来，弟子与小星相互扶持，努力____。
cope:1.hook: Master Qingwu's lamp burned steady — but she was not holding it.
cope:1.line: 'We *cope* not by standing firm alone, but by holding the same ground together.'

salary:1.en: On the Grand Market terrace, floating stalls sold bottled starlight and dried cloud-moss. Master Qingwu examined each price tag with calm eyes. 'A disciple's *salary* of merit points,' she said, 'is earned breath by breath, not spent in a single morning.' I tucked my coin-pouch away, ashamed.
salary:1.cnHint: 师尊在云市告诫我，____要一点一滴地挣，不能一早上就花光。
salary:1.hook: But one stall held a price no merit points could ever cover.
salary:1.line: 'Your *salary* of merit points must be earned, not squandered.'

shopping:1.en: Shen Wujiu led me through the Cloudbridge Bazaar, where herb-sellers called out from hovering baskets. He moved with ease, nodding at familiar faces. '*Shopping* here sharpens the eye,' he said, lifting a frost-root to the light. 'You learn which words heal and which merely look beautiful.' I watched and said nothing.
shopping:1.cnHint: 师兄带我在云桥集市____，说这能磨练辨别真伪的眼力。
shopping:1.hook: Then a vendor pressed a black herb into my hand and vanished.
shopping:1.line: '*Shopping* here will teach you more than any scroll can.'

tendency:1.en: We stood on the Sky-Root Bridge as morning mist rose from the cloud sea below. Master Qingwu traced the wind with one finger. 'You have a *tendency* to reach for power before you understand it,' she said quietly. The bridge hummed underfoot. Far below, something vast moved in the white folds of cloud.
tendency:1.cnHint: 师尊在天根桥上指出，我有一种在理解之前就抢先动手的____。
tendency:1.hook: The humming grew louder, as though the bridge itself disagreed.
tendency:1.line: 'Your *tendency* to rush will one day cost you something dear.'

tough:1.en: The Path of Ascending Stones was a *tough* climb even for senior disciples, each slab tilting under wind that smelled of ozone and old lightning. Xiaoxing kept pace beside me, her breath steady. 'Do not look down,' she advised. Above us, the sect gate floated like a paper lantern against the pale sky.
tough:1.cnHint: 飞升石阶的攀爬十分____，连师兄们都走得艰难，师妹却气息平稳。
tough:1.hook: One stone tilted too far, and my foot found only sky.
tough:1.line: 'The road is *tough*, but the gate is already waiting for us.'

tour:1.en: Every new disciple takes a *tour* of the outer peaks before their first lesson. Shen Wujiu walked ahead, naming each mountain in a low voice. The clouds shifted and revealed a peak I had not seen on any map. It floated apart from the others, wrapped in a silence that felt deliberate and cold.
tour:1.cnHint: 每位新弟子都要____外峰，师兄逐一报名，却有一座山不在地图上。
tour:1.hook: Shen Wujiu paused at that peak and did not say its name.
tour:1.line: 'Every disciple must *tour* the peaks before the trials begin.'

wake:1.en: We gathered on the Dawn Platform as the sect's oldest word-tree was removed. Master Qingwu stood at its stump in silence. It was a quiet *wake* for something that had given shade and meaning for three hundred years. Petals drifted down through the cloud layer and did not return. Xiaoxing held her sleeve over her face.
