store:2.en: Deep in the sect's inner hall, I found a *store* of forgotten word-scrolls stacked behind a stone door no one had opened in years. Each scroll held a healing formula, dry and waiting like seeds before rain. Shen Wujiu said the old disciples had sealed them away during a great storm. I counted twelve. Then I counted eleven.
store:2.cnHint: 我在内殿深处发现了一批被遗忘已久的____，取出时却发现数目少了一卷。
store:2.hook: One scroll was gone, and the stone door had no dust on its handle.
store:2.line: 'This *store* of scrolls was sealed by our founders — touch nothing until Master Qingwu arrives.'

budget:2.en: Master Qingwu spread a worn ledger across the altar stone and showed us the sect's yearly *budget* for spiritual herbs — enough for forty word-seeds, no more. Xiaoxing traced the numbers with one careful finger. Outside, the cloud-sea shifted, and three herbs we had already planted turned grey before sunset.
budget:2.cnHint: 师尊展示了门派的草药____，但当晚种下的灵草无故枯萎了三株。
budget:2.hook: The numbers balanced perfectly, yet something vital was already missing.
budget:2.line: 'Our *budget* for rare herbs is fixed — every wasted seed is a word we cannot speak.'

grant:2.en: The sect elders gathered at dawn and, after long silence, offered to *grant* me a single sky-passage token — permission to climb to the highest peak where living word-flowers grew. Shen Wujiu squeezed my shoulder once and said nothing. I bowed and accepted. A cold wind rose the moment the token touched my palm.
grant:2.cnHint: 长老们决定____我一枚通行令牌，我接过的瞬间，山风骤然变冷。
grant:2.hook: The token was warm when they held it, and ice-cold the moment it reached me.
grant:2.line: 'We *grant* this passage to you alone — return before the cloud-sea rises at dusk.'

hospital:2.en: In the old records I found a drawing of the Healing Pavilion, which the text called a *hospital* of words — a place where sick disciples came to hear formulas read aloud until their breath steadied. It had stood on the east cliff for three hundred years. I looked east. The cliff held only empty air and a ring of dead flowers.
hospital:2.cnHint: 古籍中记载着一座以词语为药的____，但我抬头望去，那处山崖已空无一物。
hospital:2.hook: Three hundred years of healing, and not one stone remained to show it.
hospital:2.line: 'Every great sect once kept a *hospital* of words — ours was lost the night the east cliff fell.'

island:2.en: Among the floating peaks, one stood fully alone, cut off from all rope-bridges — a true *island* of stone above the cloud-sea. Xiaoxing pointed to it at midday and said a single word-tree grew there, its roots gripping bare rock. By evening the peak had drifted closer. No wind had blown all day.
island:2.cnHint: 云海之上有一座孤悬的浮峰____，傍晚时它在无风之中悄悄靠近了。
island:2.hook: It moved without wind, without sound, and its roots glowed faintly in the dusk.
island:2.line: 'That *island* of stone has no bridge and no path — yet someone has been tending the tree on it.'

native:2.en: Shen Wujiu told me that the oldest word-seeds were *native* to this mountain range — they could not be carried to lower ground without losing all power. I had packed three in my robe, planning to study them in my room. When I opened my hand at the foot of the stairs, they were only grey dust and a faint smell of rain.
native:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，最古老的词种是这片山脉____的，我试图带走三粒，它们却化为了灰尘。
native:2.hook: They turned to dust in my palm, and the dust rose upward instead of falling.
native:2.line: 'These seeds are *native* to the high peaks — carry them down and you carry nothing at all.'

tradition:2.en: It was the sect's oldest *tradition*: on the first night of each new season, every disciple lit a word-lantern and set it free above the cloud-sea. I folded my lantern with care, wrote one learned formula inside, and released it at midnight. All the other lanterns rose. Mine hung still in the air for a long moment, then descended slowly into the clouds below.
tradition:2.cnHint: 按照门派最古老的____，我放飞了写有心得的词灯，但它却缓缓沉入了云海。
tradition:2.hook: Every lantern climbed toward the stars — except mine, which sank like a slow stone.
tradition:2.line: 'This *tradition* has been kept for four hundred years — what a lantern does on its first night is never forgotten.'

africa:2.en: In the sect library I found an old world-map painted on silk, its edges soft with age. One distant land was labelled *Africa*, and beside the name someone had brushed a single word in our sect's oldest script. Xiaoxing leaned in close and read it aloud. The lamp above us went out, though there was no wind in the room.
africa:2.cnHint: 我在典籍中的古地图上看到了____这个地名，旁边有人用古文字注了一个词，师妹读出声后，灯熄灭了。
africa:2.hook: She had only spoken one word, but the room did not feel empty the way it had before.
africa:2.line: 'Someone carried a word all the way from *Africa* to this mountain — I wonder if it ever found a place to grow.'

teenager:2.en: The jade register lay open on Master Qingwu's desk, listing every soul admitted to the Cloud Sea Sect that season. My name sat at the very bottom. Beside it, in small careful strokes, were the words: 'a *teenager*, still unformed, yet the mountain chose her.' I traced those words with one finger. Outside, the wind shifted without warning.
teenager:2.cnHint: 师尊的玉册上记载着我的名字，旁边写着一句令人深思的评语，说我这个____尚未成熟，却被山峰选中。
teenager:2.hook: The ink beside my name was still warm.
teenager:2.line: 'A *teenager* who speaks the word for wind may yet learn to ride it,' said Master Qingwu.

patient:2.en: Shen Wujiu found me at the herb shelf, reading the same scroll for the third time. 'You must be *patient*,' he said, setting a small wrapped bundle beside my hand. Inside was a pressed cloud-lily, used to calm a restless mind. I bowed. When I looked up, a single white feather drifted past the window, moving against the wind.
patient:2.cnHint: 师兄发现我反复研读同一卷书，送来一株药草，提醒我要____，然而窗外出现了一个奇异的征兆。
patient:2.hook: The feather rose, not fell, into the sky.
patient:2.line: 'Be *patient* — the word for healing will open when you are ready,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

classroom:2.en: The east hall was called the First Word *classroom*, though it held no chairs — only twelve stone pillars, each carved with a single character. Xiaoxing whispered that disciples who spoke all twelve in one breath could lift a boulder. I stepped inside alone at dusk. The characters began, very slowly, to glow.
classroom:2.cnHint: 东厢的____里立着十二根石柱，据说能全部念出的弟子可以举起巨石，我独自入内时，石柱竟然发光了。
classroom:2.hook: Eleven glowed gold; the twelfth burned a deep and warning red.
classroom:2.line: 'This *classroom* holds words that have not been spoken aloud in forty years,' Xiaoxing murmured.

vehicle:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a long map of the floating peaks and pointed to a narrow cloud-bridge linking two distant mountains. 'Language,' she said, 'is the only *vehicle* that can carry you across.' She folded the map and pressed it into my hands before I could ask a single question. That night, the cloud-bridge on the map began to move.
vehicle:2.cnHint: 师尊展开山峦地图，告诉我语言是跨越两座浮山之间唯一的____，随后将地图交给了我。
vehicle:2.hook: The inked bridge shifted, as if something heavy had just crossed it.
vehicle:2.line: 'A word is a *vehicle* — choose it wrongly and you arrive somewhere you never intended,' said Master Qingwu.

remote:2.en: A sealed letter arrived by wind-crane, postmarked from the most *remote* peak in the sect's territory — a place so high that clouds formed below it, not above. The seal bore Shen Wujiu's mark, though he stood right beside me in the courtyard. He stared at the letter and said nothing. The crane circled once more before it vanished.
remote:2.cnHint: 一封来自最____山峰的信件由风鹤送达，信封上盖的却是就站在我身旁的师兄的印记。
remote:2.hook: He reached for the letter, then pulled his hand back.
remote:2.line: 'That *remote* peak has been sealed for a century — no one should be sending letters from there,' Shen Wujiu said.

zoo:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me a worn picture-book used to teach young children the names of animals. 'Before I came here,' she said, 'I thought a *zoo* was the strangest place a person could stand — so many creatures, each with its own sound.' She closed the book gently. Above us, something vast and unseen moved through the clouds, making no sound at all.
zoo:2.cnHint: 师妹给我看一本旧图册，讲起她幼时觉得____是世间最奇异的地方，此时云层中却有庞大的什么东西悄无声息地掠过。
zoo:2.hook: The clouds parted in a shape no known creature could make.
zoo:2.line: 'In a *zoo* every creature is named — here, the unnamed ones are the ones to fear,' Xiaoxing said quietly.

card:2.en: Tucked inside my new disciple robe was a small *card* no larger than my palm, printed with a single sentence in formal script: 'The word you speak first in fear will follow you always.' No name, no seal. Shen Wujiu said he had found the same card in his robe on his own first day, years ago. His face, as he said it, told me nothing.
card:2.cnHint: 我的新弟子袍中藏着一张小____，上面印着一句警示之语，师兄说他当年入门时也收到过同样的东西。
card:2.hook: The card was dated three days from now.
card:2.line: 'Keep the *card*,' Shen Wujiu said. 'Master Qingwu will ask to see it before the trial.'

gene:2.en: Master Qingwu held my wrist and read the faint lines of spiritual force the way a healer reads a pulse. 'Your *gene* for word-sensing is dormant,' she said, 'not absent.' She released my hand and turned to the window. Below the mountain, the sea of clouds rippled once, sharply, as if something beneath it had just woken and stretched.
gene:2.cnHint: 师尊把脉后说我感知词语的____处于沉眠状态而非缺失，话音未落，山下云海猛地涌动了一下。
gene:2.hook: The ripple spread outward in a perfect, unnatural circle.
gene:2.line: 'A dormant *gene* is a sealed gate — the right word is the key,' Master Qingwu said.

childhood:2.en: Among the sealed jars on the archive shelf, I found a small clay tablet carved with a child's unsteady hand. Master Qingwu stood beside me in silence. 'This belonged to your first teacher,' she said softly. The name etched below the drawing was my own — proof that my *childhood* had been spent inside these very walls, though I remembered none of it.
childhood:2.cnHint: 我在档案室发现了一块刻有自己名字的泥板，才知道____竟与云海宗有关。
childhood:2.hook: If I grew up here, why was every memory taken?
childhood:2.line: 'Your *childhood* was kept here, waiting for this day.'

equal:2.en: Shen Wujiu and I stood at opposite ends of the trial bridge, each holding a glowing formula shard. The bridge would only open if the spiritual energy on both sides was *equal*. I steadied my breath and pushed warmth through my palm until the two lights merged into one perfect ring of gold above the clouds.
equal:2.cnHint: 我与师兄必须让两端灵力____，石桥才会开启。
equal:2.hook: The ring of gold suddenly cracked straight down the middle.
equal:2.line: 'Only when both sides are *equal* will the path appear.'

inspire:2.en: Xiaoxing had been staring at her blank cultivation scroll for hours on the high pavilion when I placed beside her a single dried sky-herb, still faintly glowing. She looked up, eyes brightening. It seemed such a small thing, yet it was enough to *inspire* her — she lifted her brush and wrote three new formulas without stopping.
inspire:2.cnHint: 我放在师妹旁边的一株枯萎灵草，竟____了她，让她奋笔写出新法诀。
inspire:2.hook: The third formula she wrote was one no disciple had ever seen before.
inspire:2.line: 'Let this small herb *inspire* you when the path feels closed.'

narrow:2.en: The message arrived folded inside a cloud-crane: a map drawn on bark, showing a *narrow* passage between two peaks that did not appear on any sect chart. Shen Wujiu frowned as he traced its edges. The gap was barely wide enough for a single person walking sideways, yet the map marked it as the only road forward.
narrow:2.cnHint: 云鹤送来一张地图，标出了两峰之间一条____的秘密通道。
narrow:2.hook: Someone had drawn that passage in fresh ink, hours ago at most.
narrow:2.line: 'The *narrow* path on this map leads somewhere the sect has hidden.'

quantity:2.en: Master Qingwu set before me a row of identical jade vials, each containing a different spirit liquid. 'Healing power does not come from the *quantity* of liquid you use,' she said, tapping the smallest vial, 'but from the clarity of your intent.' I chose the smallest vial, poured three drops, and watched the wilted sky-flower stand upright again.
quantity:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，治愈之力不在于灵液的____，而在于心念的纯净。
quantity:2.hook: The revived flower released a faint scent that unlocked a sealed memory.
quantity:2.line: 'Reduce the *quantity*, and let your intent do the true work.'

sustainable:2.en: Deep in the archive cave I discovered an old record written by a founder of the sect. She had designed the cloud-root formation so its energy would be *sustainable* across a thousand seasons — drawing only what the sky willingly gave, never taking more. I copied every word, feeling that this principle was the real heart of our cultivation.
sustainable:2.cnHint: 我在洞窟档案中发现宗派创始人留下的记录，揭示了____的灵阵设计原理。
sustainable:2.hook: The last page of the record had been deliberately torn away.
sustainable:2.line: 'A *sustainable* path grows with the sky, not against it.'

delay:2.en: I found a sealed letter tucked beneath the root of the great summit cedar, addressed to me in Master Qingwu's hand. Inside, a single line read: 'Do not *delay* — the ascension gate opens only once each century, and it opens at the next sunrise.' The ink was dry but the wax seal was still warm, as if placed there moments ago.
delay:2.cnHint: 我在雪松树根下找到师尊的信，警告我不要____，因为飞升之门即将开启。
delay:2.hook: Sunrise was less than one hour away.
delay:2.line: 'Do not *delay*; the gate will not wait for second thoughts.'

identity:2.en: Hidden inside the hollow of a cloud-stone near the outer gate, I discovered a bronze token etched with a crest I did not recognise. Xiaoxing gasped when she saw it. 'That crest reveals the *identity* of whoever placed it here,' she whispered, tracing the lines with one careful finger. 'And that person should not exist — not anymore.'
identity:2.cnHint: 我在石洞中找到一枚铜牌，师妹说它揭示了留牌之人的____，而那人本不该存在。
identity:2.hook: The crest began to glow the moment I touched it.
identity:2.line: 'This token holds the *identity* of someone the sect erased from record.'

artificial:2.en: Deep inside the archive tower, I found a shelf lined with glowing stones. Each one held a stored memory — not a natural vision, but an *artificial* light shaped by human hands. Master Qingwu had warned us: borrowed light cannot show you the true path. I set the stones down and looked for a window.
artificial:2.cnHint: 我在档案塔里发现了一排人造光石，师尊曾警告过我们这种____的光。
artificial:2.hook: Behind the last stone, a real eye blinked back at me.
artificial:2.line: 'This *artificial* glow will fade before dawn,' Master Qingwu said softly.

confirm:2.en: A folded letter rested on the stone altar at the peak of White Mist Ridge. The seal bore Master Qingwu's mark, but I had to *confirm* it was genuine before I moved a single step further. Shen Wujiu stood at my shoulder, silent. The wax held three small characters I had never seen before.
confirm:2.cnHint: 我在白雾岭顶的石坛上发现一封信，需要____其真实性才敢继续前行。
confirm:2.hook: The three unknown characters began to glow a deep violet.
confirm:2.line: 'You must *confirm* the seal before you open it,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

context:2.en: The stone tablet on Hollow Peak was carved with a single formula, but without the surrounding verses it made no sense. Xiaoxing traced each character with one finger. 'A word without *context* is like a herb without soil,' she said. We searched the mossy ground and found the missing lines buried beneath our feet.
context:2.cnHint: 小星在空心峰发现一块残缺的石碑，缺少____的公式毫无意义。
context:2.hook: The buried lines described a door that should not exist here.
context:2.line: 'Without *context*, even the strongest formula is hollow,' Xiaoxing said carefully.

date:2.en: Inside the sealed jar we opened on the bridge of clouds, a thin scroll named every disciple who had ever attempted the ascent. Beside each name was a *date*. I found my own name at the very bottom, already written in someone else's hand. The ink was still wet.
date:2.cnHint: 我们在云桥上打开封罐，发现滚轴上已写下我的名字和____。
date:2.hook: No one alive could have written that name today.
date:2.line: 'The *date* beside your name,' Shen Wujiu whispered, 'is tomorrow.'

flexible:2.en: The silver chain that sealed the archive gate was unlike any metal I knew. It bent easily in my hands, soft and *flexible* as a living vine, yet it had held the gate closed for a hundred years. Master Qingwu said strength that yields does not break. I began to understand what she meant.
flexible:2.cnHint: 封印档案门的银链出奇地____，我开始明白师尊那句话的含义。
flexible:2.hook: When I let go, the chain coiled itself into a new shape.
flexible:2.line: 'A *flexible* will can hold what rigid iron cannot,' Master Qingwu said.

fly:2.en: At the edge of the outer terrace, a single *fly* circled the lantern three times and then rose straight up into the cloud layer above. No insect climbs that high. Xiaoxing grabbed my sleeve without a word. In the old lore of the sect, such a sign meant the boundary between earth and sky had thinned.
fly:2.cnHint: 一只____在外台边绕着灯笼飞了三圈后径直升入云层，小星紧紧抓住了我的袖子。
fly:2.hook: The lantern flame turned blue the moment it vanished.
fly:2.line: 'A *fly* that rises to the clouds carries no ordinary message,' Xiaoxing said.

judge:2.en: At the centre of the trial pavilion stood a low table with three sealed scrolls on it. I was told to *judge* which scroll held the true formula and which two held traps. Shen Wujiu watched from the doorway, arms folded. The scrolls smelled identical. I closed my eyes and listened instead.
judge:2.cnHint: 在试炼阁中，我需要____哪卷是真正的秘方，哪卷是陷阱。
judge:2.hook: One scroll, untouched, rolled slowly toward the edge.
judge:2.line: '*Judge* by what you feel, not only what you see,' Shen Wujiu said.

oil:2.en: The passage beneath the eastern root-pillar was dark until Xiaoxing uncovered a shallow dish of pale *oil* resting in a carved hollow. She lit it with one breath, and soft light filled the tunnel. The flame burned without smoke and without heat, casting shadows that moved against the direction of the wind.
oil:2.cnHint: 小星在东根柱下的通道里发现了一盏____灯，点燃后火焰的影子逆风而动。
oil:2.hook: The shadows spelled out a name none of us had spoken.
oil:2.line: 'This *oil* does not come from any plant I know,' Xiaoxing said slowly.

modern:2.en: Deep in the archive hall, I found a jade tablet unlike any other. Its surface held no ancient seal script, but clean, straight marks — a *modern* hand had carved them recently. Master Qingwu stood behind me, silent. Someone inside the sect had written a warning, and they had done so just yesterday.
modern:2.cnHint: 我在典籍阁发现一块刻有____字迹的玉简，那笔法绝非古人所留。
modern:2.hook: The dust around the tablet had not yet settled.
modern:2.line: 'This *modern* script does not belong to any elder I know,' said Master Qingwu.

officer:2.en: A stranger stood at the sect gate: tall, robed in grey, bearing a bronze seal at his belt. Shen Wujiu whispered that the man was a cloud-court *officer*, sent from the governing hall above the highest peak. His eyes swept the courtyard and rested, briefly but clearly, on me.
officer:2.cnHint: 一位云廷____来到门派，目光最终落在了我身上。
officer:2.hook: No officer visited the sect without a reason already decided.
officer:2.line: 'An *officer* from the cloud-court never travels alone,' Shen Wujiu murmured.

convince:2.en: The sealed scroll had been addressed to me, yet I almost set it aside unread. It was Xiaoxing who stopped my hand and began to read aloud, letting the words fill the room like smoke. By the final line, even I could not *convince* myself the warning was meant for someone else.
convince:2.cnHint: 小星大声朗读封印卷轴，我再也无法____自己那警告与我无关。
convince:2.hook: The scroll's ink was still faintly warm.
convince:2.line: 'Nothing will *convince* me this message reached you by accident,' said Xiaoxing.

directly:2.en: Most disciples sent word through a senior or left notes at the message stone. But this letter had come *directly* to my sleeping quarters, slipped beneath the door before dawn. No name was signed. On the paper, only three herbs were drawn — the formula for a path I had not yet been taught.
directly:2.cnHint: 一封信____送到我的住处，纸上画着我尚未学过的草药配方。
directly:2.hook: Whoever sent it knew exactly where I slept.
directly:2.line: 'It came *directly* to your door — that itself is the message,' said Shen Wujiu.

extend:2.en: The jade map on Master Qingwu's wall had always shown seven floating peaks. This morning a faint eighth peak had appeared at the map's eastern edge, as though the sect's territory had begun to *extend* into unmapped sky. No elder would explain it. The drawn peak pulsed once, then held still.
extend:2.cnHint: 宗门的玉石地图上出现了第八座山峰，似乎领域正向东____。
extend:2.hook: An eighth peak meant an eighth trial no text described.
extend:2.line: 'We do not know who gave the sect leave to *extend* its reach,' said Master Qingwu.

rat:2.en: A small brown *rat* sat motionless at the centre of the herb garden, holding a folded strip of paper in its teeth. It did not flee when I knelt beside it. Xiaoxing said that trained messenger rats had not been used in the sect for a hundred years. This one waited, patient as stone.
rat:2.cnHint: 一只____叼着纸条端坐在药圃中央，据说这种传信方式已绝迹百年。
rat:2.hook: The paper in its teeth bore the seal of a disbanded sect.
rat:2.line: 'A *rat* that does not run is carrying a message, not searching for food,' said Xiaoxing.

saturday:2.en: Every *Saturday* the sect held open study, and disciples were free to read any scroll in the outer hall. On this particular morning I pulled a thin volume from the lowest shelf and a loose page fell out — a hand-drawn chart of a constellation that should not have been visible from the cloud sea at all.
saturday:2.cnHint: 每逢____，我在外堂读书时，发现夹在书中的星图描绘着一个不该出现的星座。
saturday:2.hook: The constellation on the page had been circled three times.
saturday:2.line: 'Every *Saturday* someone has been here before you,' said Shen Wujiu softly.

april:2.en: A date was pressed into the wax seal of the letter: the fifteenth of *April*, three seasons from now. That was the day of the Cloud Ascension Trial, when one disciple each cycle was permitted to attempt the passage beyond the highest peak. I had not yet entered my name. Someone had entered it for me.
april:2.cnHint: 信封蜡印上刻着____十五日——飞升大试之日，而我从未报名。
april:2.hook: My name, in a stranger's hand, was already on the list.
april:2.line: 'The fifteenth of *April* is not a deadline — it is a summons,' said Master Qingwu.

comfortable:2.en: Inside the Archive Pavilion, I found an old scroll tucked beneath a *comfortable* cushion of woven cloud-moss. The scroll was warm, as if it had been resting there for a hundred years, waiting. Master Qingwu had told us that sleeping knowledge is the most dangerous kind.
comfortable:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁的厚垫下发现了一卷古老的典籍，它似乎已在此沉睡百年。
comfortable:2.hook: A single line of text at the bottom had been torn away.
comfortable:2.line: 'Nothing that feels *comfortable* should be trusted so easily,' said Master Qingwu.

conclusion:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread three jade tablets on the stone floor and studied their markings for a long time. His *conclusion* was quiet but firm: the path to the upper peaks had been deliberately sealed, not by weather, but by someone inside the sect. I felt the clouds beneath the mountain shift.
conclusion:2.cnHint: 师兄仔细研究了三块玉简后，得出了一个令人不安的____。
conclusion:2.hook: He looked at me and said nothing more.
conclusion:2.line: 'My *conclusion* is this: we were never meant to find these tablets,' said Shen Wujiu.

formal:2.en: A *formal* summons arrived at dawn, pressed into a square of white bark and sealed with Master Qingwu's silver mark. Xiaoxing held it at arm's length, as though it might bite. In the Cloud Sea Sect, a sealed summons meant one thing: a trial was about to begin.
formal:2.cnHint: 黎明时分，一份正式的____降临，小星小心翼翼地捧着它，不敢大意。
formal:2.hook: The seal cracked open by itself before she could break it.
formal:2.line: 'A *formal* summons never arrives without a reason,' said Xiaoxing softly.

happiness:2.en: Among the recovery herbs in the lower garden, I discovered a small stone carving half-buried in the soil. It showed a figure flying above the clouds, arms open, face turned upward. The carver had etched one word beneath it. *Happiness*, the stone read — but the face wore no smile.
happiness:2.cnHint: 我在药园里挖出一块石刻，上面雕着飞升的人像，却透着奇异的____。
happiness:2.hook: The word had been carved over something else, now worn away.
happiness:2.line: 'True *happiness* in this sect is rarer than a cloudless sky,' said Shen Wujiu.

intelligent:2.en: Xiaoxing was considered the most *intelligent* disciple of our intake, able to read a spirit-formula once and speak it back without error. So when she stood before the inscription on the Ascending Gate and went pale and silent, the rest of us stopped breathing. She had understood something we had not.
intelligent:2.cnHint: 小星向来是最____的弟子，但她在飞升门前突然沉默，令众人心生不安。
intelligent:2.hook: She folded the rubbing she had made and hid it in her sleeve.
intelligent:2.line: 'Even the most *intelligent* mind may not be ready for what is written there,' said Master Qingwu.

novel:2.en: The method Shen Wujiu proposed was *novel* — no elder had ever tried to read a gate-inscription by pressing cloud-silk against the stone and letting dew form the letters. Xiaoxing said it was reckless. I thought it was the most alive idea I had heard since entering the sect.
novel:2.cnHint: 师兄提出了一个____的解读方法，让弟子们既惊讶又好奇。
novel:2.hook: The dew formed a character none of us had ever seen before.
novel:2.line: 'It is a *novel* approach, yes — but novel things carry novel risks,' said Master Qingwu.

political:2.en: The letter found inside the hollow pillar bore no name, only a list of sect positions and marks beside each one. Shen Wujiu said the arrangement looked *political* — as if someone had been mapping who held power and who did not. Up here above the clouds, I had thought power meant cultivation alone.
political:2.cnHint: 石柱中藏着一封涉及____权力布局的密信，令师兄神色凝重。
political:2.hook: The last mark on the list pointed to Master Qingwu's name.
political:2.line: 'This is not spiritual business — this is *political*, and that makes it more dangerous,' said Shen Wujiu.

property:2.en: Tucked inside the gate arch, wrapped in dry leaves, was a small bronze key. Xiaoxing checked the sect register and found it listed under *property* of a disciple who had vanished during an ascension rite three seasons ago. No one had reported the key missing. No one had reported much of anything.
property:2.cnHint: 小星在典籍中查到，那把铜钥匙是一位失踪弟子的____。
property:2.hook: The key was warm, as if someone had just set it down.
property:2.line: 'Personal *property* does not hide itself inside a gate arch,' said Xiaoxing.

passion:2.en: Inside the Hall of Records, I found a scroll left by a former disciple. Every line burned with *passion* for herb-lore, each character pressed so deep the bamboo had cracked. Master Qingwu stood behind me, silent. The candle between us flickered once, then split into two flames.
passion:2.cnHint: 我在藏经阁发现了一卷前辈手稿，字里行间充满了对草药之道的____。
passion:2.hook: Two flames where one had burned — what did it mean?
passion:2.line: 'Only *passion* this fierce could crack the bamboo itself,' Master Qingwu said.

temperature:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a pale-blue herb jar and told me to feel its surface. The *temperature* dropped sharply against my palm — colder than the mountain wind, colder than the clouds below. He watched my expression and said nothing. Outside, the sky turned an unusual shade of green.
temperature:2.cnHint: 师兄让我触摸一只药罐，感受它异常的____，天色随即变得诡异。
temperature:2.hook: The green sky deepened, and the jar grew colder still.
temperature:2.line: 'If the *temperature* falls again, set the jar down and step back,' Shen Wujiu said.

board:2.en: At the east cliff edge hung a narrow wooden *board*, painted with the names of disciples who had ascended. I climbed the ladder to read the topmost name — one stroke was still wet. Xiaoxing called up to me, her voice careful and low. The wet ink smelled of storm clouds.
board:2.cnHint: 悬崖边的木____上，最新刻下的名字墨迹未干，小星在下方轻声呼唤我。
board:2.hook: Fresh ink on a name no one admitted writing — whose hand did this?
board:2.line: 'The *board* never lies about who has ascended,' Xiaoxing said softly.

handle:2.en: Among the tools left in the preparation room I found a small knife I did not recognise. I reached out to *handle* it, and the moment my fingers closed around the grip, a faint map appeared on the blade — paths I had never seen in any sect chart. Then it vanished.
handle:2.cnHint: 我在炼药室触碰一把陌生小刀，刚____它，刀身上便浮现出一幅神秘地图。
handle:2.hook: The map was gone, but my fingers still tingled with its shape.
handle:2.line: 'Do not *handle* what the previous disciple left behind,' Master Qingwu warned quietly.

ideal:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me the garden terrace where light and mist arrived together each dawn. She said it was the *ideal* place to plant the rarest sky-herbs, that the balance of cloud and sun here was found nowhere else on the mountain. A single seed rested in her open palm, glowing faintly.
ideal:2.cnHint: 小星带我来到她认为____的草药种植台，她掌心有一粒微微发光的种子。
ideal:2.hook: The seed's glow pulsed once — as if it were listening.
ideal:2.line: 'This terrace is *ideal*; the clouds here carry memory,' Xiaoxing said.

ride:2.en: A cloud-raft drifted to the stone dock, empty and waiting. Master Qingwu said that to take a *ride* on it without permission was forbidden — yet it had come on its own, nudging the dock post three times. Shen Wujiu and I looked at each other. No wind had moved it.
ride:2.cnHint: 一艘无人云筏自行靠岸，主动邀人____，师兄与我面面相觑。
ride:2.hook: Three gentle knocks, no wind — someone, or something, was steering.
ride:2.line: 'A *ride* offered by an empty raft is a message, not an invitation,' Master Qingwu said.

adjust:2.en: The spirit-compass on the observation deck had shifted overnight; its needle pointed inward, toward the mountain core, instead of upward. Shen Wujiu bent over it to *adjust* the setting ring, but the needle returned on its own before he touched it. A low hum rose from the stone floor beneath us.
adjust:2.cnHint: 师兄试图____灵罗盘的指针，但它自行归位，石板下传来低鸣。
adjust:2.hook: The hum grew, and the needle began spinning without pause.
adjust:2.line: 'I cannot *adjust* it — the compass is answering something below us,' Shen Wujiu said.

basis:2.en: In the archive room I found a thin volume titled 'Principles of Ascent.' Its first page stated that the *basis* of all flight was not strength but clarity of intent — one true purpose could lift a disciple higher than a hundred fierce techniques. The page beneath it was blank, and waiting.
basis:2.cnHint: 古籍中写道，飞升的____不是力量而是意念的纯粹，下一页却是空白。
basis:2.hook: A blank page in an ancient book — or a page not yet written?
basis:2.line: 'Clarity of intent is the *basis*; everything else is decoration,' the old text read.

relative:2.en: Deep in the Archive Grotto, I found a jade tablet carved with two flight paths. Master Qingwu had taught that altitude and spirit-wind were *relative* — what felt like rising might only be the mountain sinking. Studying the tablet, I began to understand why some disciples flew high yet never truly ascended.
relative:2.cnHint: 在藏经洞中，我发现一块玉简，让我明白高度与灵风是____的。
relative:2.hook: One path on the tablet led somewhere the maps refused to show.
relative:2.line: 'Speed and stillness are *relative*, young one — the clouds judge neither.'

rent:2.en: At the base of Floating Peak Three, a notice board listed spiritual plots for *rent*: each disciple could borrow a patch of cloud-soil to grow word-herbs for one season. Shen Wujiu pointed to the smallest plot. 'Start there,' he said quietly. 'Even a narrow field teaches the whole sky.'
rent:2.cnHint: 峰下告示板上列着灵地的____价格，师兄建议我从最小的一块开始。
rent:2.hook: Someone had already torn the last notice from the board.
rent:2.line: 'The *rent* for this plot is three bottles of morning dew — no less.'

round:2.en: Master Qingwu described ascension as a *round* — a full cycle from earth-root to cloud-tip and back, repeated until the spirit no longer needed the ground. I stood at the rim of the outer platform and watched the mist turn slowly below me, tracing the shape of something vast and patient.
round:2.cnHint: 师尊说飞升是一个____，从根到云顶，如此往复，直到灵识不再需要大地。
round:2.hook: The mist below had begun turning in the opposite direction.
round:2.line: 'Each *round* you complete rewrites the formula in your bones.'

structure:2.en: Xiaoxing spread an unrolled scroll across the stone table. It showed the *structure* of the Ascension Gate: three rings of spirit-script, each dependent on the next, like the bones of a great bird holding the feathers in place. Without understanding each layer, flight would collapse before it began.
structure:2.cnHint: 小星展开一幅卷轴，图示了飞升门的____，三重灵纹环环相扣。
structure:2.hook: The innermost ring on the scroll had been carefully erased.
structure:2.line: 'Study the *structure* first — a broken gate cannot be forced open.'

typical:2.en: This was not a *typical* discovery. Most disciples found their ascension herb in the communal garden, plain and well-documented. Mine had grown on the underside of a cloud-shelf, unseen, feeding on starlight rather than soil. Shen Wujiu crouched beside it, his face unreadable, and said nothing for a long time.
typical:2.cnHint: 这不是一次____的发现——我的飞升灵草长在云架下方，以星光为食。
typical:2.hook: The herb was still growing, even after I had picked it.
typical:2.line: 'This is not the *typical* path — and that is why it matters.'

vacation:2.en: There is no true *vacation* for a disciple of the Cloud Sea Sect — even rest days carry a quiet duty. On a still morning between lessons, I climbed to the Echo Ledge and found a locked iron box wedged beneath a prayer stone. It had not been placed there by accident.
vacation:2.cnHint: 宗门弟子没有真正的____，在一个清晨，我在回音崖发现了一只上锁的铁盒。
vacation:2.hook: The box was warm, as though something inside was still breathing.
vacation:2.line: '*Vacation* is a word for those who have not yet heard the sky calling.'

acquire:2.en: To *acquire* the seventh-rank wind-script, a disciple must first leave something behind at the Summit Offering Stone — a memory, a habit, or a name once used. I pressed my palm to the cold rock and felt a pull, as if the mountain itself were reading what I could spare. Xiaoxing watched from a distance, silent.
acquire:2.cnHint: 要____第七阶风纹，弟子必须先在山顶献石处舍弃某样东西。
acquire:2.hook: The stone took something I had not chosen to give.
acquire:2.line: 'You can only *acquire* what the wind believes you are ready to carry.'

adequate:2.en: The spirit-lamp in my chamber cast *adequate* light for reading, but no more. By its pale glow I traced the final diagram of the Ascension Scroll, aware that adequate was not the same as enough. Outside, the wind changed pitch, and somewhere on a higher platform, a bell rang once and did not echo.
adequate:2.cnHint: 我房间的灵灯光线____，勉强够读书，但在灯下我意识到够用并不等于充分。
adequate:2.hook: The bell that rang once should, by all known law, have rung three times.
adequate:2.line: '*Adequate* preparation and true readiness are not the same offering.'

attribute:2.en: Deep in the Archive Grotto, I found a jade slip no disciple had touched in years. Master Qingwu had taught us to *attribute* unusual warmth in a relic to stored spiritual intention — and this slip burned against my palm like a living coal.
attribute:2.cnHint: 我在档案洞窟发现一块无人触碰多年的玉简，它在我掌心散发出异常的热度。
attribute:2.hook: The slip's glow matched the color of the forbidden upper peak.
attribute:2.line: 'You must *attribute* this heat to the will of whoever sealed it,' said Master Qingwu.

badly:2.en: The old rope bridge to the Outer Herb Terrace had frayed *badly* overnight; three planks had fallen into the clouds below. Shen Wujiu knelt and pressed his ear to the remaining wood, listening for the hum a cut rope makes when someone has tampered with it.
badly:2.cnHint: 通往外草台的绳桥一夜之间严重破损，师兄仔细检查是否有人动了手脚。
badly:2.hook: A single unbroken thread held the weight of everything.
badly:2.line: 'This bridge was damaged *badly* — no wind alone could do this,' said Shen Wujiu.

bridge:2.en: From the Outer Herb Terrace I could see the whole sect: roof after roof stepping up the mountain, joined by a single stone *bridge* that floated free of the cliff on both sides, anchored by nothing visible. Xiaoxing whispered that the bridge was the sect's oldest word-formula, given physical form.
bridge:2.cnHint: 小星告诉我，那座悬空的石桥其实是门派最古老的法诀所化。
bridge:2.hook: Then the bridge shivered, as if the word inside it had stirred.
bridge:2.line: 'Every stone of that *bridge* is a syllable no one alive can pronounce,' said Xiaoxing.

casual:2.en: A folded note lay on my cultivation mat — *casual* in appearance, the paper plain and the knot loose, as though someone had left a reminder about morning drills. But the characters inside described a passage in the sealed east wing that only an inner disciple could know.
casual:2.cnHint: 我的蒲团上有一张看似随意的纸条，内容却涉及只有内门弟子才知晓的密道。
casual:2.hook: No one in my hall held inner-disciple rank.
casual:2.line: Shen Wujiu frowned: 'A note this *casual* is meant to make you lower your guard.'

closely:2.en: Master Qingwu told me to study the new formula *closely* before the first light of dawn dissolved the dew, because moisture in the air made the characters briefly visible to a careful eye. I bent over the stone tablet and saw, inside the strokes, a smaller set of words I had never been taught.
closely:2.cnHint: 师尊让我在晨露消散前仔细研读新法诀，我却在字迹中发现了一组从未被传授的文字。
closely:2.hook: Those inner words were not part of any lesson I knew.
closely:2.line: 'Look *closely* — what the dew reveals, daylight will hide,' said Master Qingwu.

commit:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin iron token and said that accepting it meant I must *commit* to carrying a sealed message to the Cloud Mirror Peak before the next bell, speaking to no one on the path. The token was cold in a way that had nothing to do with the mountain air.
commit:2.cnHint: 师兄交给我一枚铁牌，接受它意味着我必须承诺在下一声钟响前独自送信上云镜峰。
commit:2.hook: Something on that peak had been waiting a long time.
commit:2.line: 'Take it only if you *commit* fully — the path will test you,' said Shen Wujiu.

concentrate:2.en: The meditation hall was silent except for the slow drip of a water-clock. Master Qingwu had asked us all to *concentrate* our breath at the chest's center and hold the seed-word there until it grew warm. Halfway through, the water-clock stopped, and the silence became something heavier than quiet.
concentrate:2.cnHint: 师尊让我们在静室中将气息凝聚于胸口，修炼途中计时的水漏却突然停了。
concentrate:2.hook: Stillness that deep usually meant the mountain was listening.
concentrate:2.line: '*Concentrate* on the seed-word — let nothing else exist,' said Master Qingwu.

conscious:2.en: I woke on the cold floor of the formula vault, *conscious* of two things at once: the sealed door behind me stood open, and the bronze lamp above burned a colour it had never shown before — a pale green that herb-lore texts link to spiritual overflow. I had not opened that door.
conscious:2.cnHint: 我在法诀库的地板上醒来，意识到身后那扇封印的门竟然开着，铜灯也燃出了异常的颜色。
conscious:2.hook: The vault's air tasted of a formula I had not yet learned.
conscious:2.line: Xiaoxing whispered: 'Are you *conscious* of what that green flame means?'

conventional:2.en: The sealed jar arrived at my door before dawn, wrapped in cloud-silk. Inside lay a single dried leaf — not the *conventional* herb any healer would recognise, but something older, its veins glowing faint gold. A note in Shen Wujiu's hand read: 'Do not open until the bell rings.' Outside, no bell existed on this mountain.
conventional:2.cnHint: 一个装有陌生草药的密封罐子出现在我门口，它不是____的那种药草，附带的字条让我等钟声响起。
conventional:2.hook: There was no bell on this mountain — until tonight.
conventional:2.line: 'This is nothing *conventional*, so do not treat it as one.'

disappear:2.en: I found the bronze compass in the archive room, half-buried under dusty scrolls. The moment I lifted it, the needle spun wildly, then pointed straight down — toward the sea of clouds far below. Xiaoxing had warned me that certain instruments *disappear* from this room on their own, always before something shifts in the sect.
disappear:2.cnHint: 我在档案室发现一只罗盘，小星曾警告我某些器具会自行____，而这只罗盘的指针正对准云海。
disappear:2.hook: By morning, the compass was gone from my locked room.
disappear:2.line: 'Things that matter tend to *disappear* right when you need them most.'

district:2.en: The old map unrolled across the stone table showed the sky divided into named zones. Master Qingwu pressed one finger to the easternmost *district*, a pale region marked only with the word 'Silence.' No sect had built there. No disciple had returned from it. The ink in that corner was newer than the rest.
district:2.cnHint: 师尊在古地图上指出最东边的一个____，那里没有门派，从未有弟子回来过。
district:2.hook: Someone had redrawn that eastern border very recently.
district:2.line: 'Every *district* on this map was named in blood, not ink.'

greatly:2.en: I copied the healing formula three times before it finally held its shape in the air — pale green characters hovering above my palm. Shen Wujiu watched without speaking, then nodded once. 'Your control has *greatly* improved since last month,' he said quietly. Behind him, the wind changed direction without cause.
greatly:2.cnHint: 我终于让治愈咒语成形悬浮，师兄说我的掌控力比上个月____提高了。
greatly:2.hook: The wind never changed direction on this plateau — never, until now.
greatly:2.line: 'You have *greatly* surprised me, and that does not happen often.'

imitate:2.en: The scroll instructed me to *imitate* the shape of still water — not the word for water, but the silence between its sounds. I sat for two hours before a single character rose from the page and settled onto my wrist like a seal. Xiaoxing slid a note under my door: 'Whatever you just did, stop. Something below the clouds heard it.'
imitate:2.cnHint: 卷轴要我____静水的形态，我终于让一个字符浮现，但小星的纸条提醒我停下来。
imitate:2.hook: Something beneath the clouds had heard the word I had not spoken aloud.
imitate:2.line: 'Do not *imitate* a formula you do not yet understand — not here.'

implement:2.en: Shen Wujiu laid five tools on the table: a brush, a stone bowl, a copper ring, a thin blade of cloud-glass, and something with no name I recognised. 'Each *implement* carries a different word,' he said. 'You may keep one.' I reached for the nameless one. It was warm, as if already awake.
implement:2.cnHint: 师兄摆出五件____，说每件都承载着一个字，让我选一件，我选了那件没有名字的。
implement:2.hook: The nameless tool pulsed once in my hand, then went perfectly still.
implement:2.line: 'Every *implement* here has chosen someone before — think before you reach.'

mood:2.en: The ink I used that morning changed colour with my *mood* — a property Xiaoxing had mentioned once, lightly, as though it were ordinary. When I felt calm, the characters rose silver. When doubt crept in, they turned the deep grey of storm-cloud. I wrote the word for 'ascend.' It came out black. I had never written it black before.
mood:2.cnHint: 我的墨水会随____变色——平静时字是银色，怀疑时变灰，今晨写"飞升"二字，墨迹却是黑色。
mood:2.hook: I had never written that word in black — not once, until today.
mood:2.line: 'Your *mood* is part of the formula — the sect taught you that on your first day.'

motivation:2.en: A letter arrived, folded inside a crane made of cloud-paper. It bore no sender's name, only three lines: 'We know your *motivation* for joining this sect. It is not what you told Master Qingwu. Come to the eastern arch before the third bell.' I burned it. The ash spelled out the same words again.
motivation:2.cnHint: 一封没有署名的信说知道我加入门派的真实____，约我在第三声钟响前去东拱门，我烧了信，灰烬又拼出了同样的字。
motivation:2.hook: The ash held its shape long after any fire should have scattered it.
motivation:2.line: '*Motivation* can be hidden from a master, but never from the mountain itself.'

obvious:2.en: A sealed jar sat on my desk when I woke — left by no hand I had seen. Inside, a single leaf glowed with three written characters. Their meaning was *obvious*: fly before the next bell, or the path closes. I read them twice, then held the jar to the morning light, wondering who had placed it there.
obvious:2.cnHint: 清晨，我发现桌上有一只封口的罐子，里面的文字____地指示我必须在下一声钟响前飞行。
obvious:2.hook: A fourth character began to form on the leaf, unbidden.
obvious:2.line: 'The message is *obvious* — do not wait for a second warning.'

ordinary:2.en: The scroll Shen Wujiu slid under my door looked *ordinary* — rough paper, no seal, ink slightly smeared. But when I unrolled it in the half-dark, the words rearranged themselves into a map of a passage I had never seen marked on any sect wall. I folded it quickly and hid it inside my robe.
ordinary:2.cnHint: 师兄塞来的卷轴看起来____，却在我展开时自行变成了一幅从未见过的通道地图。
ordinary:2.hook: Outside, footsteps paused just beyond my door.
ordinary:2.line: 'It looks *ordinary*, but nothing Shen Wujiu sends ever is.'

pace:2.en: I found the bronze compass on the peak's highest step, spinning on its own. It would *pace* itself to my breathing — fast when I was afraid, slow when I was still. Master Qingwu had written one line on the back: master your breath, master your flight. I closed my eyes and let my lungs find their calm.
pace:2.cnHint: 我在山顶台阶上找到一枚铜罗盘，它会随我的呼吸____，师尊在背面留有一行字。
pace:2.hook: The compass needle snapped to the north and held.
pace:2.line: 'Let your breath *pace* the compass, not the other way around.'

participate:2.en: A wooden board hung near the archive gate, listing a cloud-crossing trial at dawn. Any disciple could *participate*, but only those carrying a written word-herb of their own making would be allowed past the first gate. I had one pressed between two stones in my room. I wrote my name on the board in steady strokes.
participate:2.cnHint: 布告板上写着一场黎明云渡试炼，持有自制字草的弟子皆可____，我已备好了。
participate:2.hook: By midnight, six other names had appeared on the board — written in silver ink.
participate:2.line: 'You may *participate* only if the word-herb is yours alone.'

pilot:2.en: The message was a single strip of cloth tied to a stone falcon perched on my window ledge. It read: a true *pilot* reads the wind before trusting the word. Below those words, someone had drawn a small arrow pointing toward the outer cliff. The falcon blinked once, then was still.
pilot:2.cnHint: 石隼腿上绑着一条布条，上面写着真正的____要先读懂风，再信任文字，箭头指向外崖。
pilot:2.hook: When I looked again, the stone falcon had shifted half a step to the left.
pilot:2.line: 'A *pilot* who ignores the wind will fall before the first cloud.'

primary:2.en: Xiaoxing handed me a thin booklet at the archive steps, her finger marking one page. The *primary* lesson, she said, was not flight or battle but stillness — a disciple who could not be still could not hold a word long enough for it to work. I read the page three times before I understood she was right.
primary:2.cnHint: 师妹在档案台阶上递给我一本小册子，告诉我其中____的课程不是飞行而是静止。
primary:2.hook: The booklet grew warm in my hands as the mountain bell rang.
primary:2.line: 'Stillness is the *primary* lesson — everything else follows from it.'

priority:2.en: A note in Master Qingwu's handwriting was pinned to the inner door of the word-herb chamber. It named one thing as the clear *priority* above all study: return any borrowed word to its shelf before the cloud tide comes in, or the word would fade and be lost for a generation. I checked the shelf at once and found one word still in my pocket.
priority:2.cnHint: 师尊手书的字条钉在字草室的内门上，指明归还借用字草是云潮前最重要的____。
priority:2.hook: The cloud tide bell rang thirty minutes early.
priority:2.line: 'Returning the word on time is your one *priority* tonight.'

throughout:2.en: The discovery was not a sudden flash but a slow glow that spread *throughout* the old record stone near the east path — every carved character lighting up in pale blue, one after another, until the whole surface shone. Shen Wujiu knelt beside it and whispered that the stone had not lit in over a hundred years. We did not touch it.
throughout:2.cnHint: 东路旁的古记录石上，所有字符____整块石面缓缓发出蓝光，师兄说这一百多年来从未亮过。
throughout:2.hook: The final character at the stone's edge pulsed once, then went dark.
throughout:2.line: 'The light spread *throughout* every character — all at once, like a held breath released.'

dinner:2.en: The great hall of the Cloud Sea Sect glowed with lantern light. Master Qingwu had called every disciple to a *dinner* where rare spirit-words were served like dishes — each one swallowed in silence, each one lighting a small flame inside the chest. I held mine on my tongue and felt the mountain hum beneath my feet.
dinner:2.cnHint: 师尊在宴会厅召集所有弟子，将珍稀灵字如菜肴般____，每个人默默领悟。
dinner:2.hook: But one seat at the long table sat empty, and no one dared ask whose it was.
dinner:2.line: 'This *dinner* is not for your stomachs,' said Master Qingwu, 'it is for your souls.'

embrace:2.en: The old archive room sat at the mountain's heart, its stone walls damp with cloud-mist. I found a scroll so worn its edges had turned soft as silk. To *embrace* its teaching, the text said, was to let the word breathe inside you rather than force it into shape. I unrolled it slowly, and the room grew warmer.
embrace:2.cnHint: 在山心档案室，我找到一卷古老的卷轴，上面说要____其中的教义，让灵字在心中自然呼吸。
embrace:2.hook: The last line of the scroll had been torn away, and the torn edge still smelled of smoke.
embrace:2.line: 'You cannot copy a word,' Shen Wujiu said. '*Embrace* it, or it will leave you.'

explanation:2.en: A sealed letter had appeared on my sleeping mat — no name, no seal, only three spirit-words drawn in fading ink. I brought it to Shen Wujiu, who studied it without speaking for a long while. His *explanation* was short: these words were a map, not a message, and the place they pointed to had been forbidden for thirty years.
explanation:2.cnHint: 我在卧垫上发现一封密封的信，带去给师兄，他的____很简短：那三个灵字是一张地图。
explanation:2.hook: He folded the letter back and handed it to me, and his hand was trembling slightly.
explanation:2.line: 'My *explanation* may frighten you,' Shen Wujiu said, 'but you deserve the truth.'

intend:2.en: Near the eastern ridge I found a stone basin filled with still water that reflected no sky — only a single word, hovering just below the surface. I reached in. The word dissolved at my touch. I did not *intend* to absorb it, but it rose through my fingers and settled behind my eyes like a coal still holding heat.
intend:2.cnHint: 在东侧山脊，我无意间触碰了水中的灵字，并非____吸收它，但它自行融入了我的体内。
intend:2.hook: That night I dreamed in a language I had never been taught.
intend:2.line: 'I did not *intend* to take it,' I told Master Qingwu, and she looked at me without surprise.

leadership:2.en: The notice board outside the Hall of Words carried a new list. At the top, under the heading of *leadership* for the coming season's trial, was a name I did not expect: Xiaoxing. She stood nearby, reading the same board, her face still and unreadable as a winter lake.
leadership:2.cnHint: 布告栏上公布了即将到来的试炼____名单，榜首的名字出乎所有人意料。
leadership:2.hook: Someone had drawn a faint circle around her name in red, and it had not been there an hour ago.
leadership:2.line: '*Leadership* is a word that weighs more than it looks,' Master Qingwu said softly.

locate:2.en: Master Qingwu gave me a single task before dawn: *locate* the source of the strange tone that had been humming through the mountain's lower roots for three days. I pressed my palm to the stone floor of the passage and followed the vibration deeper, past the training halls, past the well, to a door I had never seen before.
locate:2.cnHint: 师尊命我在天亮前____山体下方持续震鸣三天的声音源头，我顺着震动一路深入。
locate:2.hook: The door had no handle, only a word carved above it that I could not yet read.
locate:2.line: 'Can you *locate* it?' Master Qingwu asked, and I was not sure she meant the sound.

original:2.en: In the library's deepest shelf I found two copies of the same healing word — one polished and bright, clearly redrawn many times, the other faded but unmistakably the *original*, its brushstrokes uneven and alive. When I held them side by side, the copy felt hollow. I put the bright one down and kept the old one close.
original:2.cnHint: 在书库最深处，我发现同一个疗愈灵字的两个版本，____那份笔触生动却褪色，仿制版却毫无生气。
original:2.hook: A note tucked behind both copies read only: 'Do not let them meet.'
original:2.line: 'The *original* always carries something the copy cannot hold,' Xiaoxing said quietly.

overcome:2.en: The test at the Mist Gate required every disciple to face a word that resisted them — one that the spirit refused to accept. Mine was a word for stillness, and it pushed back like a cold current. I breathed slowly until the resistance softened. To *overcome* it, I had learned, was not to fight but to wait with complete patience.
overcome:2.cnHint: 迷雾之门的考验要求弟子面对令自己抗拒的灵字，我用耐心而非对抗____了它。
overcome:2.hook: As I stepped through the gate, I heard the word behind me seal itself shut with a sound like a held breath released.
overcome:2.line: 'To *overcome* a word,' Master Qingwu said, 'you must first stop fearing it.'

partly:2.en: The old scroll had been *partly* eaten by time, its edges dark with age. I found it wedged beneath a cracked stone in the library cave, where frost gathered even in summer. The surviving words glowed faintly, like embers refusing to die. Shen Wujiu knelt beside me and whispered, 'This is enough. This is more than enough.'
partly:2.cnHint: 古卷轴____残存，弟子在藏经洞发现了它，上面的文字仍在微微发光。
partly:2.hook: But the missing half bore the name of a sect that no longer existed.
partly:2.line: 'The seal is *partly* broken — do not touch the center glyph.'

practical:2.en: Master Qingwu set three jars of common herbs before me and said nothing. No lecture, no poem — only a look that meant: begin. This was her most *practical* lesson, the kind that leaves no room for dreaming. I crushed the first leaf, and the cave filled with silver light I had not been told to expect.
practical:2.cnHint: 师尊给了弟子一堂最____的课——直接动手配药，没有任何解释。
practical:2.hook: The silver light formed a single character, then vanished into the stone floor.
practical:2.line: 'Forget the theory for now — this lesson is *practical*, and the mountain will not wait.'

profit:2.en: Xiaoxing spread the cloud-market ledger open on the flat rock and traced a column with her finger. 'Every sect that hoards the word-herbs takes *profit* from those who fall ill below,' she said quietly. I had not thought of healing as a trade before. The clouds beneath our mountain turned a dull, bruised yellow.
profit:2.cnHint: 晓星翻看云市账簿，指出有人从药草中牟取____，令弟子陷入沉思。
profit:2.hook: That yellow had a name, and Master Qingwu had forbidden us to speak it aloud.
profit:2.line: 'There is no true *profit* in a word sold to someone too weak to carry it.'

promise:2.en: On the eastern pillar of the Gate of Ascension, every new disciple carves one word as a *promise* to the sect. Most choose strength or clarity. I chose the character for listening. Shen Wujiu raised an eyebrow but said nothing. That night a cold wind rose from the sea of clouds, carrying a sound like distant bells.
promise:2.cnHint: 每位新弟子在飞升门石柱上刻字为____，弟子刻下了"聆听"二字。
promise:2.hook: The bells had not rung since the last disciple who chose that same word disappeared.
promise:2.line: 'A *promise* carved in stone still breaks if the one who carved it turns away.'

rarely:2.en: Master Qingwu *rarely* descended to the lower courtyard, so when I saw her white robe moving between the herb-stones at dawn, I pressed myself against the wall and held my breath. She stopped at the one plant that had refused to bloom all season, touched a single leaf, and walked away. By midday the plant bore seven silver flowers.
rarely:2.cnHint: 师尊____踏足下院，今日破例而来，只轻触一片叶子便离去了。
rarely:2.hook: On each flower, a different word was written in lines of frost.
rarely:2.line: 'I *rarely* come here twice — take this as the only warning you will receive.'

severe:2.en: The frost-trial was known to be *severe*, but no one had described the silence inside it. For three hours I knelt on a disk of ice above the cloudline, holding a single word-formula in my mind without letting it dissolve. When I stepped off, Shen Wujiu handed me a cup of warm water without speaking. His hands were trembling slightly.
severe:2.cnHint: 霜考以____著称，弟子在冰盘上独自撑过三个时辰，师兄双手微微颤抖着相迎。
severe:2.hook: The formula I had held so carefully had changed one stroke while I was not looking.
severe:2.line: 'The trial is *severe* because the mountain above it is more severe still.'

smell:2.en: Before I could see the hidden archive, I found it by its *smell* — ink older than the sect, cedar wood, and something sharp like lightning caught in cloth. The door was no door, only a gap in the carved cliff face. Inside, one candle burned on a desk where someone had been reading very recently. The chair was still warm.
smell:2.cnHint: 弟子靠着一股独特的____找到了秘藏室，里面有人刚刚离去，椅子尚有余温。
smell:2.hook: The open book on the desk showed a map of a mountain that did not appear on any chart I knew.
smell:2.line: 'That *smell* means the oldest words are close — and close means they can still hear you.'

socialize:2.en: Xiaoxing told me the upper disciples did not *socialize* with those of us still learning the first-tier formulas. 'It is not pride,' she said, stirring her bowl. 'It is that words move between people like wind between trees — they are careful.' That evening I passed the upper hall and heard, through the paper window, a sound like a hundred voices speaking one syllable together.
socialize:2.cnHint: 晓星说上阶弟子不与新人____，并非傲慢，而是因为言语会在人间流动传递。
socialize:2.hook: The syllable was one I had read only once, in a text Shen Wujiu had told me to forget.
socialize:2.line: 'We do not *socialize* carelessly here — every shared word plants a root in the listener.'

worldwide:2.en: Inside the archive tower, I found a scroll sealed with cloud-silk. It listed the names of disciples from every corner of the sky — a record of those who had carried the Sect's words *worldwide*, planting healing formulas on distant peaks no map could name. My own name was not there. Not yet.
worldwide:2.cnHint: 我在档案塔里发现一卷记录着门派弟子遍布____的名册，但上面还没有我的名字。
worldwide:2.hook: At the scroll's edge, one name had been burned away.
worldwide:2.line: 'These words have traveled *worldwide*, and still the clouds keep their secrets.'

accomplish:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a plain stone tablet etched with a single formula. 'One week,' he said quietly. 'That is all Master Qingwu asks.' I held the tablet and felt its weight — not heavy in my hands, but heavy in meaning. To *accomplish* even this small task, I would need to understand what the words truly wanted.
accomplish:2.cnHint: 师兄交给我一块石碑，要我在一周内____一个看似简单的任务。
accomplish:2.hook: The formula on the tablet shifted, rearranging itself while I watched.
accomplish:2.line: 'To *accomplish* this, you must listen before you speak the word.'

address:2.en: A sealed letter arrived at my door before dawn, bearing no sender's name — only a mountain glyph I did not recognize. Inside, a single line of old script served as both a greeting and a warning. I brought it to Xiaoxing, who read it twice and went pale. She said Master Qingwu would need to *address* this matter before the next rising cloud.
address:2.cnHint: 我收到一封神秘来信，小星认为师尊必须亲自____这件事。
address:2.hook: The mountain glyph on the envelope began to glow faint gold.
address:2.line: 'Master Qingwu must *address* this letter — I am not ready to understand it.'

barely:2.en: Xiaoxing found an old medicine jar buried beneath the floor of the herb room, its seal cracked but still holding. Inside were three dried words — rare sky-root syllables that the Sect had *barely* managed to preserve through the last great storm. She placed them on the table with steady hands, though her breath was not steady at all.
barely:2.cnHint: 小星在药房地板下发现了一个旧药罐，里面装着门派____保存下来的珍稀草药音节。
barely:2.hook: One of the dried syllables was already turning to ash at the edges.
barely:2.line: 'We *barely* saved these words — handle them as if they are your last breath.'

blame:2.en: The record scroll in the inner hall showed a missing formula — one that should have been copied three seasons ago. No disciple had signed the empty space. Shen Wujiu read it without expression and said the *blame* was not the point; the point was that the formula was gone, and the cloud season would not wait for anyone to feel sorry.
blame:2.cnHint: 内堂记录显示一个药方丢失，师兄说追究____并不重要，找回它才是关键。
blame:2.hook: Below the empty space, a faint ink shadow showed the missing formula had been erased, not forgotten.
blame:2.line: 'The *blame* can wait — the missing words cannot.'

chat:2.en: I found Shen Wujiu sitting alone at the cliff's edge, watching the clouds shift below. He invited me to sit, and for a quiet hour we did nothing more than *chat* — about the names of cloud formations, about which formulas hummed in cold wind and which fell silent. It felt easy and good, until he pointed to the eastern peak and said nothing more.
chat:2.cnHint: 我和师兄在悬崖边____，轻松地聊着云的名字和咒文，直到他指向东边的山峰沉默下来。
chat:2.hook: The eastern peak was wrapped in a color of cloud that had no name.
chat:2.line: 'Let us *chat* a while — the mountain will still be strange when we finish.'

combat:2.en: On the stone board inside the training hall, someone had drawn a layout of a sky-duel using dried herb-words as markers. It was not a lesson plan — the positions were too desperate, too real. Master Qingwu studied it in silence and told me that *combat* between word-masters was not about force; it was about which disciple understood the meaning of what they spoke.
combat:2.cnHint: 训练大厅的石板上有人用草药字符画出了一场____的阵型，师尊驻足沉默地审视着它。
combat:2.hook: One of the herb-word markers had been placed outside the board entirely, as if it had already fled.
combat:2.line: 'In true *combat*, the word you choose reveals what you believe.'

danger:2.en: Tucked inside the cover of my assigned text, I found a small folded note in Xiaoxing's handwriting. It said only: study the fifth formula before the cloud-gate opens, and do not go to the east garden alone. I did not know what *danger* she had sensed, but the note was creased and old — she had been carrying it, waiting for the right moment to give it to me.
danger:2.cnHint: 我在课本封面里发现了小星写的一张纸条，提醒我注意某种____，那张纸条显然已被她带了很久。
danger:2.hook: Outside, the east garden wall cast a shadow that pointed the wrong way.
danger:2.line: 'I felt the *danger* before I had words for it — so I wrote this down.'

threaten:2.en: A crack ran across the great sealing stone at the archive gate. Master Qingwu placed one hand on its surface and said nothing for a long moment. The fissure held a dark energy that did not belong to Cloud Sea Sect. Something old had begun to *threaten* the boundary between the floating mountains and whatever waited below.
threaten:2.cnHint: 封印石出现裂缝，师尊发现有黑暗力量____着山门边界。
threaten:2.hook: The crack widened by one breath before our eyes.
threaten:2.line: 'This force will *threaten* the seal before the next dawn,' Master Qingwu said softly.

throw:2.en: The old courier bird arrived at my window at first light, dropping a sealed scroll onto my floor. Accepting a message without testing it was a *throw* none of us were trained to take lightly. I pressed my finger to the wax and felt a faint warmth — the signature of Shen Wujiu, from somewhere far below the cloud line.
throw:2.cnHint: 一只信鸟带来密封卷轴，接收它是一次充满风险的____。
throw:2.hook: The wax seal smelled faintly of ash and distance.
throw:2.line: 'Opening it blind is a *throw* you may regret,' Xiaoxing warned.

unlike:2.en: The herb I found growing in the shadow of the eastern pillar was *unlike* any in Master Qingwu's teaching charts. Its leaves carried silver edges and gave off no scent at all. Xiaoxing leaned close, then stepped back quickly. Silence between us filled the narrow ledge like a held breath.
unlike:2.cnHint: 我在东柱阴影处发现一株____于教材记载的奇异药草。
unlike:2.hook: Its silver edges began to glow as the sun set.
unlike:2.line: 'This is *unlike* anything recorded in the sect library,' Xiaoxing whispered.

vast:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me to the upper terrace before sunrise to show me the full spread of the cloud sea. I had seen it before, but never from this height. The *vast* white stillness below looked less like cloud and more like a sleeping creature. He handed me a small compass and told me to watch the needle.
vast:2.cnHint: 师兄带我登上高台，俯瞰____无边的云海，并递给我一枚罗盘。
vast:2.hook: The compass needle trembled, then pointed straight down.
vast:2.line: 'The *vast* cloud sea hides more than it reveals,' Shen Wujiu said.

absolutely:2.en: Master Qingwu's note had only one line, written in her careful hand on pale paper: the inner archive must remain closed until further notice. Shen Wujiu read it twice and folded it slowly. He was *absolutely* still in a way I had never seen before — not calm, but caught between two choices neither of us could name.
absolutely:2.cnHint: 师尊的字条让师兄陷入____沉默，两人都感受到某种沉重的抉择。
absolutely:2.hook: The paper dissolved into silver dust in his hand.
absolutely:2.line: 'She is *absolutely* certain of what is inside,' Shen Wujiu murmured.

accumulate:2.en: Xiaoxing had been sketching the frost patterns on the northern archive wall for seven mornings. She told me that cold spiritual energy does not arrive suddenly — it takes time to *accumulate*, layer by quiet layer, until the stone itself remembers a different season. She pressed her palm to the wall and showed me the faint blue light beneath.
accumulate:2.cnHint: 师妹解释寒灵气如何缓慢____在石壁中，并让我看到隐隐的蓝光。
accumulate:2.hook: The blue light pulsed once, as if answering her touch.
accumulate:2.line: 'Enough cold can *accumulate* here to crack the archive from within,' Xiaoxing said.

breakfast:2.en: We gathered in the open hall to *breakfast* in silence the morning after the sealing stone cracked. The bowls were warm and the rice was soft, but no one reached for seconds. Master Qingwu's seat was empty. Shen Wujiu kept his eyes on the door at the far end of the hall, waiting for a sound that did not come.
breakfast:2.cnHint: 封印石开裂后的清晨，众弟子默默____，师尊的座位空着。
breakfast:2.hook: A single candle at Master Qingwu's seat went out on its own.
breakfast:2.line: 'We *breakfast* here today, but tomorrow is uncertain,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

capacity:2.en: The old storage vessel in the lower archive was said to hold the compressed memory of a hundred spoken formulas. Xiaoxing traced the ring of symbols around its lid and told me that its *capacity* was nearly full — one more formula pressed inside and the vessel might not hold. We both looked at the new scroll in my hand.
capacity:2.cnHint: 储存器的____几近饱和，而我手中恰好握着一卷新的法诀。
capacity:2.hook: The vessel hummed low, as if warning us to stop.
capacity:2.line: 'Its *capacity* is almost gone — do not add another word,' Xiaoxing said.

register:2.en: The Hall of Records stood at the mountain's heart, carved from cloud-white stone. I pressed my palm to the cold wall, and the ancient words lit up beneath my skin. 'You must *register* your true name here,' Shen Wujiu said quietly, 'or the sect will never recognise your power.' My name burned itself into the stone — and then kept burning.
register:2.cnHint: 在记录殿，师兄告诉我必须将真名____在石壁上，我的名字刻入后却久久不熄。
register:2.hook: The flame around my name was a colour no disciple's had ever been.
register:2.line: 'You must *register* your true name before the stone grows cold.'

skin:2.en: Xiaoxing found me by the eastern pool, where healing words drift like pollen over the water. She placed a silver leaf on my arm. 'Watch,' she said. The word written on the leaf soaked through my *skin* and settled in my bones, cool and steady as morning mist. Below the pool, the clouds turned a deep and warning red.
skin:2.cnHint: 师妹用刻有文字的银叶贴在我的____上，那文字渗入体内，而云海忽变深红。
skin:2.hook: The red in the clouds below us was spreading, not fading.
skin:2.line: 'Let the word pass through your *skin* — do not hold your breath.'

spirit:2.en: Master Qingwu led me to the Quiet Hall and told me to sit. 'A word is not merely sound,' she said, lighting a single herb that smelled of pine and rain. 'It lives because your *spirit* gives it a home.' I breathed in, and for one bright moment I felt the whole mountain breathe with me. Then the herb went out on its own.
spirit:2.cnHint: 师尊在静心殿告诉我，文字之所以有力，是因为修行者的____为它安家。
spirit:2.hook: No wind had entered the hall, yet the herb died without warning.
spirit:2.line: 'A word without a willing *spirit* behind it is only noise.'

spread:2.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a map across the stone table, its edges soft with age. Ink lines showed how one spoken word, released at the peak, could *spread* across the whole range of floating mountains like water finding every crack. 'This is why careless speech is forbidden here,' he said. Outside, a cloud shaped like an open hand passed slowly beneath us.
spread:2.cnHint: 师兄展开古图，解释一个字若在山顶说出，将如何在浮山群中____开来。
spread:2.hook: The cloud below us had five distinct fingers, and they were closing.
spread:2.line: 'Watch how quickly a word can *spread* when the wind is right.'

totally:2.en: I spent the morning copying the word for 'rise' onto thin paper, certain I had it right. Xiaoxing glanced over and shook her head gently. 'You are *totally* wrong about the third stroke,' she said, not unkindly. 'Reverse it, or the word will pull you down instead of up.' I reversed it — and the paper lifted from the desk on its own.
totally:2.cnHint: 师妹纠正我说，我对第三笔的理解____错了，若不改正，这个字会让我下坠而非升起。
totally:2.hook: The paper rose until it touched the ceiling and stayed there, trembling.
totally:2.line: 'You are *totally* wrong about the third stroke — please reverse it now.'

tree:2.en: At the cliff's edge grew one ancient *tree*, its roots gripping bare rock above the clouds. Master Qingwu said its rings held every word ever spoken on this mountain, packed in circles of living wood. She handed me a small knife and told me to listen, not to cut. Somewhere deep inside the trunk, something was already answering.
tree:2.cnHint: 悬崖边有一棵古老的____，师尊说它的年轮储存着此山上曾说出的每一个文字。
tree:2.hook: The answer inside the trunk had not waited for my question.
tree:2.line: 'Press your ear to the *tree* and you will hear what the mountain remembers.'

weigh:2.en: Before the dawn bell, I found Shen Wujiu holding two scrolls, one in each hand, eyes closed. 'I *weigh* every word before I speak it on this mountain,' he said without opening his eyes. 'A heavy word, dropped carelessly, can crack a cloud-stone path.' He opened his hands. Both scrolls rose and hung in the air, perfectly level.
weigh:2.cnHint: 师兄在黎明前手持两卷，说他会仔细____每一个将说出口的字，以防裂开云石路。
weigh:2.hook: The two scrolls hung level for a breath, then the left one dipped.
weigh:2.line: 'I *weigh* every word before I let it leave my mouth up here.'

alive:2.en: The instruction scroll Xiaoxing passed me felt warm, almost like a small animal resting in my palms. 'Every text in this library is *alive*,' she whispered, eyes bright. 'Feed it attention and it grows; ignore it and it fades.' I read the first line aloud, and the characters rose off the page, arranging themselves into the shape of a bird above my head.
alive:2.cnHint: 师妹说图书馆里每一卷文字都是____的，用心研读它便会成长，忽视它便会消散。
alive:2.hook: The bird of living characters tilted its head and waited for the next line.
alive:2.line: 'Every word in this room is *alive* — speak them with care.'

lift:2.en: The sealed bronze box arrived at my door before dawn, carried by no hand I could see. Inside lay a single word-scroll, and the moment I unrolled it the character for *lift* blazed gold — a formula that could raise a body from earth toward sky without wings or wind. I set it on my desk and stepped back, breathless.
lift:2.cnHint: 一个神秘的铜盒在黎明前出现在我门口，里面的字卷让我____离地而起。
lift:2.hook: A second scroll, still sealed, rolled out from beneath my bed.
lift:2.line: 'This word can *lift* you above the highest peak,' Shen Wujiu said softly.

mainly:2.en: Master Qingwu spread three scrolls across the stone table and explained that a disciple's first year was *mainly* devoted to tending the word-garden: watering the root-characters, pruning the branch-strokes, and listening for the hum each herb gave when it was ready to be learned. The clouds below the mountain shifted uneasily as she spoke.
mainly:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，弟子第一年____要做的事情是照料字草园。
mainly:2.hook: One herb at the garden's edge had already begun to glow without being tended.
mainly:2.line: 'Your training is *mainly* patience,' Master Qingwu said, 'and patience alone.'

moral:2.en: Xiaoxing found an old fable carved into the cliff behind the storage hall. She read it aloud: a disciple who hoarded words withered; one who shared them soared. 'The *moral* is plain,' she said, pressing her palm to the stone. Beneath her hand, the carved lines began to fill with a faint amber light.
moral:2.cnHint: 小星在石壁上读到一则寓言，其中的____清晰可见——独吞文字者终将枯萎。
moral:2.hook: The amber light spread far beyond where her hand had touched.
moral:2.line: 'The *moral* of every lesson here is the same,' Xiaoxing said quietly.

nor:2.en: I searched the entire eastern terrace for the missing word-seed — it was *nor* among the clay pots, nor tucked behind the water barrel, nor resting in any crack of the wall. Shen Wujiu said nothing when I reported this; he only looked at the sky, where a single dark cloud sat perfectly still above our peak.
nor:2.cnHint: 我找遍了东台，那粒丢失的字种既不在花盆里，也*nor*在其他任何地方。
nor:2.hook: The still cloud above the peak slowly took the shape of a missing character.
nor:2.line: 'It is *nor* lost nor destroyed,' Shen Wujiu said at last, eyes still on the sky.

pick:2.en: Master Qingwu led me to the word-garden at first light and told me to *pick* one herb for my morning study — but warned that a wrong choice would leave the chosen word dark and silent for a full month. My hand hovered, trembling, over a row of softly glowing characters that all seemed to lean toward me at once.
pick:2.cnHint: 师尊让我从字草园里____一株草药来研习，但选错了就要沉寂整整一个月。
pick:2.hook: Every herb in the row went dark the instant I made my choice.
pick:2.line: '*Pick* with your understanding, not your eye,' Master Qingwu said.

pollution:2.en: A gray mist had crept up from the lower valleys and settled on the outer word-beds. Shen Wujiu called it *pollution* from a broken mountain whose core-character had rotted — when a fundamental word died, everything it once purified turned dull and sick. He wrapped a clean scroll around the worst-affected herbs and began to recite a counter-formula in a low voice.
pollution:2.cnHint: 山谷升起的灰雾是一种____，来自一座核心文字已腐烂的山峰。
pollution:2.hook: One wrapped herb lit up bright gold, then went black with a soft hiss.
pollution:2.line: 'This *pollution* spreads faster than any storm,' Shen Wujiu warned.

quit:2.en: The copying task had taken three hours and my brush kept slipping on the damp scroll. I nearly put it down and walked away — but the moment I thought to *quit*, the character I had just written steadied itself and began to glow with a pale green warmth, as though it sensed my doubt and chose to answer it. I picked up the brush again.
quit:2.cnHint: 当我几乎想____放弃抄写时，刚写下的那个字突然发出了光。
quit:2.hook: Outside the window, the sea of clouds rose three feet in a single breath.
quit:2.line: 'Do not *quit* when the character finally wakes,' Xiaoxing urged from the doorway.

recall:2.en: Master Qingwu asked me to stand still and *recall* the very first word I had ever spoken as a child — not read, not written, but spoken from pure instinct. She said that word was my root-formula, the seed of all power I would ever hold. I closed my eyes, reached back through years of silence, and felt something small and warm stir at the edge of memory.
recall:2.cnHint: 师尊要我____自己孩提时说出的第一个字，因为那就是我的根源法诀。
recall:2.hook: When I opened my eyes, that word was already written in light on the wall before me.
recall:2.line: '*Recall* it clearly, and the mountain itself will hear you,' Master Qingwu said.

consideration:2.en: Master Qingwu handed me a folded leaf sealed with golden thread. 'Before you open it,' she said, 'give every word inside careful *consideration*.' The leaf held a single formula: one I had never seen, written in a script older than the mountain itself. Somewhere below, the clouds parted without wind.
consideration:2.cnHint: 师尊交给我一片封好的叶子，要我对其中每个字给予充分的____。
consideration:2.hook: The script on the leaf slowly began to glow on its own.
consideration:2.line: 'Every word deserves full *consideration* before you speak it aloud.'

disaster:2.en: Shen Wujiu found the old storage hall first. Shelves lay broken, jars of dried word-herbs spilled across the floor, their meanings bleeding into one another in dangerous mixtures. 'This is not an accident,' he said quietly. The scale of the *disaster* was clear: someone had done this on purpose. A single feather, black as ink, rested on the highest shelf.
disaster:2.cnHint: 师兄发现存放草药的大厅发生了严重的____，地上满是混乱的碎片。
disaster:2.hook: The black feather rose slowly, though the air was perfectly still.
disaster:2.line: 'A *disaster* of this scale does not happen without a reason.'

emergency:2.en: Xiaoxing burst through the pavilion door, breath sharp, eyes wide. She pressed a small stone tablet into my hands — the sect's signal for an *emergency*, warm and pulsing like a second heartbeat. 'The eastern word-spring has gone silent,' she said. 'No sound, no flow, nothing.' Above us, the sky deepened to the colour of a bruise.
emergency:2.cnHint: 师妹冲进来，把宗门的紧急____信号石板塞进我手里。
emergency:2.hook: The tablet's pulse stopped the moment she finished speaking.
emergency:2.line: 'This is a real *emergency* — the eastern spring answered no one all morning.'

familiar:2.en: The handwriting on the rolled-up note felt *familiar* before I had read a single word — the way each stroke leaned left, the way the final character always curled like a sleeping fish. It was Shen Wujiu's hand, yet the message was sealed in Master Qingwu's private wax. The note said only: 'Do not climb tonight.' A cold mist rose from the cloud-sea far below.
familiar:2.cnHint: 纸条上的笔迹让我感到十分____，但封印的蜡却属于师尊。
familiar:2.hook: Below the message, a second line appeared — written in no one's hand.
familiar:2.line: 'That seal is *familiar* to me — I have seen it on her private letters before.'

furthermore:2.en: The carved stone I lifted from the library floor was old, worn smooth by many hands. Its first face named the ten founding words of the Cloud Sea Sect; its second face listed five that had been erased from memory. *Furthermore*, a third face had been hidden beneath a layer of pressed clay — and the words there were ones I could not yet read. The lamp above me flickered once and went dark.
furthermore:2.cnHint: 我发现石碑有两面文字，____还有被泥土封住的第三面。
furthermore:2.hook: The hidden words seemed to shift each time I blinked.
furthermore:2.line: 'There are ten founding words, and *furthermore*, five others nobody speaks of.'

hardly:2.en: The message was written so small I could *hardly* make out the words even in full morning light. I pressed the paper close: it was a list of every disciple who had entered the eastern passage in the last month, and my name was already on it — though I had never been there. Xiaoxing leaned over my shoulder and said nothing. A single cloud rose from the sea below us, perfectly still, perfectly shaped like an open hand.
hardly:2.cnHint: 纸条上的字极小，我____能看清楚，但上面已经有了我的名字。
hardly:2.hook: My name on the list was written in ink that was still wet.
hardly:2.line: 'The words are so fine I can *hardly* read them without a lens.'

hinder:2.en: A ring of old seal-stones circled the archive door, each one humming with a low, slow note. Shen Wujiu studied them and shook his head. 'They are set to *hinder* anyone who carries an unrecognised word-herb,' he said. I checked my satchel: the cutting Master Qingwu had given me that morning glowed faintly at the bottom. The stones began to hum louder, and the door did not move.
hinder:2.cnHint: 封印石阵会____携带陌生灵草的人进入，而我包里恰好有一株。
hinder:2.hook: The hum rose in pitch until the stones began to crack.
hinder:2.line: 'Those seal-stones are designed to *hinder* any disciple with an unknown herb.'

injury:2.en: Xiaoxing unwrapped the small bundle she had carried down from the upper peak: inside lay a pressed word-leaf, its edges burned, its centre torn. 'No *injury* to the surrounding shelf,' she said, 'only to this one leaf.' It was the rarest healing word in the sect's collection — and whatever had burned it had done so with great care, leaving everything else untouched. The ash at its centre was still faintly warm.
